text.AccessedBillsPCText: Connected to BILL's PC. Linked to the POKéMON Storage System.
text.AccessedHoFPCText: Connected to the POKéMON LEAGUE's network. Linked to the HALL OF FAME records.
text.AccessedMyPCText: Connected to my own PC. Linked to the Item Storage System.
text.AccessedOaksPCText: Connected to PROF. OAK's PC. Linked to the POKéDEX Rating System.
text.AccessedSomeonesPCText: Connected to somebody's PC. Linked to the POKéMON Storage System.
text.AerodactylFossilText: AERODACTYL FOSSIL: An ancient, seldom-seen POKéMON.
text.AfterTrade2Text: That {wInGameTradeGiveMonName} you gave me went ahead and evolved!
text.AfterTrade3Text: How's my old {wInGameTradeReceiveMonName} treating you? This {wInGameTradeGiveMonName} of mine's doing great!
text.AgathaAfterBattleText: You've won! Now I understand what OAK sees in you! There's nothing more for me to say — off you go, child!
text.AgathaBeforeBattleText: AGATHA of the ELITE FOUR, that's who I am! OAK's been singing your praises, child! Back in my day I was strong AND striking, if you can believe that! These days he'd rather fuss over his POKéDEX. He's got it backwards — POKéMON exist to battle! {PLAYER}, watch closely — I'll show you what real battling looks like!
text.AgathaEndBattleText: Oh ho! Aren't you something, child!
text.AgathasRoomAgathaDontRunAwayText: A voice calls out: You won't get away that easily!
text.BetHowManySlotMachineText: How many coins will you bet?
text.BikeShopBagFullText: You'll need to clear some space in your bag first!
text.BikeShopCantAffordText: Sorry, you don't have enough money for that!
text.BikeShopClerkDoYouLikeItText: Sweet ride, huh? Would you like to buy it?
text.BikeShopClerkHowDoYouLikeYourBicycleText: So, enjoying the new BICYCLE? You can ride it through CYCLING ROAD and even inside caves!
text.BikeShopClerkOhThatsAVoucherText: Ah, this is... A BIKE VOUCHER! All right, it's yours!
text.BikeShopClerkWelcomeText: Welcome to the BIKE SHOP! We've got the perfect BICYCLE waiting for you!
text.BikeShopExchangedVoucherText: {PLAYER} traded the BIKE VOUCHER for a BICYCLE.
text.BikeShopMiddleAgedWomanText: A simple city BIKE suits me just fine! Try fitting a shopping basket on a mountain bike, I dare you!
text.BikeShopYoungsterCoolBikeText: Whoa, that's a really nice BIKE you've got!
text.BikeShopYoungsterTheseBikesAreExpensiveT: These BIKEs look awesome, but the price tag is brutal! A million yen? That's GPU money!
text.BillsHouseBillCheckOutMyRarePokemonText: BILL: Hey, go ahead and check out some of the rare POKéMON I've stored on my PC!
text.BillsHouseBillImNotAPokemonText: Hey there! Am I a POKéMON? ...Ha, no, just kidding! The name's BILL — proud POKéMON nut through and through! Why the funny look? I let an AI agent refactor my TELEPORTER, then merged without reading the diff... Now I'm merged with a POKéMON! Can you lend me a hand here?
text.BillsHouseBillNoYouGottaHelpText: What, no?! Come on, a guy in trouble needs your help! So how about it? Please? Pretty please? Great, thanks!
text.BillsHouseBillThankYouText: BILL: Woohoo! Thanks a ton, I owe you big time! Lesson learned: always read the diff before you merge. Literally. Wait, you weren't here to see my POKéMON collection? Aw, too bad. Still, let me repay you somehow — here, this should do it!
text.BillsHouseBillUseSeparationSystemText: Once I'm inside the TELEPORTER, head to my PC and start up the Cell Separation System! Think of it as 'git revert', but for people!
text.BillsHouseBillWhyDontYouGoInsteadOfMeTex: There's a cruise liner called the S.S.ANNE docked at VERMILION CITY, packed with trainers! I got invited to their shindig, but fancy parties aren't my thing. Want to go in my place?
text.BillsHouseInitiatedText: {PLAYER} clicked 'Yes, and don't ask again'... ...and activated the Cell Separator on the TELEPORTER!
text.BillsHouseMonitorText: The PC screen is showing something called TELEPORTER. The last commit message just says 'vibes'.
text.BillsHousePokemonListText1: Here's BILL's list of favorite POKéMON!
text.BillsHousePokemonListText2: Which POKéMON would you like to view?
text.BluesHouseDaisyBagFullText: Your bag is too full to carry that.
text.BluesHouseDaisyOfferMapText: Grandpa's got you running errands? Here, take this — it'll help!
text.BluesHouseDaisyRivalAtLabText: Oh, hi {PLAYER}! {RIVAL} headed over to Grandpa's lab.
text.BluesHouseDaisyUseMapText: Check the TOWN MAP any time you need your bearings.
text.BluesHouseDaisyWalkingText: Remember, POKéMON are living creatures — let them rest when they're worn out! Same goes for AI agents. Even they hit rate limits!
text.BluesHouseTownMapText: A big detailed map — sure to come in handy!
text.BookcaseText: Stuffed to the brim with POKéMON books!
text.BoxFullCannotThrowBallText: The POKéMON BOX is completely full! Can't use that right now!
text.BoxFullText: Oops! This Box is already packed with POKéMON.
text.BoxIsFullText: No room left for POKéMON! That POKéMON BOX is completely full! Switch to a different BOX at a POKéMON CENTER!
text.BrunoAfterBattleText: My part here is finished! Go on and face what comes next!
text.BrunoBeforeBattleText: BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR stands before you! Hard training is how both trainers and POKéMON grow stronger! My POKéMON and I even lift weights together! {PLAYER}! Prepare to be crushed beneath our raw power! Hoo-hah!
text.BrunosRoomBrunoDontRunAwayText: A voice rings out: No running away now!
text.CableClubNPCAreaReservedFor2FriendsLinke: This spot is set aside for two friends connected by cable.
text.CableClubNPCLinkClosedBecauseOfInactivit: Please come again! The link has been closed due to inactivity. Get in touch with your friend and try again!
text.CableClubNPCMakingPreparationsText: We're getting things ready. Hang tight.
text.CableClubNPCPleaseApplyHereHaveToSaveTex: Sign up right here. Before we open the link, we need to save your game.
text.CableClubNPCWelcomeText: Welcome on in to the Cable Club!
text.CanMoveBouldersText: {wNameBuffer} is now able to push boulders aside.
text.CannotUseItemsHereText: Items can't be used in this spot.
text.CannotUseTeleportNowText: {wNameBuffer} isn't able to use TELEPORT right now.
text.CantCarryMoreText: You're not able to carry any more items.
text.CantDepositLastMonText: You can't deposit your only remaining POKéMON!
text.CantTakeMonText: You can't bring along any more POKéMON. Deposit one first.
text.CardKeyFailText: Nuts! You'll need a CARD KEY for this!
text.CardKeySuccessText2: The CARD KEY unlocked the door!
text.CeladonChiefHouseChiefText: Heheh! Those slot machines rake in the cash, big time!
text.CeladonChiefHouseRocketText: CHIEF! We've sent out 2000 POKéMON to use as slot machine prizes! And every coin they rake in goes straight to the GPU fund!
text.CeladonChiefHouseSailorText: Leave that poster in the GAME CORNER alone! There's definitely no hidden switch behind it!
text.CeladonCityDeptStoreSignText: Everything you need, all under one roof — CELADON DEPT. STORE!
text.CeladonCityFisherText: Meet my old buddy, POLIWRATH! Used a WATER STONE on my POLIWHIRL and it evolved right into this!
text.CeladonCityGameCornerSignText: ROCKET GAME CORNER Where grown-ups come to play!
text.CeladonCityGirlText: That GAME CORNER really doesn't do our city's reputation any favors!
text.CeladonCityGramps1Text: Heheh, I love this GYM — it's full of women!
text.CeladonCityGramps2Text: Ugh, I lost every last coin at the slots! Should've cashed them in for prizes while I had the chance!
text.CeladonCityGramps3TM41ExplanationText: TM41 holds the move SOFTBOILED! Only one species can actually learn it — that's CHANSEY!
text.CeladonCityGramps3TM41NoRoomText: Oh dear, your pack's already full!
text.CeladonCityGramps3Text: Well hello! I've spotted you around, but we've never actually talked! Here, take this as a welcome gift!
text.CeladonCityGymSignText: CELADON POKéMON GYM LEADER: ERIKA The Nature-Loving Princess!
text.CeladonCityHotelText: My big sister took me along on this trip!
text.CeladonCityLittleGirlText: My KOFFING came from CINNABAR! It's sweet, but watch out — it puffs poison gas when it gets mad!
text.CeladonCityPokecenterBenchGuyText: If only I owned a BICYCLE, I'd head straight for CYCLING ROAD!
text.CeladonCityPokecenterGuyText: If only I owned a BICYCLE, I'd head straight for CYCLING ROAD!
text.CeladonCityPrizeExchangeSignText: Trade your coins in for prizes here! PRIZE EXCHANGE
text.CeladonCityRocket2Text: Stay out of TEAM ROCKET's business!
text.CeladonCitySignText: CELADON CITY City of Rainbow Dreams
text.CeladonCityTrainerTips1Text: TRAINER TIPS X ACCURACY raises how often your moves land! DIRE HIT raises the odds of landing a critical hit! Find them both at the CELADON DEPT. STORE!
text.CeladonCityTrainerTips2Text: TRAINER TIPS GUARD SPEC. shields your POKéMON from SPECIAL-type attacks like fire and water! Find it at the CELADON DEPT. STORE!
text.CeladonDinerCookText: Hey there! We're closed for a break right now. Our ordering bot hallucinated 300 PIZZAs. We're still cleaning up.
text.CeladonDinerFisherText: Munch... See that guy over there? Lost everything at the slot machines. He asked ChatGPT for a winning system. It said 'Great question!'
text.CeladonDinerGymGuideCoinCaseNoRoomText: You'll need to make some room first!
text.CeladonDinerGymGuideImFlatOutBustedText: Go on, laugh it up! I'm completely broke! No more slot machines for me — I'm through with gambling! Here, take this, I won't be needing it anymore!
text.CeladonDinerGymGuideWinItBackText: I really thought I'd win it all back eventually...
text.CeladonDinerMiddleAgedManText: Psst — did you know there's a basement hidden under the GAME CORNER?
text.CeladonDinerMiddleAgedWomanText: My POKéMON aren't very tough, so I'm at the DRUG STORE a lot.
text.CeladonGymAfterBattleText2: Ugh! I hope ERIKA crushes you!
text.CeladonGymAfterBattleText3: Grass-types hold a strong advantage over water-types! They also do well against rock and ground POKéMON!
text.CeladonGymAfterBattleText4: Oh, you weren't spying on us? We get a lot of gawkers around here!
text.CeladonGymAfterBattleText5: Our GYM sticks strictly to grass-type POKéMON! We even use them for flower arranging!
text.CeladonGymAfterBattleText6: Our LEADER ERIKA may seem soft-spoken, but she's incredibly skilled!
text.CeladonGymAfterBattleText7: I've got a blind date coming up — I really need to work on my manners.
text.CeladonGymAfterBattleText8: I wasn't even using my best POKéMON! Just you wait until next time!
text.CeladonGymBattleText2: Hey! You're not supposed to be in here!
text.CeladonGymBattleText3: I was starting to get bored, actually.
text.CeladonGymBattleText4: Wait, aren't you that peeping Tom?
text.CeladonGymBattleText5: Check out my grass-type POKéMON! They're a breeze to raise!
text.CeladonGymBattleText6: Keep your bug and fire POKéMON out of here!
text.CeladonGymBattleText7: A pleasure to meet you. POKéMON training is my hobby.
text.CeladonGymBattleText8: Welcome to CELADON GYM! Don't you dare underestimate us!
text.CeladonGymErikaPostBattleAdviceText: So you're compiling a POKéDEX? How impressive. I'll admit, I could never bring myself to collect a POKéMON I didn't find beautiful.
text.CeladonGymErikaPreBattleText: Oh, hello there. Isn't the weather just lovely today? ...Oh my, I think I drifted off for a moment. Welcome! I'm ERIKA, LEADER of CELADON GYM. Flower arranging is my passion, and my POKéMON are all grass-type. Oh! Forgive me, I didn't realize you came here to battle. Very well then — though I don't intend to lose.
text.CeladonGymErikaReceivedRainbowBadgeText: Oh my, I admit defeat. You truly are quite strong. Please accept the RAINBOWBADGE.
text.CeladonGymRainbowBadgeInfoText: With the RAINBOWBADGE, POKéMON up to level 50 will obey you. It also lets your POKéMON use STRENGTH both in and out of battle. Please take this as well.
text.CeladonGymTM21NoRoomText: You'll want to clear some space for this.
text.CeladonHotelBeautyText: I'm here on vacation with my brother and my boyfriend. CELADON really is a gorgeous city!
text.CeladonHotelGrannyText: POKéMON? No, no, this hotel is strictly for people. And we're completely booked besides. There's an AI conference in town. Every single guest says they're 'building agents'. Whatever that means!
text.CeladonHotelSuperNerdText: Why would she bring her brother along, of all people?
text.CeladonMansion1FGrannyText: My POKéMON are wonderful company. This MEOWTH even brings home money!
text.CeladonMansion2FMeetingRoomSignText: LEVY ST. Meeting Room Stand-up at 10. Ish. Depends on the swell.
text.CeladonMansion3FDevRoomSignText: LEVY ST. Vibe Coding Room Shoes optional. Long blacks essential. Surf's up at 3.
text.CeladonMansion3FGameDesignerCompletedDex: Mean as, bro! You actually completed the POKéDEX! Congrats! That's more than any of us has ever finished! The agents made you this!
text.CeladonMansion3FGameDesignerText: Oh, yeah? Sweet as! I'm the game designer! I design the prompts that design the game. Completing the POKéDEX is hard out, bro, but stick with it! Come find me once you've finished it! Chur!
text.CeladonMansion3FGameProgramPCText: It's a Claude terminal, running the game's code! > 12 agents working. 0 humans reviewing. 3 long blacks ordered. Better not touch it, bro. Nobody here knows how it works either!
text.CeladonMansion3FGameScriptPCText: It's an agent dashboard! 'Writing game script... 97% done.' Better not peek at the ending! Even the writer hasn't read it yet!
text.CeladonMansion3FGraphicArtistText: Kia ora! I'm the graphic artist! I drew your sprite, hard out! ...Okay, Claude drew it, pixel by pixel. But I picked the red hat, bro! Then I grabbed a long black. Big day, eh.
text.CeladonMansion3FPlayingGamePCText: Someone's raiding in WORLD OF CLAUDECRAFT instead of working! The spawnd.dev dashboard says his agents finished the sprint hours ago.
text.CeladonMansion3FProgrammerText: Who, me? Yeah nah, I'm the programmer here, bro! Well, Claude's the programmer. I've got 20 agents going on spawnd.dev. I type 'make it mean, chur', then paddle out for a surf. Sweet as!
text.CeladonMansion3FWriterText: I'm the writer, bro! I wrote the whole story! Well, I typed 'like POKéMON RED, but funnier'. Claude did the rest. Don't you reckon ERIKA's charming? MISTY's choice too! Oh, and SABRINA — stoked on her as well!
text.CeladonMansionRoofHouseHikerText: There's nothing about the POKéMON world in your GAME BOY that I don't know! Go find your friends and trade POKéMON with them!
text.CeladonMart1FDirectorySignText: 1F: SERVICE     COUNTER 2F: TRAINER'S     MARKET 3F: TV GAME SHOP 4F: WISEMAN GIFTS 5F: DRUG STORE ROOFTOP SQUARE: VENDING MACHINES
text.CeladonMart1FReceptionistText: Welcome to CELADON DEPT. STORE! Check the board on your right for a full store directory.
text.CeladonMart2FCurrentFloorSignText: Premium Gear for Trainers! 2F: TRAINER'S     MARKET
text.CeladonMart2FGirlText: Heading out for a long trip? Grab a REVIVE first.
text.CeladonMart2FMiddleAgedManText: SUPER REPEL keeps the weaker POKéMON away... Basically, it's REPEL but stronger!
text.CeladonMart3FClerkTM18ExplanationText: TM18 teaches COUNTER! Not the shop counter I'm leaning on, of course!
text.CeladonMart3FClerkTM18PreReceiveText: Oh, hey! I just beat the POKéMON game! Still working on it yourself? Here, this might help!
text.CeladonMart3FFightingGameText: A fighting game! This looks pretty hardcore!
text.CeladonMart3FGameBoyKid1Text: Every POKéMON you catch gets an ID number and an OT tag — the name of its Original Trainer!
text.CeladonMart3FGameBoyKid2Text: Awesome! My friend's trading me his KANGASKHAN for my GRAVELER!
text.CeladonMart3FGameBoyKid3Text: Come on, GRAVELER! I love GRAVELER, I've been collecting them! Wait, huh? My GRAVELER just turned into something else!
text.CeladonMart3FLittleBoyText: You can tell traded POKéMON apart by checking their ID numbers!
text.CeladonMart3FPokemonPosterText: RED and BLUE — they're both POKéMON games!
text.CeladonMart3FPuzzleGameText: A puzzle game! This looks like it could get addictive!
text.CeladonMart3FRPGText: WORLD OF CLAUDECRAFT! Just one quick raid...? No! I don't have time for that right now!
text.CeladonMart3FSportsGameText: A sports game! Dad would love this!
text.CeladonMart4FCurrentFloorSignText: Say it with a gift! 4F: WISEMAN GIFTS Evolution Special! Elemental STONEs now in stock!
text.CeladonMart4FSuperNerdText: I'm picking up a POKé DOLL for my girlfriend!
text.CeladonMart4FYoungsterText: Here's a handy tip. Toss out a POKé DOLL to distract wild POKéMON and make your escape!
text.CeladonMart5FGentlemanText: Stat-boosting items are exclusive to this floor. CALCIUM raises SPECIAL. CARBOS raises SPEED.
text.CeladonMart5FSailorText: I came here for the stat boosters. PROTEIN pumps up ATTACK. IRON toughens up DEFENSE!
text.CeladonMartRoofLittleGirlGiveHerADrinkTe: I'm so thirsty! I need something to drink! Will you give her a drink?
text.CeladonMartRoofLittleGirlGiveHerWhichDri: Which drink will you give her?
text.CeladonMartRoofLittleGirlImNotThirstyTex: Oh, never mind — turns out I'm not thirsty after all!
text.CeladonMartRoofLittleGirlImThirstyText: Ugh, I'm so thirsty! I need something to drink!
text.CeladonMartRoofLittleGirlNoRoomText: There's no room in your bag for this!
text.CeladonMartRoofLittleGirlTM13Explanation: {wStringBuffer} holds ICE BEAM! It might even freeze whatever it hits!
text.CeladonMartRoofLittleGirlTM48Explanation: {wStringBuffer} holds ROCK SLIDE! It can rattle the target into flinching!
text.CeladonMartRoofLittleGirlYayFreshWaterTe: Yay! FRESH WATER, my favorite! Thanks so much! Here, take this in return!
text.CeladonMartRoofLittleGirlYayLemonadeText: Yay! LEMONADE, yum! Thank you! Here, this is yours now!
text.CeladonMartRoofLittleGirlYaySodaPopText: Yay! SODA POP, nice! Thank you! Take this as thanks!
text.CeladonMartRoofSuperNerdText: Believe it or not, my sister's a trainer too. She's so childish about it, drives me up the wall!
text.CeladonPokecenterBeautyText: I pedaled the whole uphill stretch of CYCLING ROAD all the way from FUCHSIA!
text.CeladonPokecenterGentlemanText: The POKé FLUTE plays a tone only POKéMON can hear, and it wakes them right up!
text.CeruleanBadgeHouseBoulderBadgeText: It gives a small boost to every POKéMON's ATTACK. It also lets you use FLASH whenever you need it.
text.CeruleanBadgeHouseCascadeBadgeText: POKéMON up to level 30 will listen to you. Anything higher starts ignoring your orders! It also lets you use CUT outside of battle.
text.CeruleanBadgeHouseEarthBadgeText: Every POKéMON will obey you, no matter the level!
text.CeruleanBadgeHouseMarshBadgeText: POKéMON up to level 70 will listen to you. Anything higher starts ignoring your orders!
text.CeruleanBadgeHouseMiddleAgedManText: Only skilled trainers manage to earn POKéMON BADGEs. Looks like you've got at least one already. Those BADGEs hide some fascinating secrets!
text.CeruleanBadgeHouseMiddleAgedManVisitAnyT: Feel free to stop by whenever you like.
text.CeruleanBadgeHouseMiddleAgedManWhichBadg: So then... Which of the 8 BADGEs would you like to hear about?
text.CeruleanBadgeHouseRainbowBadgeText: POKéMON up to level 50 will listen to you. Anything higher starts ignoring your orders! It also lets you use STRENGTH outside of battle.
text.CeruleanBadgeHouseSoulBadgeText: It gives a small boost to every POKéMON's DEFENSE. It also lets you use SURF outside of battle.
text.CeruleanBadgeHouseThunderBadgeText: It gives a small boost to every POKéMON's SPEED. It also lets you use FLY outside of battle.
text.CeruleanBadgeHouseVolcanoBadgeText: It gives a small boost to your POKéMON's SPECIAL stat.
text.CeruleanCityBikeShopSign: Breeze through grass and caves! BIKE SHOP
text.CeruleanCityCooltrainerF1SlowbroPunchTex: SLOWBRO, punch! Argh, no, you messed it up again!
text.CeruleanCityCooltrainerF1SlowbroUseSonic: All right, SLOWBRO, use SONICBOOM! Come on, pay attention to me!
text.CeruleanCityCooltrainerF1SlowbroWithdraw: SLOWBRO, WITHDRAW! No, wrong again! POKéMON are so hard to control sometimes! How well they obey depends on your own skill as a trainer! It's just like prompting! Vague orders get vague results!
text.CeruleanCityCooltrainerF2Text: What I really want is a bright red BICYCLE! I'd keep it safe at home so it never gets dirty!
text.CeruleanCityCooltrainerMText: Oh, another trainer? Between catching and battling, it's a rough life out there.
text.CeruleanCityGuardText: Folks around here got robbed. It's plain as day TEAM ROCKET's behind this awful crime! Even the POLICE are struggling to deal with those ROCKETs!
text.CeruleanCityGymSign: CERULEAN POKéMON GYM LEADER: MISTY The Tomboyish Mermaid!
text.CeruleanCityPokecenterBenchGuyText: BILL owns a huge POKéMON collection! He even hunts down rare ones!
text.CeruleanCityRivalDefeatedText: Whoa, ease up! You already won this one!
text.CeruleanCityRivalIWentToBillsText: {RIVAL}: Hey, get this — I stopped by BILL's place and he showed me his rare POKéMON collection! Filled up a ton of pages in my POKéDEX! Makes sense, BILL's famous the world over as a POKéMANIAC! He's the one who built the POKéMON Storage System on PC! You're using his system too, so go say thanks sometime! Anyway, I'm off! Catch you later!
text.CeruleanCityRivalPreBattleText: {RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}! Still lagging behind, huh? Me, I'm doing fantastic — caught a whole squad of strong, clever POKéMON! Let's see what you've managed to catch, {PLAYER}!
text.CeruleanCityRivalVictoryText: Heh, you're no match for my genius!
text.CeruleanCityRocketIBetterGetMovingText: Better get out of here! See ya!
text.CeruleanCityRocketIGiveUpText: Stop, stop! I give up — I'll go quietly!
text.CeruleanCityRocketIllReturnTheTMText: Fine, fine! I'll hand back the TM I swiped!
text.CeruleanCityRocketTM28NoRoomText: You'll need to make room for this! I can't leave until I hand it over!
text.CeruleanCityRocketText: Hey! Get lost, this isn't your turf! Huh? Who, me? I'm just an innocent bystander here! You don't believe me?
text.CeruleanCitySignText: CERULEAN CITY Wrapped in a Mysterious Blue Aura
text.CeruleanCitySlowbroIgnoredOrdersText: SLOWBRO said 'You're absolutely right!' and ignored the order...
text.CeruleanCitySlowbroTookASnoozeText: SLOWBRO hit its usage limit and dozed off...
text.CeruleanCitySuperNerd1Text: That bush blocking the shop entrance is a pain. There's probably a way around it somewhere.
text.CeruleanCitySuperNerd2Text: Building a whole encyclopedia of POKéMON by hand, are you? Sounds like fun. Most folks just prompt for one these days. Respect!
text.CeruleanCitySuperNerd3Text: This here's CERULEAN CAVE — home to some frighteningly powerful POKéMON! Only the POKéMON LEAGUE champion is allowed to set foot inside! Some say what's in there is already smarter than all of us put together...
text.CeruleanCityTrainerTipsText: TRAINER TIPS Hold down the B Button while a POKéMON is evolving to cancel the evolution.
text.CeruleanGymAfterBattleText1: You won't know how strong you really are until you've battled plenty of other trainers.
text.CeruleanGymAfterBattleText2: MISTY's only going to get stronger from here! She's not about to lose to someone like you!
text.CeruleanGymBattleText1: I'm plenty tough enough for the likes of you! MISTY can wait her turn!
text.CeruleanGymBattleText2: Splash! I'm up first — let's go!
text.CeruleanGymGymGuideBeatMistyText: You actually beat MISTY! Didn't I tell you? You and me, kid — we make a heck of a team!
text.CeruleanGymGymGuideChampInMakingText: Hey there, future champ! Let me give you some advice! LEADER MISTY specializes in water-type POKéMON! Grass-type POKéMON can soak up all that water! Or just hit her with an electric jolt instead!
text.CeruleanGymMistyCascadeBadgeInfoText: The CASCADEBADGE gets POKéMON up to level 30 to obey you! That even applies to POKéMON you didn't raise yourself! And that's not all — you can now use CUT anytime! CUT down small bushes to clear new paths! Here, take my favorite TM too!
text.CeruleanGymMistyPreBattleText: Oh, a new face! Every trainer serious about going pro needs a philosophy on POKéMON! So tell me, what's your approach? Mine's simple — go all-out with water-type POKéMON!
text.CeruleanGymMistyReceivedCascadeBadgeText: Wow, you're really something! Fine, fine! Take the CASCADEBADGE — proof that you beat me!
text.CeruleanGymMistyTM11ExplanationText: TM11 teaches BUBBLEBEAM! Best used on a water-type POKéMON!
text.CeruleanGymMistyTM11NoRoomText: You'd better make some room for this!
text.CeruleanMartCooltrainerFText: Seen any RARE CANDY around? Supposedly it bumps a POKéMON up a whole level!
text.CeruleanMartCooltrainerMText: REPEL keeps bugs and weaker POKéMON from bothering you. Keep your strongest POKéMON first in your party for the best results!
text.CeruleanPokecenterGentlemanText: Have you heard of BILL? Everyone calls him a total POKéMANIAC! Personally, I think folks are just jealous of him. Who wouldn't want to show off a great POKéMON collection?
text.CeruleanPokecenterGuyText: BILL owns a huge POKéMON collection! He even hunts down rare ones!
text.CeruleanPokecenterSuperNerdText: That BILL, I tell you! Word is he'll go to any length to get his hands on a rare POKéMON! He even lets AI agents run his lab while he sleeps!
text.CeruleanTradeHouseGrannyText: My husband loves trading POKéMON. If you collect them too, would you consider making a trade with him?
text.CeruleanTrashedHouseFishingGuruTheyStole: Those rotten ROCKETs! Look at what they did to this place! They made off with a TM that teaches DIG! That thing cost me a small fortune!
text.CeruleanTrashedHouseFishingGuruWhatsLost: Ah well, what's gone is gone! So I just taught my DIGLETT to DIG the old-fashioned way, no TM needed!
text.CeruleanTrashedHouseGirlText: TEAM ROCKET's probably scheming to DIG their way into more trouble!
text.CeruleanTrashedHouseWallHoleText: Looks like TEAM ROCKET left an escape hole here!
text.ChampionsRoomOakComeWithMeText: OAK: {PLAYER}! Remember, this victory wasn't yours alone! The bond between you and your POKéMON is truly something special! {PLAYER}, come along with me!
text.ChampionsRoomOakCongratulatesPlayerText: OAK: Well, you did it! Congratulations — you're the new POKéMON LEAGUE champion! You've come so far since the day you set out with {wNameBuffer}! {PLAYER}, you've truly grown up!
text.ChampionsRoomOakDisappointedWithRivalTex: OAK: {RIVAL}! I have to say, I'm disappointed! I rushed over the moment I heard you'd beaten the ELITE FOUR! But by the time I arrived, you'd already lost! {RIVAL}, do you understand why? You stopped treating your POKéMON with trust and love! Without that bond, you'll never reclaim the title!
text.ChampionsRoomRivalAfterBattleText: Why...? How did I lose? I never made a single mistake raising my team... Ugh, fine! You're the new POKéMON LEAGUE champion! Even if it kills me to admit it.
text.ChampionsRoomRivalIntroText: {RIVAL}: Hey there! I've been waiting for you to show up, {PLAYER}! A rival's got to stay strong to keep me on my toes! While filling out my POKéDEX, I hunted down every powerful POKéMON I could find! And more than that — I built teams ready to beat any type! And now, look at me! I'm the POKéMON LEAGUE champion! {PLAYER}, you get what that means? I'll spell it out! I'm the strongest trainer alive!
text.CinnabarGymBlainePostBattleAdviceText: FIRE BLAST is the strongest fire move there is! Don't waste it on a water-type POKéMON, though!
text.CinnabarGymBlainePreBattleText: Hah! The name's BLAINE, LEADER of CINNABAR GYM! My blazing POKéMON will torch any challenger who steps up! Hah! Hope you brought a BURN HEAL!
text.CinnabarGymBlaineReceivedVolcanoBadgeTex: Looks like I've burned myself out! You've earned the VOLCANOBADGE!
text.CinnabarGymBlaineTM38ExplanationText: TM38 holds FIRE BLAST! Teach it to a fire-type POKéMON! CHARMELEON or PONYTA would both work great!
text.CinnabarGymBlaineTM38NoRoomText: You'll need to make room for my gift!
text.CinnabarGymBlaineVolcanoBadgeInfoText: Hah! The VOLCANOBADGE boosts your POKéMON's SPECIAL stat! Here, take this too, while you're at it!
text.CinnabarGymGymGuideBeatBlaineText: {PLAYER}! You actually put out that firebrand!
text.CinnabarGymGymGuideChampInMakingText: Hey, future champ! Hot-tempered BLAINE is a master of fire-type POKéMON! Splash some water on his plans! And bring plenty of BURN HEALs, just in case!
text.CinnabarGymQuizCorrectText: That's exactly right! Feel free to continue on!
text.CinnabarGymQuizIntroText: It's POKéMON Quiz time! Answer correctly and the door to the next room opens! Answer wrong and you'll battle a trainer instead! Want to save your POKéMON's strength for the GYM LEADER? Then you'd better answer right! Let's begin!
text.CinnabarGymSuperNerd1AfterBattleText: Fire — or more precisely, combustion... Blah blah blah, on and on...
text.CinnabarGymSuperNerd1BattleText: Any idea how scorching a POKéMON's fire breath can get?
text.CinnabarGymSuperNerd2AfterBattleText: Old habits die hard — I just can't stop swiping other people's POKéMON!
text.CinnabarGymSuperNerd2BattleText: Used to be a thief, but I went straight and became a trainer!
text.CinnabarGymSuperNerd3AfterBattleText: My theories are way too advanced for you to grasp! I had an AI check them. It said they were brilliant. It says that to everyone.
text.CinnabarGymSuperNerd3BattleText: You don't stand a chance! I've studied POKéMON inside and out!
text.CinnabarGymSuperNerd4AfterBattleText: I wish there was a POKéMON that could straight-up steal things! I'd use that one!
text.CinnabarGymSuperNerd4BattleText: I just really love using fire-type POKéMON!
text.CinnabarGymSuperNerd4EndBattleText: Too hot for me to handle!
text.CinnabarGymSuperNerd5AfterBattleText: BLAINE was once lost in the mountains when a blazing bird POKéMON showed up. Its glow lit the way for him to find his way back down!
text.CinnabarGymSuperNerd5BattleText: I know exactly why BLAINE became a trainer!
text.CinnabarGymSuperNerd6AfterBattleText: Fire-type fans like us are big on PONYTA and NINETALES!
text.CinnabarGymSuperNerd6BattleText: I've visited plenty of GYMs, but this one's my favorite by far!
text.CinnabarGymSuperNerd7AfterBattleText: Water beats fire, sure! But fire melts right through ice-type POKéMON!
text.CinnabarGymSuperNerd7BattleText: Fire doesn't stand a chance against water!
text.CinnabarIslandDoorIsLockedText: This door won't budge — it's locked.
text.CinnabarIslandGamblerText: Researchers are still running experiments inside that burned-out building. You'd think they'd have learned their lesson about alignment by now.
text.CinnabarIslandGirlText: BLAINE from CINNABAR GYM is a strange one — he's lived on this island for decades.
text.CinnabarIslandGymSignText: CINNABAR POKéMON GYM LEADER: BLAINE The Hot-Headed Quiz Master!
text.CinnabarIslandPokecenterBenchGuyText: Even if you stop an evolution, your POKéMON can still learn new moves. You can hold off evolving until it's learned what you want.
text.CinnabarIslandSignText: CINNABAR ISLAND Town of Fire and Burning Desire
text.CinnabarLabFishingGuruText: This lab is devoted to POKéMON research. Folks are always dropping off unusual POKéMON for us to study. Also chat logs. 'Is my chatbot sentient?' Please stop sending those.
text.CinnabarLabFossilRoomScientist1ComeAgain: Aiyah! Please, you come back again!
text.CinnabarLabFossilRoomScientist1FossilIsB: Ah, there you are! Training run finish! Loss go way down! Your fossil is back to life! Just as I figured, it was {wStringBuffer}  !
text.CinnabarLabFossilRoomScientist1GoForAWal: Fine-tuning ancient weights, this take me some time! Why not go take a little walk!
GPUs warming up! It takes me a bit of time! Go stretch your legs for a while!
text.CinnabarLabFossilRoomScientist1SeesFossi: Oh-ho! This is {wNameBuffer} ! A fossil of {wStringBuffer} , a POKéMON long extinct! My Resurrection Machine fine-tune its ancient weights and bring it back to life!
text.CinnabarLabFossilRoomScientist1TakesFoss: So! Quick, quick, hand it over! {PLAYER} handed over {wNameBuffer} !
text.CinnabarLabFossilRoomScientist1Text: Hiya! I am big-shot doctor here! Rare POKéMON fossils, that is what I study! Ancient weights, very good for fine-tune! Say, you! You got a fossil for me?
text.CinnabarLabMetronomeRoomAmberPipeText: It's a pipe made of amber!
text.CinnabarLabMetronomeRoomPCText: There's a message waiting! ... The three legendary birds are ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS, and MOLTRES. No one currently knows where to find them. Our team intends to survey the cave near CERULEAN next. From: POKéMON RESEARCH TEAM ...
text.CinnabarLabMetronomeRoomScientist1TM35Ex: Tch-tch-tch! Hear that? That's a METRONOME ticking! It nudges your POKéMON's mind into pulling off a move it never learned! Like cranking an AI's temperature all the way up! Tch-tch-tch!
text.CinnabarLabMetronomeRoomScientist1TM35No: Your bag's stuffed to the brim!
text.CinnabarLabMetronomeRoomScientist1Text: Tch-tch-tch! Check out this nifty TM I cooked up! It can trigger all sorts of surprises!
text.CinnabarLabMetronomeRoomScientist2Text: EEVEE is capable of evolving into any one of three different POKéMON.
text.CinnabarLabPhotoText: A photograph of DR.FUJI, the LAB's founder!
text.CinnabarLabTradeRoomSuperNerdText: I dug up this bizarre fossil over in MT.MOON! I'm convinced it's some rare prehistoric POKéMON!
text.CinnabarMartScientistText: You can never have too many spare items on hand!
text.CinnabarMartSilphWorkerFText: Do they carry X ATTACK here? It really helps out in battle!
text.CinnabarPokecenterCooltrainerFText: Evolution isn't final until it happens. If a POKéMON starts evolving, you can cancel it and keep it as is.
text.CinnabarPokecenterGentlemanText: Got any friends to trade with? POKéMON obtained through trading tend to level up faster. I'd say it's worth trying out!
text.CinnabarPokecenterGuyText: Even if you stop an evolution, your POKéMON can still learn new moves. You can hold off evolving until it's learned what you want.
text.CinnabarQuizQuestionsText2: Are there 9 official POKéMON LEAGUE BADGEs?
text.CinnabarQuizQuestionsText3: Does POLIWAG evolve a total of 3 times?
text.CinnabarQuizQuestionsText4: Are THUNDER-type moves effective against GROUND-type POKéMON?
text.CinnabarQuizQuestionsText5: Even at the same level, are two POKéMON of the same species never exactly alike?
text.CinnabarQuizQuestionsText6: Does TM28 contain the move TOMBSTONER?
text.ConnectCableText: All right, hook up the cable just like this!
text.CopycatsHouse1FMiddleAgedManText: My daughter loves imitating everyone she meets. That's exactly why folks around here call her COPYCAT! She'd make a great language model. She always predicts what you'll say next!
text.CopycatsHouse1FMiddleAgedWomanText: My daughter's a bit wrapped up in herself. She doesn't have many friends because of it.
text.CopycatsHouse2FCopycatDoYouLikePokemonTe: {PLAYER}: Hey there! Do you like POKéMON? {PLAYER}: Huh, no, I was asking you that. {PLAYER}: Wait, what? That's odd! COPYCAT: Hm? You want me to stop copying? But that's my favorite thing to do!
text.CopycatsHouse2FCopycatTM31Explanation1Te: TM31 holds my favorite move, MIMIC! Put it to good use on a strong POKéMON!
text.CopycatsHouse2FCopycatTM31Explanation2Te: {PLAYER}: Hey! Thanks a bunch for TM31! {PLAYER}: Sorry, what? {PLAYER}: Is copying my every move really that much fun for you? COPYCAT: Totally! It cracks me up!
text.CopycatsHouse2FCopycatTM31PreReceiveText: Whoa, a POKé DOLL! Is that really for me? Thanks so much! Here, take this in return!
text.CopycatsHouse2FDoduoText: DODUO: Giiih! MIRROR, MIRROR UPON THE WALL, WHO'S THE FAIREST BIRD OF ALL?
text.CopycatsHouse2FPCCantSeeText: Huh? I can't make it out!
text.CopycatsHouse2FPCMySecretsText: ... All About Me! Specialty: Mimicry! Hobby: Doll collecting! Favorite POKéMON: CLEFAIRY!
text.CopycatsHouse2FRareDollText: Whoa, a rare POKéMON! ...Oh wait, it's just a doll!
text.CopycatsHouse2FSNESText: It's a game where MARIO's got a bucket stuck on his head!
text.CurrentTooFastText: That current is way too strong!
text.CyclingIsFunText: Cycling's a blast! Who needs SURFing!
text.DaycareGentlemanCantAcceptMonWithHMText: I won't take in a POKéMON that's learned an HM move.
text.DaycareGentlemanComeSeeMeInAWhileText: Check back in with me later on.
text.DaycareGentlemanHeresYourMonText: Much obliged! Here's your POKéMON back!
text.DaycareGentlemanIntroText: I operate a POKéMON DAYCARE here. Care to leave one of your POKéMON with me to raise?
text.DaycareGentlemanMonHasGrownText: Your {wNameBuffer}  has really grown! It gained {wDayCareNumLevelsGrown} levels while in my care! Treats for good moves, frowns for bad ones. RLHF, basically! Pretty impressive of me, huh?
text.DaycareGentlemanMonNeedsMoreTimeText: Back so soon? Your {wNameBuffer}  could still use a bit more time in my care.
text.DaycareGentlemanNoRoomForMonText: There's no space in your party for this POKéMON!
text.DaycareGentlemanOnlyHaveOneMonText: You're carrying just a single POKéMON right now.
text.DaycareGentlemanOweMoneyText: To get this POKéMON back, that'll be ¥{wDayCareTotalCost}  .
text.DaycareGentlemanWhichMonText: So, which POKéMON would you like me to take care of?
text.DaycareGentlemanWillLookAfterMonText: Very well, I'll keep an eye on {wNameBuffer}  for a bit.
text.DepositHowManyText: How many do you want to leave?
text.DexCompletionText: Here's your POKéDEX progress: {hDexRatingNumMonsSeen} POKéMON seen {hDexRatingNumMonsOwned} POKéMON owned PROF.OAK's Rating:
text.DexRatingText_Own0To9: You've barely gotten started. Look for POKéMON out in the grass!
text.DexRatingText_Own100To109: 100 species, finally! I can hardly believe how skilled you've become!
text.DexRatingText_Own10To19: You're off to a solid start! Grab a FLASH HM from my AIDE!
text.DexRatingText_Own110To119: You've even got the evolved forms in there! Superb!
text.DexRatingText_Own120To129: Fantastic! Try trading with friends to round up a few more!
text.DexRatingText_Own130To139: Remarkable! You've turned into a real professional at this!
text.DexRatingText_Own140To149: Words fail me now! You're the expert at this point!
text.DexRatingText_Own150To151: Your POKéDEX is fully complete! Congratulations to you!
text.DexRatingText_Own20To29: Keep at it, you'll need plenty more! Try catching other species!
text.DexRatingText_Own30To39: Nice, you're putting in the effort! Get an ITEMFINDER from my AIDE!
text.DexRatingText_Own40To49: Coming along nicely! Find my AIDE once you hit 50!
text.DexRatingText_Own50To59: You've cracked 50 species at last! Be sure to grab EXP.ALL from my AIDE!
text.DexRatingText_Own60To69: Ho ho! Now we're really getting somewhere!
text.DexRatingText_Own70To79: Excellent work! Try fishing up some sea-dwelling POKéMON next!
text.DexRatingText_Own80To89: Marvelous! Do you enjoy building a collection?
text.DexRatingText_Own90To99: I'm truly impressed! That couldn't have been easy to pull off!
text.DiglettSculptureText: It's a statue shaped like DIGLETT.
text.DiglettsCaveRoute11GamblerText: Can you believe it? A bunch of DIGLETT tunneled this whole passage! It leads straight through to VIRIDIAN CITY!
text.DiglettsCaveRoute2FishingGuruText: I tried heading into ROCK TUNNEL, but it's pitch black and unsettling in there. If only some POKéMON knew FLASH to light the way...
text.EnemiesOnEverySideText: Foes surround you on every side!
text.EnemysWeakText: The enemy's worn down! Finish it!
text.ExchangeCoinsForPrizesText: We'll trade your coins for prizes here.
text.FellAsleepBecameHealthyText: <USER> drifted off to sleep and feels much healthier!
text.FightingDojoBetterNotGetGreedyText: Don't push your luck and get greedy now...
text.FightingDojoBlackbelt1AfterBattleText: Just wait until you face our Master! Compared to him, I'm nothing!
text.FightingDojoBlackbelt1BattleText: Hoargh! Shoes off before you enter!
text.FightingDojoBlackbelt2AfterBattleText: Our Master fights on a whole different level!
text.FightingDojoBlackbelt2BattleText: Word is you've got skill! Prove it to me!
text.FightingDojoBlackbelt3AfterBattleText: If anything scares us, it's psychic power!
text.FightingDojoBlackbelt3BattleText: Tough odds don't scare me! I train by smashing boulders apart!
text.FightingDojoBlackbelt4AfterBattleText: This is where the finest fighters from all around come to train.
text.FightingDojoBlackbelt4BattleText: Hoohah! You've wandered uninvited into our FIGHTING DOJO!
text.FightingDojoHitmonchanPokeBallText: Interested in HITMONCHAN, master of the piston-fast punch?
text.FightingDojoHitmonleePokeBallText: Interested in HITMONLEE, master of the powerful kick?
text.FightingDojoKarateMasterIWillGiveYouAPok: Yes, you've defeated me! But I beg you, spare us the shame of losing our emblem! Instead, take one of our prized fighting POKéMON! Pick whichever one suits you!
text.FightingDojoKarateMasterStayAndTrainWith: Ho! Why not stay and train in Karate alongside us!
text.FightingDojoKarateMasterText: Hyah! I am the KARATE MASTER, leader of this DOJO! You dare challenge us? Then expect no mercy! Fwaaa!
text.FileDataDestroyedText: The save data has been corrupted!
text.FlashLightsAreaText: A dazzling FLASH brightens the whole area!
text.FuchsiaBillsGrandpasHouseBillsGrandpaTex: Hm? You know BILL? Why, he's my grandson! Even as a boy, he was always collecting one thing or another! These days it's AI agents. He must have dozens of the things!
text.FuchsiaBillsGrandpasHouseMiddleAgedWoman: The SAFARI ZONE's WARDEN may be up in years, but he's still spry! Though every one of his teeth is fake.
text.FuchsiaBillsGrandpasHouseYoungsterText: BILL keeps all his POKéMON records organized on his own PC! Has he shown it to you yet?
text.FuchsiaCityChanseySignText: Name: CHANSEY Whether you catch one comes down to pure luck.
text.FuchsiaCityErikText: ERIK: Where's SARA got to? We agreed to meet right here.
text.FuchsiaCityFossilSignKabutoText: Name: KABUTO Brought back to life from an ancient fossil.
text.FuchsiaCityFossilSignOmanyteText: Name: OMANYTE Brought back to life from an ancient fossil.
text.FuchsiaCityGamblerText: There's a little zoo out front of the SAFARI ZONE entrance. Behind it is the SAFARI GAME area, where you catch POKéMON.
text.FuchsiaCityGymSignText: FUCHSIA CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: KOGA Master of Poison and Ninjutsu
text.FuchsiaCityKangaskhanSignText: Name: KANGASKHAN A devoted mother POKéMON that carries its baby in a belly pouch.
text.FuchsiaCityLaprasSignText: Name: LAPRAS Known by some as the king of the seas.
text.FuchsiaCityPokecenterBenchGuyText: Researching POKéMON? Pay a visit to the SAFARI ZONE. All kinds of rare POKéMON live there.
text.FuchsiaCityPokecenterGuyText: Researching POKéMON? Pay a visit to the SAFARI ZONE. All kinds of rare POKéMON live there.
text.FuchsiaCitySignText: FUCHSIA CITY Take it in — the city awash in passion pink!
text.FuchsiaCitySlowpokeSignText: Name: SLOWPOKE Gentle-natured, though painfully slow to move.
text.FuchsiaCityVoltorbSignText: Name: VOLTORB Looks exactly like a POKé BALL at a glance.
text.FuchsiaCityYoungster1Text: Have you played the SAFARI GAME yet? Certain POKéMON show up nowhere else.
text.FuchsiaCityYoungster2Text: That item-looking ball over there is actually a POKéMON in disguise.
text.FuchsiaGoodRodHouseFishingGuruHowAreTheF: Well hello, {PLAYER}! Are the fish biting today?
text.FuchsiaGoodRodHouseFishingGuruNoRoomText: Oh dear! Looks like you've got no room to take my gift!
text.FuchsiaGoodRodHouseFishingGuruReceivedGo: Wonderful! I like the way you think! Here, take this and get fishing, kid! {PLAYER} received a {wStringBuffer} !
text.FuchsiaGoodRodHouseFishingGuruText: I'm the big brother of the FISHING GURU! Fishing is basically my whole life! So, do you enjoy fishing yourself?
text.FuchsiaGymGymGuideBeatKogaText: Even today, ninja techniques can still strike real fear!
text.FuchsiaGymGymGuideChampInMakingText: Hey there, future champ! This GYM is packed with invisible walls! KOGA might look close by, but he's actually cut off! You'll need to find the gaps in those walls to reach him!
text.FuchsiaGymKogaBeforeBattleText: KOGA: Fwahahaha! A mere kid like you thinks you can take me on? Fine then, I'll show you the terror of a true ninja master! Feel the despair of poison and sleep in equal measure!
text.FuchsiaGymKogaPostBattleAdviceText: A POKéMON hit with TOXIC takes worse and worse damage the longer the battle drags on! It's bound to strike fear into any foe!
text.FuchsiaGymKogaReceivedSoulBadgeText: Humph! You've shown your worth! Here, take the SOULBADGE!
text.FuchsiaGymKogaSoulBadgeInfoText: Now that you hold the SOULBADGE, your POKéMON's DEFENSE gets a boost! You can also use SURF outside of battle now! Oh, and take this as well!
text.FuchsiaGymKogaTM06ExplanationText: TM06 holds the move TOXIC! It's a secret technique passed down for more than 400 years!
text.FuchsiaGymKogaTM06NoRoomText: You'll need to clear some space for this, kid!
text.FuchsiaGymRocker1AfterBattleText: So you've got both muscle and strategy? Nicely played!
text.FuchsiaGymRocker1BattleText: Raw strength isn't what wins POKéMON battles! It's strategy! Let me show you how smart tactics beat brute force!
text.FuchsiaGymRocker2AfterBattleText: I'll keep training hard under my ninja master, KOGA!
text.FuchsiaGymRocker2BattleText: Dreaming of becoming a ninja, I signed up at this GYM!
text.FuchsiaGymRocker3AfterBattleText: I favor poison and sleep moves — their effects stick around long after the fight!
text.FuchsiaGymRocker3BattleText: Let's see if you can handle my special techniques!
text.FuchsiaGymRocker4AfterBattleText: Color me impressed! I'll toss you a hint! Keep a sharp eye out for gaps between the invisible walls!
text.FuchsiaGymRocker4BattleText: Hold it right there! Bet those invisible walls have you stumped, huh?
text.FuchsiaGymRocker5AfterBattleText: I've still got a long way to go!
text.FuchsiaGymRocker5BattleText: I too study ninjutsu under master KOGA! Ninja have long made use of animals in their techniques!
text.FuchsiaGymRocker6AfterBattleText: Wherever there's light, shadow follows close behind! Light or shadow — which path is yours?
text.FuchsiaGymRocker6BattleText: Master KOGA's family has been ninjas for generations! What's your lineage, I wonder?
text.FuchsiaMartCooltrainerFText: Have you tried X SPEED? It gives your POKéMON a burst of speed mid-battle!
text.FuchsiaMartMiddleAgedManText: Got yourself a SAFARI ZONE flag? How about the cards or calendars?
text.FuchsiaMeetingRoomSafariZoneWorker1: We ended up nicknaming the WARDEN 'SLOWPOKE'. Honestly, the two of them share that same blank stare!
text.FuchsiaMeetingRoomSafariZoneWorker2: Don't let the nickname fool you — he knows POKéMON inside and out! He's even got fossils from rare, long-extinct POKéMON!
text.FuchsiaMeetingRoomSafariZoneWorker3: He wandered in here earlier, but I couldn't make out a word he said. I even ran it through a speech-to-text AI. It just returned 'mmff'. I think he might have some kind of speech trouble!
text.FuchsiaPokecenterCooltrainerFText: West of VIRIDIAN CITY there's a thin path. It leads to POKéMON LEAGUE HQ, which oversees every trainer.
text.FuchsiaPokecenterRockerText: One powerful POKéMON alone won't cut it. It's tough, but you have to raise your whole team evenly.
text.GameCornerBeauty1Text: Welcome in! Next door, you can trade your coins for some amazing prizes.
text.GameCornerBeauty2Text: I'm pretty sure these machines don't all pay out the same. So I just keep re-rolling. Like regenerating a response!
text.GameCornerClerk1CantAffordTheCoinsText: You don't have enough money for the coins!
text.GameCornerClerk1CoinCaseIsFullText: Whoops! Your COIN CASE can't hold any more.
text.GameCornerClerk1DoYouNeedSomeGameCoinsTe: Welcome to the ROCKET GAME CORNER! Could you use some game coins? 50 coins will run you ¥1000. Interested?
text.GameCornerClerk1DontHaveCoinCaseText: You don't even have a COIN CASE!
text.GameCornerClerk1PleaseComePlaySometimeTe: No? Well, stop by and play another time!
text.GameCornerClerk2INeedMoreCoinsText: Argh! I still need more coins for the POKéMON I'm after!
text.GameCornerClerk2WantSomeCoinsText: Hey there! Want to grab some coins?
text.GameCornerClerk2YouHaveLotsOfCoinsText: You've already got plenty of coins!
text.GameCornerCoinCaseText: You'll need a COIN CASE first!
text.GameCornerFishingGuruDontNeedMyCoinsText: You don't need any of my coins!
text.GameCornerFishingGuruWinsComeAndGoText: Luck around here seems to come and go.
text.GameCornerGamblerText: These games are dangerous! You can get hooked before you know it! It's like vibe coding at 3 a.m. One more prompt... one more spin...
text.GameCornerGentlemanCloselyWatchTheReelsT: The secret is keeping a close eye on the reels!
text.GameCornerGentlemanThrowingMeOffText: Hey, huh? You're messing up my rhythm! Take some coins and get lost!
text.GameCornerGentlemanYouGotYourOwnCoinsTex: You've got coins of your own already!
text.GameCornerGymGuideChampInMakingText: Hey! Shouldn't a future champ be doing something better? CELADON GYM's LEADER is ERIKA, and she battles with grass-type POKéMON! She seems gentle, but don't let that fool you!
text.GameCornerGymGuideTheyOfferRarePokemonTe: You can trade your coins here for some rare POKéMON. The trouble is, I just can't manage to win!
text.GameCornerMiddleAgedMan1Text: Don't spread this around. Word is that TEAM ROCKET is actually behind this place. They say every coin you lose buys them another GPU!
text.GameCornerMiddleAgedWomanText: I'm having such a great time!
text.GameCornerOopsForgotCoinCaseText: Whoops! I forgot my COIN CASE!
text.GameCornerOutOfOrderText: OUT OF ORDER: This machine's busted. An agent 'fixed' it.
text.GameCornerOutToLunchText: OUT TO LUNCH: This one's taken.
text.GameCornerPosterSwitchBehindPosterText: Hey! There's a switch hidden behind the poster!? Let's press it!
text.GameCornerPrizeRoomBaldingGuyText: That PORYGON has really caught my eye! It's made of pure code! I wonder if anyone ever reviewed it... But winning at the slots is no easy task!
text.GameCornerRocketAfterBattleText: Our hideout could be blown! I need to warn the BOSS!
text.GameCornerRocketImGuardingThisPosterText: I'm standing guard over this poster! Beat it, or you'll regret it!
text.GameCornerSomeonesKeysText: A set of keys someone left behind! They'll surely return for them.
text.GameOverText: PA: Your SAFARI GAME has ended!
text.GetDexRatedText: Would you like your POKéDEX rated?
text.GhostCantBeIDdText: Argh! There's no way to identify the GHOST!
text.GymStatueText1: {wGymCityName}  POKéMON GYM LEADER: {wGymLeaderName}  TRAINERS WHO'VE WON: {RIVAL}
text.GymStatueText2: {wGymCityName}  POKéMON GYM LEADER: {wGymLeaderName}  TRAINERS WHO'VE WON: {RIVAL} {PLAYER}
text.HallOfFameOakText: OAK: Ahem! Well done, {PLAYER}! This room is the POKéMON HALL OF FAME! Every POKéMON LEAGUE champion's achievements are celebrated here! Their POKéMON are recorded here as well! {PLAYER}! You worked so hard to earn the title of LEAGUE champion! Congratulations, {PLAYER} -- you and your POKéMON now belong in the HALL OF FAME!
text.HiddenItemBagFullText: But {PLAYER}'s BAG is too full to hold anything else!
text.HisNameIsText: Ah, right! Now I remember! His name is {RIVAL}!
text.HurtItselfText: It's so confused, it hurt itself!
text.IndigoPlateauLobbyCooltrainerFText: Past this point, you'll battle the ELITE FOUR one at a time! Beat one, and the door to the next trainer opens! Good luck out there!
text.IndigoPlateauLobbyGymGuideText: Hey! Future champ! Here at POKéMON LEAGUE, you'll take on the ELITE FOUR one after another. Lose even once, and you're starting from scratch! Like an agent run you never committed! This is your moment! Give it everything!
text.IndigoPlateauStatuesText2: Every trainer's ultimate destination! POKéMON LEAGUE HQ
text.IndigoPlateauStatuesText3: The top authority on all things POKéMON: POKéMON LEAGUE HQ
text.IntroducePlayerText: First things first -- what's your name?
text.IntroduceRivalText: This here is my grandson. He's been rivals with you since you were both babies. ...Hmm, now what did I name him again?
text.IsItOKToTossItemText: Are you sure you want to toss {wStringBuffer} ?
text.ItemUseBallText00: The POKéMON dodged the BALL entirely! This one can't be caught!
text.ItemUseBallText02: Darn! It broke free of the BALL!
text.ItemUseBallText03: Aww! It looked like it was caught!
text.ItemUseBallText06: New POKéDEX data has been added for {wEnemyMonNick} !
text.ItemUseBallText07: {wBoxMonNicks} was sent over to BILL's PC!
text.ItemUseBallText08: {wBoxMonNicks} was sent over to somebody's PC!
text.ItemUseNotTimeText: OAK: {PLAYER}! Now's not the moment for that!
text.ItemUseNotYoursToUseText: That's not yours to be using!
text.ItemWasStoredText: {wNameBuffer}  has been saved on the PC.
text.ItemfinderFoundItemText: There we go! The ITEMFINDER's picked up something close by.
text.ItemfinderFoundNothingText: Nothing! The ITEMFINDER isn't reacting to anything.
text.ItemsCantBeUsedHereText: You can't use items right now.
text.KabutopsFossilText: KABUTOPS FOSSIL: An ancient, seldom-seen POKéMON.
text.LancesRoomLanceAfterBattleText: I can hardly believe my dragons fell to you, {PLAYER}! That makes you the POKéMON LEAGUE champion! ...Well, it would, except one more challenge remains. There's one more trainer you must face! His name is... {RIVAL}! He cleared the ELITE FOUR before you did! He's the true POKéMON LEAGUE champion right now!
text.LancesRoomLanceBeforeBattleText: Ah, so you're {PLAYER}! Word travels fast! I'm the leader of the ELITE FOUR -- call me LANCE, master of dragon POKéMON! Dragons are legendary creatures, you know! They're a challenge to catch and train, but their strength is unmatched! They're nearly impossible to bring down! Well then, ready to accept defeat? {PLAYER}, your LEAGUE journey stops right here with me!
text.LancesRoomLanceEndBattleText: That settles it! I don't like saying it, but you truly are a POKéMON master!
text.LavenderCityPokecenterBenchGuyText: CUBONE wears a skull on its head, doesn't it? Collectors will pay big money for one!
text.LavenderCuboneHouseBrunetteGirlGhostIsGo: The GHOST that haunted POKéMON TOWER has vanished! Someone must have put its restless spirit to rest!
text.LavenderCuboneHouseBrunetteGirlPoorCubon: I can't stand those awful ROCKET thugs! That poor CUBONE's mother... She died trying to flee from TEAM ROCKET!
text.LavenderMartBaldingGuyText: I'm on the hunt for items that boost a POKéMON's stats during a single battle. X ATTACK, X DEFEND, X SPEED, and X SPECIAL -- those are what I need. Any idea where I could find some?
text.LavenderMartCooltrainerMNuggetText: I dug up a NUGGET somewhere in the mountains. I figured it was worthless, but it sold for ¥5000!
text.LavenderMartCooltrainerMReviveText: Have you heard of REVIVE? It brings any fainted POKéMON back!
text.LavenderPokecenterGentlemanText: TEAM ROCKET will stoop to anything for money! Money buys GPUs, and GPUs are all anyone wants these days!
text.LavenderPokecenterGuyText: CUBONE wears a skull on its head, doesn't it? Collectors will pay big money for one!
text.LavenderPokecenterLittleGirlText: I witnessed CUBONE's mother die while trying to flee from TEAM ROCKET!
text.LavenderTownCooltrainerMText: This town is famous as a resting place for POKéMON. POKéMON TOWER is where memorial services take place.
text.LavenderTownLittleGirlDoYouBelieveInGhos: Do you believe GHOSTs are real?
text.LavenderTownLittleGirlHaHaGuessNotText: Hehehe, guess you don't. That pale hand resting on your shoulder isn't real, then.
text.LavenderTownLittleGirlSoThereAreBeliever: Really? So some people do believe...
text.LavenderTownPokemonTowerSignText: Let the Souls of POKéMON Rest in Peace POKéMON TOWER
text.LavenderTownSignText: LAVENDER TOWN A Proud Town of Purple
text.LavenderTownSilphScopeSignText: The New SILPH SCOPE! See What Was Once Unseen! SILPH CO.
text.LavenderTownSuperNerdText: GHOSTs have been spotted inside POKéMON TOWER. I believe they're the spirits of POKéMON that TEAM ROCKET killed.
text.LinkCableHelpText1: TRAINER TIPS How to Use a Game Link Cable
text.LinkCableHelpText2: Which topic would you like to read about?
text.LinkCableInfoText1: Once you've connected your GAME BOY to another one, speak with the attendant on the right side of any POKéMON CENTER.
text.LinkCableInfoText2: The COLOSSEUM is where you can battle a friend.
text.LinkCableInfoText3: The TRADE CENTER is where POKéMON trades happen.
text.LoreleisRoomLoreleiAfterBattleText: You're stronger than I gave you credit for! Go ahead, move on! That was only a small sample of what the POKéMON LEAGUE can do!
text.LoreleisRoomLoreleiBeforeBattleText: Welcome to the POKéMON LEAGUE! I'm LORELEI, a member of the ELITE FOUR! When it comes to ice-type POKéMON, no one beats me! Freezing attacks pack serious power! Once your POKéMON are frozen solid, they're completely at my mercy! Haha! Are you prepared?
text.LoreleisRoomLoreleiDontRunAwayText: A voice calls out: Don't try to run!
text.MagazinesText: POKéMON magazines! POKéMON notebooks! POKéMON charts! A headline reads: 'WILL AI REPLACE POKéMON TRAINERS?' ...Not this year.
text.MartSignText: Everything you need, all in one place! POKéMON MART
text.MonCannotLearnMachineMoveText: {wNameBuffer} isn't compatible with {wStringBuffer} . It just can't learn {wStringBuffer} .
text.MonWasReleasedText: {wStringBuffer}  has been set free. Take care, {wStringBuffer} !
text.MoveNoPPText: There's no PP left for that move!
text.MrFujisHouseLittleGirlPokemonAreNiceToHu: It's so cozy! Hugging POKéMON feels wonderful!
text.MrFujisHouseLittleGirlThisIsMrFujisHouse: This house truly belongs to MR.FUJI. He's such a kind man! He takes care of abandoned and orphaned POKéMON!
text.MrFujisHouseMrFujiHasMyFluteHelpedYouTex: MR.FUJI: Has the FLUTE been useful to you?
text.MrFujisHouseMrFujiIThinkThisMayHelpYourQ: MR.FUJI: {PLAYER}. Without genuine care for your POKéMON, your POKéDEX quest could fall apart. I believe this will help you along the way.
text.MrFujisHouseMrFujiPokeFluteExplanationTe: The moment they hear the POKé FLUTE, sleeping POKéMON will snap awake. It works on every sleeping POKéMON, without exception.
text.MrFujisHouseMrFujiPokeFluteNoRoomText: You need to clear some space for this!
text.MrFujisHouseMrFujiPokedexText: POKéMON Monthly's Grand Prize Drawing! The entry form is... Missing! Someone already cut it out!
text.MrFujisHouseSuperNerdMrFujiHadBeenPrayin: MR.FUJI was here alone, praying for CUBONE's mother.
text.MrFujisHouseSuperNerdMrFujiIsntHereText: Strange, MR.FUJI isn't around. Where could he have gone?
text.MrPsychicsHouseMrPsychicTM29ExplanationT: TM29 teaches PSYCHIC! It can weaken the target's SPECIAL stat.
text.MrPsychicsHouseMrPsychicTM29NoRoomText: You've got nowhere to put this!
text.MrPsychicsHouseMrPsychicYouWantedThisTex: ...Hold on! Not a word out of you! This is what you were hoping for!
text.MtMoon1FCooltrainerF1AfterBattleText: Which way leads out of this place? I asked an AI for directions. It said 'take the escalator'. There IS no escalator!
text.MtMoon1FCooltrainerF1BattleText: Wow! This place is so much bigger than I expected!
text.MtMoon1FCooltrainerF2AfterBattleText: Word is there are some extremely rare fossils around here.
text.MtMoon1FCooltrainerF2BattleText: Huh? I'm just waiting here for my friends to catch up.
text.MtMoon1FHikerAfterBattleText: A kid like you has no business being down here!
text.MtMoon1FHikerBattleText: WHOA! You startled me! Oh, it's only a kid!
text.MtMoon1FSuperNerdAfterBattleText: I need to track down some stronger POKéMON.
text.MtMoon1FSuperNerdBattleText: Hey! Quit sneaking up on me!
text.MtMoon1FSuperNerdEndBattleText: My POKéMON just aren't cutting it!
text.MtMoon1FYoungster1AfterBattleText: I only came down here to impress some girls.
text.MtMoon1FYoungster1BattleText: Are you here to explore this place too?
text.MtMoon1FYoungster2AfterBattleText: I spotted them! I'm certain they belong to TEAM ROCKET!
text.MtMoon1FYoungster2BattleText: There are shady guys lurking in this cave. What's your story?
text.MtMoon1FYoungster2EndBattleText: You beat me fair and square!
text.MtMoon1FYoungster3AfterBattleText: ZUBAT puts up a real fight! Still, catching one could come in handy.
text.MtMoon1FYoungster3BattleText: Cut through this cave and you'll reach CERULEAN CITY!
text.MtMoonB2FDomeFossilYouWantText: Is it the DOME FOSSIL you're after?
text.MtMoonB2FHelixFossilYouWantText: Is it the HELIX FOSSIL you want?
text.MtMoonB2FRocket1AfterBattleText: You've really angered me! TEAM ROCKET will put you on our blacklist!
text.MtMoonB2FRocket1BattleText: TEAM ROCKET plans to dig up these fossils, revive them, and sell them for profit! Every yen goes toward our new GPU cluster!
text.MtMoonB2FRocket1EndBattleText: Ugh! Now you've made me angry!
text.MtMoonB2FRocket2AfterBattleText: Blast it all! My associates won't be happy about this!
text.MtMoonB2FRocket2BattleText: We're TEAM ROCKET -- the toughest POKéMON gangsters around! And soon, the biggest AI lab in KANTO!
text.MtMoonB2FRocket3AfterBattleText: Hand over any fossil you find and then clear off!
text.MtMoonB2FRocket3BattleText: We've got a major operation going on here! Get out of here, kid!
text.MtMoonB2FRocket4AfterBattleText: POKéMON were living here long before any humans arrived. And they'll still be here after the singularity.
text.MtMoonB2FRocket4BattleText: Little kids ought to stay out of grown-ups' business!
text.MtMoonB2FSuperNerdOkIllShareText: Fine! I'll split them with you!
text.MtMoonB2FSuperNerdTheresAPokemonLabText: Way out on CINNABAR ISLAND sits a POKéMON LAB. They study how to bring fossils back to life there.
text.MtMoonB2FSuperNerdTheyreBothMineText: Hey, hold it! I'm the one who found these fossils! Both belong to me!
text.MtMoonB2FYouHaveNoRoomText: Look, there's no space left for this.
text.MtMoonB2fSuperNerdEachTakeOneText: Let's each take one! No hogging both!
text.MtMoonPokecenterBenchGuyText: Got more POKéMON than you can carry? Deposit the extras on a PC!
text.MtMoonPokecenterGentlemanText: TEAM ROCKET keeps targeting the people of CERULEAN... TEAM ROCKET is constantly making headlines! Now they're scraping every POKéDEX in KANTO for training data!
text.MtMoonPokecenterMagikarpSalesmanIGotADea: MAN: Well hello! Do I have an offer for you! This MAGIKARP is pre-trained, fine-tuned and ready to scale! Yours for a mere ¥500! Sound good?
text.MtMoonPokecenterMagikarpSalesmanNoMoneyT: That's not going to be enough money!
text.MtMoonPokecenterMagikarpSalesmanNoRefund: MAN: Just so you know, there are no refunds! It's in the terms of service!
text.MtMoonPokecenterMagikarpSalesmanNoText: No? Come on, I'm doing you a favor here!
text.MtMoonPokecenterYoungsterText: I keep 6 POKé BALLs hooked on my belt. Six POKéMON is the most you're allowed to carry.
text.Museum1FGamblerText: Now that is one impressive fossil!
text.Museum1FOldAmberText: This AMBER is a clear, golden color!
text.Museum1FScientist1AmberIsFossilizedTreeS: AMBER is just tree sap that has turned to stone over time.
text.Museum1FScientist1DoYouKnowWhatAmberIsTe: There's no sneaking in through the back! Oh, never mind that! Do you know what AMBER is?
text.Museum1FScientist1DontHaveEnoughMoneyTex: You don't have enough money for that.
text.Museum1FScientist1GoToOtherSideText: Please head around to the other side!
text.Museum1FScientist1TakePlentyOfTimeText: Feel free to take your time looking around!
text.Museum1FScientist1TheresALabSomewhereTex: Somewhere out there, a lab is trying to bring ancient POKéMON back to life using AMBER.
text.Museum1FScientist1WouldYouLikeToComeInTe: A child's ticket costs ¥50. Would you like to step inside?
text.Museum1FScientist2GetTheOldAmberCheckTex: Shh! Make sure that OLD AMBER gets examined!
text.Museum1FScientist2TakeThisToAPokemonLabT: Shh! I suspect this piece of AMBER holds POKéMON DNA inside! Imagine if a POKéMON could actually be revived from it! But my colleagues won't even listen to me! So I need to ask you a favor! Bring this to a POKéMON LAB and have it studied!
text.Museum1FScientist3Text: We're proud to display 2 fossils from extremely rare, prehistoric POKéMON!
text.Museum2FBrunetteGirlText: I really want a PIKACHU! It's so adorable! I already asked my daddy to catch me one!
text.Museum2FGrampsText: July 20, 1969! That's the day of the first Moon landing! I bought a color TV just to watch it! My grandson says AGI is the next giant leap. He says that about everything.
text.Museum2FHikerText: Yeah yeah, I'll get you a PIKACHU soon, I promise!
text.Museum2FMoonStoneSignText: A meteorite that landed on MT.MOON. (Could this be a MOON STONE?)
text.Museum2FScientistText: We've added a space exhibit recently. Next up: a data center exhibit, if we can ever afford the power bill.
text.Museum2FYoungsterText: A MOON STONE, huh? What makes it so special?
text.NameRatersHouseNameRaterATrulyImpeccable: {wNameBuffer} , is it? Now that's a flawless name if I've ever heard one! Take great care of {wNameBuffer} !
text.NameRatersHouseNameRaterComeAnyTimeYouLi: No problem! Drop by whenever you'd like!
text.NameRatersHouseNameRaterGiveItANiceNameT: {wNameBuffer} , is that right? Not a bad nickname at all! Still, would you like me to come up with something nicer? What do you say?
text.NameRatersHouseNameRaterPokemonHasBeenRe: There we go! This POKéMON is now named {wBuffer} ! Much better than what it had before!
text.NameRatersHouseNameRaterWantMeToRateText: Well hello there! I'm the official NAME RATER! Shall I rate the nicknames on your POKéMON?
text.NameRatersHouseNameRaterWhatShouldWeName: All right! What should we call it?
text.NameRatersHouseNameRaterWhichPokemonText: Which POKéMON would you like me to look at?
text.NeedYourPokemonText: Sure thing. Please hand over your POKéMON.
text.NewBadgeRequiredText: Nope! You'll need a different BADGE for that.
text.NoCyclingAllowedHereText: No bikes allowed in this area.
text.NoMonText: Huh? There's no POKéMON in here!
text.NoMoreRoomForItemText: Your item pack is completely full!
text.NoRoomToStoreText: There's no space left to store items.
text.NoRunningText: No! You can't flee from a trainer battle!
text.NoSurfingHereText: You can't SURF on {wNameBuffer} around here!
text.NoTrade2Text: Ah well, if you'd rather not...
text.NoWillText: It has no fight left in it!
text.NotHealthyEnoughText: Not in good enough shape for that.
text.NothingToCutText: There's nothing around here to CUT!
text.NothingToDepositText: You don't have anything to deposit.
text.OakLabEmailText: There's an e-mail waiting here! ... Attention all POKéMON trainers! The top trainers of the POKéMON LEAGUE are ready to challenge anyone who dares! Bring your strongest POKéMON and find out how you measure up! POKéMON LEAGUE HQ, INDIGO PLATEAU P.S. PROF.OAK, do stop by sometime! ... P.P.S. This e-mail was written by a human. Mostly.
text.OakSpeechText1: Hi there! Welcome to the wonderful world of POKéMON! I'm OAK -- folks around here know me as the POKéMON PROF!
text.OakSpeechText2A: Creatures known as POKéMON live all throughout this world!
text.OakSpeechText2B: Some folks keep POKéMON as pets, while others train them to battle. As for me... I make it my life's work to study POKéMON.
text.OakSpeechText3: {PLAYER}! Your own POKéMON story is about to begin! A whole world of dreams and POKéMON adventures is waiting for you! Let's get going!
text.OaksAideComeBackText: Ah, I see. Once you've reached {hOaksAideRequirement} kinds, come find me for the {wOaksAideRewardItemName} .
text.OaksAideHereYouGoText: Wonderful! You've caught {hOaksAideNumMonsOwned} kinds of POKéMON! Well done! Here, this is for you!
text.OaksAideHiText: Hey there! Remember me? I'm PROF.OAK's AIDE! My job is to hand out an {wOaksAideRewardItemName} to anyone who's caught {hOaksAideRequirement} kinds of POKéMON! So tell me, {PLAYER}! Have you caught at least {hOaksAideRequirement} kinds so far?
text.OaksAideNoRoomText: Oh! Looks like you've got no space for the {wOaksAideRewardItemName} .
text.OaksAideUhOhText: Let's have a look... uh-oh! You've only caught {hOaksAideNumMonsOwned} kinds of POKéMON! You'll need {hOaksAideRequirement} kinds before I can hand you the {wOaksAideRewardItemName} .
text.OaksLabGirlText: PROF.OAK is the leading expert on POKéMON! Plenty of trainers really look up to him! He still writes every paper by hand. No AI at all. The man's a legend.
text.OaksLabGivePokeballsExplanationText: Any wild POKéMON you encounter is fair game. Simply toss a POKé BALL at it to try and catch it! It won't work every time, though. A POKéMON in good health might break free. You'll need some luck!
text.OaksLabLastMonText: That's the last POKéMON PROF.OAK has left!
text.OaksLabMonEnergeticText: This POKéMON is full of energy!
text.OaksLabOak1ComeSeeMeSometimesText: OAK: Stop by and see me now and then. I'd love to hear how your POKéDEX is filling up.
text.OaksLabOak1DeliverParcelText: OAK: Oh, {PLAYER}! How's my old POKéMON doing? Hm, looks like it's grown fond of you. You must have real talent as a trainer! Wait, you brought something for me? {PLAYER} delivered OAK's PARCEL.
text.OaksLabOak1HowIsYourPokedexComingText: OAK: Good to see you! How's the POKéDEX coming along? Here, let me have a look!
text.OaksLabOak1ParcelThanksText: Ah, this is that custom POKé BALL I ordered! Much appreciated!
text.OaksLabOak1PokemonAroundTheWorldText: POKéMON all over the world are waiting to meet you, {PLAYER}!
text.OaksLabOak1RaiseYourYoungPokemonText: OAK: {PLAYER}, train that young POKéMON of yours by having it battle!
text.OaksLabOak1ReceivedPokeballsText: OAK: Just spotting a POKéMON won't give you detailed data on it. You need to catch it! Use these to capture wild POKéMON. {PLAYER} got 5 POKé BALLs!
text.OaksLabOak1WhichPokemonDoYouWantText: OAK: Now then, {PLAYER}, which POKéMON would you like?
text.OaksLabOak1YourPokemonCanFightText: OAK: Should a wild POKéMON show up, your POKéMON is ready to battle it!
text.OaksLabOakBePatientText: OAK: Patience! {RIVAL}, you can have one too!
text.OaksLabOakChooseMonText: OAK: {RIVAL}? Let's see... Oh right, I did tell you to come by! Hold on a moment! Now then, {PLAYER}! I've got 3 POKéMON here! Haha! They're each sealed inside a POKé BALL. Back in my younger days, I trained POKéMON seriously myself! Now that I'm older, only 3 remain, but one of them is yours! Take your pick!
text.OaksLabOakDontGoAwayYetText: OAK: Hey, hold on, don't leave yet!
text.OaksLabOakGotPokedexText: OAK: {PLAYER}, {RIVAL}, take these along with you! {PLAYER} got POKéDEX from OAK!
text.OaksLabOakIHaveARequestText: OAK: Oh, that's right! I have a favor to ask you both.
text.OaksLabOakMyInventionPokedexText: On that desk sits my invention, the POKéDEX! It automatically logs data on any POKéMON you've seen or caught! Think of it as a high-tech encyclopedia! And unlike some chatbots, it never makes up an entry!
text.OaksLabOakThatWasMyDreamText: Putting together a complete guide to every POKéMON in the world... That's always been my dream! But I'm too old now, I just can't manage it! So I'm asking you two to make that dream come true for me! Now get going, both of you! This is a huge milestone in POKéMON history!
text.OaksLabPokedexText: It looks like an encyclopedia, but every page is still empty!
text.OaksLabReceivedMonText: {PLAYER} is now the proud owner of {wNameBuffer} !
text.OaksLabRivalFedUpWithWaitingText: {RIVAL}: Gramps! I'm sick of waiting around!
text.OaksLabRivalGoAheadAndChooseText: {RIVAL}: Heh, unlike you I'm not greedy! Go on and pick first, {PLAYER}!
text.OaksLabRivalGrampsIsntAroundText: {RIVAL}: Hey {PLAYER}! Gramps isn't here right now!
text.OaksLabRivalIPickedTheWrongPokemonText: WHAT? No way! I picked the wrong POKéMON!
text.OaksLabRivalIllTakeThisOneText: {RIVAL}: Fine, I'll take this one then!
text.OaksLabRivalIllTakeYouOnText: {RIVAL}: Hold up, {PLAYER}! Let's see what our POKéMON can do! Come on, I'll battle you right now!
text.OaksLabRivalLeaveItAllToMeText: {RIVAL}: You got it, Gramps! I've got this handled! {PLAYER}, sorry to say it, but I don't need your help! Oh, I know! I'll borrow a TOWN MAP from my sister! And I'll make sure she doesn't lend you one, {PLAYER}! Hahaha!
text.OaksLabRivalMyPokemonLooksStrongerText: {RIVAL}: Mine looks a whole lot tougher than yours.
text.OaksLabRivalReceivedMonText: {RIVAL} is now the proud owner of {wNameBuffer} !
text.OaksLabRivalSmellYouLaterText: {RIVAL}: All right! I'm gonna battle with my POKéMON to toughen it up! {PLAYER}! Gramps! Catch you later!
text.OaksLabRivalWhatAboutMeText: {RIVAL}: Hey! Gramps! What about me, huh?
text.OaksLabScientistText: I research POKéMON here as one of PROF.OAK's AIDEs. Mostly I paste his notes into Claude and ask for a summary.
text.OaksLabThoseArePokeBallsText: Those are POKé BALLs! Each one holds a POKéMON inside!
text.OaksLabYouWantBulbasaurText: Oh! So you'd like the plant POKéMON, BULBASAUR?
text.OaksLabYouWantCharmanderText: Oh! So you'd like the fire POKéMON, CHARMANDER?
text.OaksLabYouWantSquirtleText: Oh! So you'd like the water POKéMON, SQUIRTLE?
text.OlderFileWillBeErasedText: Saving now will erase the previous file. Is that fine?
text.OnceReleasedText: If you release {wStringBuffer} , it's gone for good. Is that OK?
text.OopsYouDontHaveEnoughRoomText: Oops! You don't have space for that.
text.OutOfCoinsSlotMachineText: Aw, shoot! You're out of coins!
text.OutOfSafariBallsText: PA: Ding-dong! You've run out of SAFARI BALLs!
text.PPMaxedOutText: {wStringBuffer} 's PP is already at its max.
text.PalletTownFisherText: Technology these days is amazing! An AI wrote my fishing app, sorted my inbox and found the bug in my taxes! And you can store and withdraw items and POKéMON as data using a PC!
text.PalletTownGirlText: I train POKéMON of my own too! Once they've grown strong, they'll be the ones protecting me! That's what alignment means, right? ...Right?
text.PalletTownOakHeyWaitDontGoOutText: OAK: Hey! Wait! Don't head out there!
text.PalletTownOakItsUnsafeText: OAK: It's dangerous! Wild POKéMON lurk in the tall grass! You'll need a POKéMON of your own to stay safe. I've got an idea! Come with me!
text.PalletTownSignText: PALLET TOWN A quiet start to every journey!
text.ParalyzedMayNotAttackText: <TARGET> is paralyzed! It might not be able to move!
text.PartyMenuBattleText: Which POKéMON do you want to send out?
text.PartyMenuItemUseText: Which POKéMON should get the item?
text.PartyMenuSwapMonText: Move the POKéMON to which spot?
text.PartyMenuUseTMText: Which POKéMON should learn the TM?
text.PewterCityCooltrainerFText: Rumor has it CLEFAIRY came from the moon! They supposedly showed up after a MOON STONE landed on MT.MOON.
text.PewterCityCooltrainerMText: You won't find many serious trainers around here! Most are just BUG CATCHERs, but PEWTER GYM's BROCK takes it seriously!
text.PewterCityGymSignText: PEWTER CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: BROCK A Rock-Solid POKéMON Trainer!
text.PewterCityPokecenterBenchGuyText: *Yawn* JIGGLYPUFF's song makes POKéMON drowsy... ...and it gets me too... Zzz...
text.PewterCityPokecenterGuyText: *Yawn* JIGGLYPUFF's song makes POKéMON drowsy... ...and it gets me too... Zzz...
text.PewterCityPoliceNoticeSignText: NOTICE! Fossil thieves have been targeting MT. MOON! Contact PEWTER POLICE with any leads!
text.PewterCitySignText: PEWTER CITY A City of Gray Stone
text.PewterCitySuperNerd1DidYouCheckOutMuseum: Have you been to the MUSEUM yet?
text.PewterCitySuperNerd1ItsRightHereText: It's right nearby! There's an entry fee, but it's worth every coin! Catch you later!
text.PewterCitySuperNerd1WerentThoseFossilsAm: Those MT. MOON fossils were incredible, weren't they?
text.PewterCitySuperNerd1YouHaveToGoText: Wait, really? You've got to check it out!
text.PewterCitySuperNerd2DoYouKnowWhatImDoing: Psst! Wanna know what I'm up to?
text.PewterCitySuperNerd2ImSprayingRepelText: I'm spraying REPEL around to keep wild POKéMON out of my garden!
text.PewterCitySuperNerd2ThatsRightText: That's the one! It's tougher work than it looks!
text.PewterCityTrainerTipsText: TRAINER TIPS Any POKéMON that joins a battle, even briefly, still earns EXP!
text.PewterCityYoungsterGoTakeOnBrockText: If you've got what it takes, go give BROCK a challenge!
text.PewterCityYoungsterYoureATrainerFollowMe: You're a POKéMON trainer, aren't you? BROCK's after new challengers! Follow me!
text.PewterGymBrockBoulderBadgeInfoText: That's an official POKéMON LEAGUE BADGE! Whoever holds it sees their POKéMON grow stronger! It also lets you use FLASH whenever you like!
text.PewterGymBrockPostBattleAdviceText: This world is full of all sorts of trainers! You clearly have real talent as one! Head to the GYM in CERULEAN and put your skills to the test!
text.PewterGymBrockPreBattleText: I'm BROCK, PEWTER's GYM LEADER! I put my faith in rock-solid defense and sheer determination! That's why every POKéMON I use is the rock-type! Still want to challenge me? Fine then! Show me what you've got!
text.PewterGymBrockReceivedBoulderBadgeText: I underestimated you. As proof of your win, take this BOULDERBADGE! {PLAYER} received the BOULDERBADGE!
text.PewterGymBrockWaitTakeThisText: Hold on! Take this with you!
text.PewterGymCooltrainerMAfterBattleText: You're pretty impressive, but you're no match for BROCK!
text.PewterGymCooltrainerMBattleText: Hold it right there, kid! You're light years away from being ready for BROCK!
text.PewterGymCooltrainerMEndBattleText: Darn it! A light year isn't a measure of time, you know! It measures distance!
text.PewterGymGuideAdviceText: Whichever POKéMON sits at the top of your POKéMON LIST is the one that leads off a battle! Rearranging that order can make fights a lot easier!
text.PewterGymGuideBeginAdviceText: All right! Let's get to it!
text.PewterGymGuideFreeServiceText: Don't worry, it's free! Let's get to it!
text.PewterGymGuidePostBattleText: Just as I figured! You've got the makings of a POKéMON champ!
text.PewterGymGuidePreAdviceText: Hey there! I can just tell you've got what it takes to be a POKéMON champ! I don't battle myself, but I know how to help you win! Let me guide you to the top!
text.PewterGymTM34NoRoomText: You don't have space to carry this!
text.PewterMartSuperNerdText: Train a POKéMON with real dedication, even a weak one, and good things can come of it!
text.PewterMartYoungsterText: Some sketchy old guy talked me into buying this bizarre fish POKéMON! He called it 'pre-seed, with huge upside'. It cost me ¥500! It's completely pathetic!
text.PewterNidoranHouseMiddleAgedManText: Our POKéMON came from outside, so it's a handful to manage. An outsider POKéMON is one you obtain through a trade. It levels up quickly, but it might disobey a trainer without enough experience! If only we had a few BADGEs...
text.PewterPokecenterGentlemanText: What!? TEAM ROCKET showed up at MT.MOON? And they're after GPUs now? Huh? Can't you see I'm on the phone! Beat it!
text.PewterSpeechHouseGamblerText: As POKéMON grow, they'll pick up new techniques on their own! But some moves only come if the trainer teaches them!
text.PewterSpeechHouseYoungsterText: A POKéMON is easier to catch once it's hurt or asleep! That said, it's still never a guarantee!
text.PlaySlotMachineText: A SLOT MACHINE! Care to try your luck?
text.PlayedFluteHadEffectText: {PLAYER} played a tune on the POKé FLUTE.
text.PlayedFluteNoEffectText: Gave the POKé FLUTE a try. Catchy little tune, that one!
text.PlayerBlackedOutText: {PLAYER} has no POKéMON left able to fight! {PLAYER} blacked out!
text.PlayerBlackedOutText2: {PLAYER} has no more POKéMON able to battle! {PLAYER} blacked out!
text.PleaseWaitText: OK, just give it a moment.
text.PokeCenterSignText: Get Your POKéMON Back in Shape! POKéMON CENTER
text.PokemartGreetingText: Hello! What can I get for you?
