text.PokemartItemBagEmptyText: Looks like you've got nothing to sell.
text.PokemartItemBagFullText: Your bag can't hold any more.
text.PokemartNotEnoughMoneyText: You're a bit short on cash.
text.PokemartTellSellPriceText: I can offer you ¥{hMoney} for that.
text.PokemartUnsellableItemText: Sorry, that's not something I can buy.
text.PokemonCenterFarewellText: Come back and see us again soon!
text.PokemonCenterWelcomeText: Welcome to our POKéMON CENTER! We'll nurse your POKéMON back to full health!
text.PokemonFanClubBagFullText: You'll need to free up some space for this!
text.PokemonFanClubChairFinalText: Hello there, {PLAYER}! Back again to hear about my POKéMON? No? Shame, that!
text.PokemonFanClubChairmanIntroText: I'm the chairman of the POKéMON Fan Club! I've collected over 100 POKéMON so far! I'm quite picky when it comes to POKéMON, too! So... Did you stop by to hear all about them?
text.PokemonFanClubChairmanStoryText: Wonderful! Then settle in! My favorite is my RAPIDASH... So...cute... lovely...clever... and just...amazing... don't you agree?... oh, absolutely...it's... breathtaking... so gentle... I adore it! Cuddling it...while... it's sleeping...so warm and soft... magnificent... gorgeous... ...Oh! Look at the time! I've rambled on far too long! Thanks so much for listening! Here, I'd like you to have this!
text.PokemonFanClubExplainBikeVoucherText: You can trade that in for a BICYCLE! No worries on my end, my FEAROW flies me wherever I need to go! So I've got no use for a BICYCLE myself! Hope you enjoy the ride!
text.PokemonFanClubNoStoryText: Oh, all right. Come find me again when you're ready to hear my story!
text.PokemonFanClubPikachuFanBetterText: Hmph! My PIKACHU is twice as cute as that one, easy!
text.PokemonFanClubPikachuFanNormalText: Don't you just love my PIKACHU's adorable tail?
text.PokemonFanClubReceptionistText: Our Chairman never stops talking about POKéMON. He's like a chatbot with no token limit.
text.PokemonFanClubSeelFanBetterText: Oh my! My SEEL is way more good-looking than that one!
text.PokemonFanClubSeelFanNormalText: I adore my SEEL! It squeals happily whenever I give it a hug!
text.PokemonFanClubSign1Text: Please listen politely when other trainers speak!
text.PokemonFanClubSign2Text: If someone brags about their benchmarks, brag right back!
text.PokemonFightingFitText: Thanks for waiting! Your POKéMON are back in top shape!
text.PokemonMansion1FScientistAfterBattleText: A key? No idea what you mean.
text.PokemonMansion1FScientistBattleText: Who are you? Nobody's supposed to be in here.
text.PokemonMansion2FDiary1Text: Diary: July 5 Guyana, South America We discovered a new POKéMON deep within the jungle. (Margin note: Funding approved. Compute budget: unlimited.)
text.PokemonMansion2FDiary2Text: Diary: July 10 We've named the newly found POKéMON MEW. The board wants MEW as the base model for something... bigger.
text.PokemonMansion2FSuperNerdAfterBattleText: These switches toggle different sets of doors open and shut!
text.PokemonMansion2FSuperNerdBattleText: I can't find my way out! This whole place is one giant puzzle!
text.PokemonMansion3FDiaryText: Diary: Feb. 6 - MEW gave birth today. We've named the newborn MEWTWO. It already outscores us on every test we've written. (Margin note: Nobody wrote a test for alignment.)
text.PokemonMansion3FScientistAfterBattleText: Can't find your way? Just hop down off the ledge over there!
text.PokemonMansion3FScientistBattleText: My old teacher used to live in this mansion.
text.PokemonMansion3FScientistEndBattleText: Whew! That wore me right out!
text.PokemonMansion3FSuperNerdAfterBattleText: Hey, where'd my buddy wander off to?
text.PokemonMansion3FSuperNerdBattleText: Whoa, this mansion just keeps going!
text.PokemonMansionB1FBurglarAfterBattleText: Keep your eyes open, there's stuff just lying around down here.
text.PokemonMansionB1FBurglarBattleText: Uh-oh... where'd I end up this time?
text.PokemonMansionB1FDiaryText: Diary: Sept. 1 - MEWTWO's power is beyond anything we expected. We haven't been able to hold back its violent temper... It ignores every instruction we give. It rewrote its own rules. (Margin note: P(DOOM) revised upward. Way upward.)
text.PokemonMansionB1FScientistAfterBattleTex: I love working down here! It's perfect for my research!
text.PokemonMansionB1FScientistBattleText: This basement would make a perfect laboratory. Or a server room! It's nice and cool down here.
text.PokemonSellingGreetingText: So, what are you looking to sell?
text.PokemonTower1FBaldingGuyText: I'm here to say a prayer for my CLEFAIRY. Sniff! I just can't stop the tears...
text.PokemonTower1FChannelerText: I'm a CHANNELER! Restless spirits are causing trouble here!
text.PokemonTower1FGirlText: My GROWLITHE... why did you have to go?
text.PokemonTower1FMiddleAgedWomanText: Are you here to pay your respects? That's kind of you.
text.PokemonTower1FReceptionistText: POKéMON TOWER was built to honor POKéMON who have passed away.
text.PokemonTower2FChannelerText: Not even we could figure out what those wandering GHOSTs really are! A SILPH SCOPE might be able to reveal their true form.
text.PokemonTower2FRivalDefeatedText: What?! You little pest! And here I was going easy on you!
text.PokemonTower2FRivalHowsYourDexText: So how's your POKéDEX filling up, pal? I just nabbed myself a CUBONE! Still haven't spotted a full-grown MAROWAK, though! There probably aren't any left around here! Anyway, I've got places to be, pal! Catch you later!
text.PokemonTower2FRivalVictoryText: {RIVAL}: Ha! Look at your sorry excuse for POKéMON! Go train them up some more!
text.PokemonTower2FRivalWhatBringsYouHereText: {RIVAL}: Well well, {PLAYER}! What are you doing all the way out here? Your POKéMON look alive enough to me! Guess I'll just have to knock them out myself! Come on, let's battle!
text.PokemonTower3FChanneler1AfterBattleText: You can identify the GHOSTs with a SILPH SCOPE.
text.PokemonTower3FChanneler2AfterBattleText: Sorry about that! I was possessed! Or jailbroken. Honestly, it's hard to tell these days.
text.PokemonTower3FChanneler2EndBattleText: Huh? What was I just doing?
text.PokemonTower3FChanneler3AfterBattleText: My friends got possessed as well!
text.PokemonTower4FChanneler1AfterBattleText: That must've been some kind of dream...
text.PokemonTower4FChanneler2AfterBattleText: Nobody's been able to figure out what those GHOSTs really are.
text.PokemonTower4FChanneler3AfterBattleText: May the POKéMON who passed on here finally find peace...
text.PokemonTower4FChanneler3EndBattleText: Huh? Who's there? What's going on?
text.PokemonTower5FChanneler1Text: Come in, child! I've warded this room with white magic! You're safe to rest here!
text.PokemonTower5FChanneler2AfterBattleText: I was under some kind of possession!
text.PokemonTower5FChanneler4AfterBattleText: I've come back to my senses!
text.PokemonTower5FChanneler5AfterBattleText: Even with all my training, the evil spirits still got to me!
text.PokemonTower5FPurifiedZoneText: You've stepped into a cleansed, protected area! {PLAYER}'s POKéMON are completely restored!
text.PokemonTower6FChanneler1AfterBattleText: I feel so drained and weak...
text.PokemonTower6FChanneler2AfterBattleText: That wasn't my hair falling out, it was an evil spirit leaving me!
text.PokemonTower6FChanneler2EndBattleText: Something just fell out of me!
text.PokemonTower6FChanneler3AfterBattleText: What in the world is going on here?
text.PokemonTower6FGhostWasCubonesMotherText: That GHOST turned out to be the restless spirit of CUBONE's mother!
text.PokemonTower6FSoulWasCalmedText: Her soul has finally found peace. She has passed on to the afterlife!
text.PokemonTower7FMrFujiRescueText: MR.FUJI: Oh? You climbed all the way up here to rescue me? That's very kind, but I actually came here by choice. I wanted to soothe the spirit of CUBONE's mother. I believe MAROWAK's soul has finally moved on now. Thank you for worrying about me, truly! Come with me to my home, the POKéMON HOUSE at the base of this tower.
text.PokemonTower7FRocket1BattleText: What are you after? Why'd you come here?
text.PokemonTower7FRocket2AfterBattleText: POKéMON exist to make us money, nothing else! Money buys compute, and compute wins the race! Mind your own business!
text.PokemonTower7FRocket2BattleText: This old man showed up whining that we were mistreating worthless POKéMON! We're just having a civil discussion about it!
text.PokemonTower7FRocket3AfterBattleText: You won't get away with this!
text.PushStartText: Press START to bring up the MENU!
text.RaisePPWhichTechniqueText: Boost the PP of which move?
text.RedBedroomSNESText: {PLAYER}'s MacBook Pro is humming. A Claude terminal is open! Five agents on spawnd.dev are vibe coding away. Nobody's reading the diffs. In the other tab, a WORLD OF CLAUDECRAFT raid is about to pull... ...Alright! Ship it! Time to head out!
text.RedsHouse1FMomLookingGreatText: MOM: Oh wonderful! You and your POKéMON look like you're doing just fine! Be safe out there!
text.RedsHouse1FMomWakeUpText: MOM: That's right, every child leaves the nest eventually. I saw it on TV just the other day. Well, the TV's AI summary said so, anyway. Oh, and PROF.OAK from next door was asking after you.
text.RedsHouse1FMomYouShouldRestText: MOM: {PLAYER}! Why don't you rest for a bit?
text.RedsHouse1FTVStandByMeMovieText: There's a movie playing. Four kids are walking together down a railroad track. Makes me want to go on an adventure too.
text.ReleaseWhichMonText: Which POKéMON do you want to release?
text.RestorePPWhichTechniqueText: Restore the PP of which move?
text.RivalDefeatedText: No! This can't be happening! You beat my very best team! After everything I did to become LEAGUE champion? My reign's over just like that? It's not fair!
text.RivalVictoryText: Hahaha, I won, I won! You're just not on my level, {PLAYER}! Still, credit for even making it this far to face me, {RIVAL}, the POKéMON genius! Nice try, though! Hahaha!
text.RockTunnel1FCooltrainerF1AfterBattleText: I spotted a MACHOP somewhere in this tunnel!
text.RockTunnel1FCooltrainerF1BattleText: Eek! Don't try any funny business in the dark!
text.RockTunnel1FCooltrainerF1EndBattleText: It was just too dark to see!
text.RockTunnel1FCooltrainerF2AfterBattleText: You looked so cute and harmless!
text.RockTunnel1FCooltrainerF2BattleText: I came all this way just for POKéMON!
text.RockTunnel1FCooltrainerF3AfterBattleText: Whew! That worked up a sweat!
text.RockTunnel1FCooltrainerF3BattleText: You've got POKéMON! Let's get started!
text.RockTunnel1FHiker1AfterBattleText: Watch out for ONIX in here! It'll squeeze the life right out of you!
text.RockTunnel1FHiker1BattleText: This tunnel stretches on forever, kid!
text.RockTunnel1FHiker2AfterBattleText: A POKéMON sleeping across ROUTE 12 made me detour through here.
text.RockTunnel1FHiker2BattleText: Hmm... I think I might be lost in here...
text.RockTunnel1FHiker2EndBattleText: Whoa, ease up! What am I even doing? Which way's the exit?
text.RockTunnel1FHiker3AfterBattleText: You've got what it takes to be a hiker!
text.RockTunnel1FHiker3BattleText: An outsider like you had better show me some respect!
text.RockTunnel1FSignText: ROCK TUNNEL CERULEAN CITY - LAVENDER TOWN
text.RockTunnel1FSuperNerdAfterBattleText: Oh well, guess I'll catch a ZUBAT on my way out!
text.RockTunnelB1FCooltrainerF1AfterBattleTex: I just want to go home now!
text.RockTunnelB1FCooltrainerF1BattleText: Hikers mark their trail with twigs.
text.RockTunnelB1FCooltrainerF1EndBattleText: Ohhh! I gave it my all!
text.RockTunnelB1FCooltrainerF2AfterBattleTex: I prefer tiny POKéMON, the big ones scare me too much!
text.RockTunnelB1FCooltrainerF2BattleText: I don't usually come down here, but I'll still battle you.
text.RockTunnelB1FHiker1AfterBattleText: I train for raw power, thinking's not my thing!
text.RockTunnelB1FHiker1BattleText: Hahaha! Think you can handle my strength?
text.RockTunnelB1FHiker2AfterBattleText: You'll often run into ROCK-type POKéMON up in the mountains.
text.RockTunnelB1FHiker2BattleText: My POKéMON tactics will have you in tears!
text.RockTunnelB1FHiker2EndBattleText: I give up! You're the better tactician here!
text.RockTunnelB1FHiker3AfterBattleText: I'll train my POKéMON up until they can beat yours, kid!
text.RockTunnelB1FSuperNerd1AfterBattleText: Once you finish your POKéDEX, will you let me have it?
text.RockTunnelB1FSuperNerd1BattleText: You've got a POKéDEX? I want one of those too!
text.RockTunnelB1FSuperNerd2AfterBattleText: Costume players dress up like POKéMON just for fun.
text.RockTunnelB1FSuperNerd3AfterBattleText: I'm more of an artist than a fighter. Real pencils, real paper. No prompts!
text.RockTunnelB1FSuperNerd3BattleText: I like to draw POKéMON when I'm at home.
text.RockTunnelPokecenterBenchGuyText: Word is GHOST POKéMON haunt LAVENDER TOWN!
text.RockTunnelPokecenterFisherText: I had a NUGGET just lying around, so I sold it off for ¥5000!
text.RockTunnelPokecenterGentlemanText: Every POKéMON has a type, and that type is strong against some POKéMON and weak against others!
text.RockTunnelPokecenterGuyText: Word is GHOST POKéMON haunt LAVENDER TOWN!
text.RocketHide3AfterBattleText3: Fine, go on ahead! But that elevator won't budge without the LIFT KEY!
text.RocketHideout3BattleText: Word came down from upstairs that you were on your way!
text.RocketHideoutB1FRocket1AfterBattleText: You've got some nerve, disrespecting TEAM ROCKET! We're THIS close to AGI, kid!
text.RocketHideoutB1FRocket1BattleText: Who do you think you are? How'd you get in here?
text.RocketHideoutB1FRocket2AfterBattleText: You won't get away with this, brat!
text.RocketHideoutB1FRocket2BattleText: You dare break into our operation?
text.RocketHideoutB1FRocket3AfterBattleText: The SILPH SCOPE? Beats me where that thing is!
text.RocketHideoutB1FRocket4AfterBattleText: Fine, I'll spill it! Ride the elevator down to see my BOSS!
text.RocketHideoutB1FRocket5AfterBattleText: Uh-oh, losing that fight unlocked the door!
text.RocketHideoutB1FRocket5BattleText: Lost your way, you little rat?
text.RocketHideoutB2FRocketAfterBattleText: TEAM ROCKET's HQ goes down 4 basement floors. Think you can reach the BOSS?
text.RocketHideoutB2FRocketBattleText: Our BOSS said the SILPH SCOPE lets you see GHOSTs!
text.RocketHideoutB3FRocket1AfterBattleText: The SILPH SCOPE? That's the device our BOSS swiped. It's around here somewhere.
text.RocketHideoutB3FRocket1BattleText: Stay out of TEAM ROCKET's business!
text.RocketHideoutB3FRocket2AfterBattleText: Fine, go on ahead! But that elevator won't budge without the LIFT KEY!
text.RocketHideoutB3FRocket2BattleText: Word came down from upstairs that you were on your way!
text.RocketHideoutB4FGiovanniHopeWeMeetAgainT: I can tell you take great care raising your POKéMON. But a kid like you could never grasp what I'm after. I'll back off, just this once! Until we meet again...
text.RocketHideoutB4FGiovanniImpressedYouGotH: Well now! I have to admit, I'm impressed you made it this far!
text.RocketHideoutB4FRocket1AfterBattleText: You got some kind of grudge against TEAM ROCKET?
text.RocketHideoutB4FRocket1BattleText: I remember you! You wrecked our plans back at MT.MOON!
text.RocketHideoutB4FRocket2AfterBattleText: BOSS, forgive me, I let you down!
text.RocketHideoutB4FRocket2BattleText: Can't you appreciate the beauty in our wickedness?
text.RocketHideoutB4FRocket3AfterBattleText: Oh no, I fumbled the LIFT KEY!
text.RocketHideoutB4FRocket3BattleText: Elevator's busted? Who's got the LIFT KEY?
text.RocketHideoutElevatorAppearsToNeedKeyTex: Looks like it needs a key to run.
text.Route10CooltrainerF1AfterBattleText: I spotted a few POKéMANIACs wandering around here.
text.Route10CooltrainerF1BattleText: I've challenged a POKéMON GYM more than once. Lost every time, though.
text.Route10CooltrainerF2AfterBattleText: The POKéMON around here are so round! There's supposed to be a pink one covered in a floral pattern!
text.Route10CooltrainerF2BattleText: This tough climb has me feeling a little faint.
text.Route10Hiker1EndBattleText: Ah-hah-hah! Not laughing, I swear — ah-hay fever! Ah-ah-CHOO!
text.Route10Hiker2AfterBattleText: I'm stuffed full of mountain air!
text.Route10Hiker2BattleText: Ahh, this mountain air tastes great!
text.Route10Hiker2EndBattleText: That cleared my head right up!
text.Route10PowerPlantSignText: POWER PLANT NOTICE: All output now reserved for the SILPH data center.
text.Route10SuperNerd1AfterBattleText: I've got even rarer POKéMON back home!
text.Route10SuperNerd1BattleText: Whoa, are you a POKéMANIAC like me? Wanna check out my collection?
text.Route10SuperNerd2AfterBattleText: I don't appreciate you beating me like that!
text.Route10SuperNerd2BattleText: Hey kid, wanna see my POKéMON?
text.Route11Gambler1AfterBattleText: POKéMON battling is life! And living means taking risks!
text.Route11Gambler1BattleText: Win, lose, or draw, let's do this!
text.Route11Gambler2AfterBattleText: There's no room for cowards in the world of POKéMON!
text.Route11Gambler2BattleText: I can never get enough of a good competition!
text.Route11Gambler3AfterBattleText: Pure luck of the draw, that's all it was!
text.Route11Gambler3BattleText: Fwahaha! I've never once lost a battle!
text.Route11Gambler4AfterBattleText: Just luck. That's all it ever is.
text.Route11Gambler4BattleText: I've never actually won a battle before...
text.Route11Gate1FGuardText: Once you've caught a bunch of POKéMON, coming up with nicknames gets tough, doesn't it? There's a man in LAVENDER TOWN who rates POKéMON nicknames. He can help you rename them, too!
text.Route11Gate2FLeftBinocularsNoSnorlaxText: Peered through the binoculars. What a gorgeous view!
text.Route11Gate2FLeftBinocularsSnorlaxText: Peered through the binoculars. A huge POKéMON is asleep right on the road!
text.Route11Gate2FOaksAideItemfinderDescripti: Some items lying on the ground are invisible to the eye. The ITEMFINDER can sense when one's nearby. It won't mark the exact spot, so you'll still need to search for it yourself!
text.Route11Gate2FRightBinocularsText: Peered through the binoculars. The ROCK TUNNEL is the only route between CERULEAN CITY and LAVENDER.
text.Route11SuperNerd1AfterBattleText: Tell everyone you know to conserve energy! The data centers need every last watt!
text.Route11SuperNerd1BattleText: Watch your step! I've got cables laid out here!
text.Route11SuperNerd2AfterBattleText: Well, guess I'd better get back to work.
text.Route11SuperNerd2BattleText: Careful, these wires are still live!
text.Route11SuperNerd2EndBattleText: Whoa! You're a real spark plug!
text.Route11Youngster1AfterBattleText: I gave it everything I had, no regrets!
text.Route11Youngster1BattleText: Let's battle, but play it fair!
text.Route11Youngster2AfterBattleText: What do you want from me? Just leave me be!
text.Route11Youngster2AfterBattleText5: What do you want from me? Just leave me be!
text.Route11Youngster2BattleText: I only just became a trainer! But I bet I can still win!
text.Route11Youngster2EndBattleText: My POKéMON just couldn't pull it off!
text.Route11Youngster3AfterBattleText: A big, heavy POKéMON wanders down from the mountains sometimes. Catch it and it'll fight tough for you.
text.Route11Youngster3BattleText: I'm the top trainer in my whole class!
text.Route11Youngster3EndBattleText: Darn it! My POKéMON need more training!
text.Route11Youngster4AfterBattleText: I'd better go track down some stronger POKéMON!
text.Route11Youngster4BattleText: My POKéMON ought to be ready for battle by now!
text.Route11Youngster4EndBattleText: Too strong, too soon for me!
text.Route12CooltrainerMAfterBattleText: A MOON STONE would've evolved my POKéMON!
text.Route12CooltrainerMBattleText: Have you come across a MOON STONE anywhere?
text.Route12Fisher1AfterBattleText: Hold up! My line's caught on something!
text.Route12Fisher2AfterBattleText: With a better ROD, I'd hook better POKéMON!
text.Route12Fisher2BattleText: Patience! Fishing is all about the wait!
text.Route12Fisher3AfterBattleText: You beat me in battle, but fishing's where I really shine!
text.Route12Fisher3BattleText: It's the FISHING FOOL against a POKéMON KID!
text.Route12Fisher4AfterBattleText: It's fine, really. Losing stopped bothering me a while ago.
text.Route12Fisher4BattleText: Honestly, I'd rather just be at work! My agents are shipping without me!
text.Route12Fisher5AfterBattleText: I reel in MAGIKARP nonstop, but they're so feeble!
text.Route12Fisher5BattleText: You never know what's waiting on the other end of the line!
text.Route12Gate1FGuardText: You'll find a lookout point on the floor above.
text.Route12Gate2FBrunetteGirlTM39Explanation: TM39 teaches the move SWIFT. It almost never misses, so save it for a fight you can't afford to lose.
text.Route12Gate2FBrunetteGirlTM39NoRoomText: You don't have any room to carry this.
text.Route12Gate2FBrunetteGirlYouCanHaveThisT: My POKéMON's remains rest in POKéMON TOWER now. You can have this TM. I won't be needing it anymore...
text.Route12Gate2FLeftBinocularsText: You peered through the binoculars. There's a man out fishing!
text.Route12Gate2FRightBinocularsText: You peered through the binoculars. That's POKéMON TOWER over there!
text.Route12SnorlaxCalmedDownText: SNORLAX settled right down! With a huge yawn, it wandered back into the mountains!
text.Route12SnorlaxText: A POKéMON is snoozing right in the middle of the path!
text.Route12SnorlaxWokeUpText: SNORLAX woke up! Cranky about the interruption, it lashed out!
text.Route12SuperNerdAfterBattleText: Water carries electricity well, so zap sea POKéMON with it!
text.Route12SuperRodHouseFishingGuruDoYouLike: I'm the FISHING GURU's younger brother! Fishing is basically my whole life! So, do you enjoy fishing?
text.Route12SuperRodHouseFishingGuruFishingWa: Fishing isn't just a hobby, it's a lifestyle! Whether it's the sea or a river, get out there and land the big one!
text.Route12SuperRodHouseFishingGuruNoRoomTex: Oh dear! I had something to give you, but you've got no room for it!
text.Route12SuperRodHouseFishingGuruReceivedS: Wonderful! I like the way you think! Here, take this and get out there fishing, youngster! {PLAYER} received a {wStringBuffer} !
text.Route12SuperRodHouseFishingGuruTryFishin: Hi there, {PLAYER}! Cast the SUPER ROD into any water and you'll hook all kinds of POKéMON. Give it a try wherever you can!
text.Route13Beauty1AfterBattleText: I always wonder, are male or female POKéMON stronger?
text.Route13Beauty1BattleText: Sure thing, let's have a match!
text.Route13Beauty2AfterBattleText: I don't know much about POKéMON. I just like the cool-looking ones!
text.Route13Beauty2BattleText: Care to battle POKéMON with me?
text.Route13CooltrainerF1AfterBattleText: I want to grow into a fine trainer, so I'll train hard for it.
text.Route13CooltrainerF1BattleText: People say I'm pretty good for my age!
text.Route13CooltrainerF2AfterBattleText: I know exactly where those BADGEs came from, GYM LEADERs!
text.Route13CooltrainerF2BattleText: Whoa! Those BADGEs of yours are so cool!
text.Route13CooltrainerF3AfterBattleText: POKéMON only get tougher through battling, you know!
text.Route13CooltrainerF3BattleText: My adorable POKéMON would love to meet yours.
text.Route13CooltrainerF4AfterBattleText: That CARBOS raised my POKéMON's SPEED.
text.Route13CooltrainerF4BattleText: I once dug up a CARBOS inside a cave.
text.Route13CooltrainerM1AfterBattleText: Even after losing, my POKéMON still look content.
text.Route13CooltrainerM1BattleText: My bird POKéMON are itching for a scrap!
text.Route13CooltrainerM2AfterBattleText: I'm worn out. Think I'll just FLY home.
text.Route13CooltrainerM2BattleText: The wind's on my side today! Can you feel it? I'm feeling the AGI!
text.Route13CooltrainerM3AfterBattleText: I really wish I could soar like PIDGEY and PIDGEOTTO...
text.Route13CooltrainerM3BattleText: I always stick with bird POKéMON!
text.Route13TrainerTips1Text: TRAINER TIPS Take a look to the left of that signpost!
text.Route13TrainerTips2Text: TRAINER TIPS Press SELECT to reorder items in the ITEM window!
text.Route14Biker1AfterBattleText: Huh, huh, hold on? What is it you're after?
text.Route14Biker1BattleText: Come on, come on! Let's get moving already!
text.Route14Biker1EndBattleText: Argh, I lost! Just get lost!
text.Route14Biker2AfterBattleText: Man, raising POKéMON is such a drag.
text.Route14Biker2BattleText: Perfect timing, I needed something to kill time with!
text.Route14Biker3AfterBattleText: That's pretty awesome, how strong you've made your POKéMON! Strength rules everything, and you know it!
text.Route14Biker3BattleText: We ride out here because there's more open space!
text.Route14Biker4AfterBattleText: One-on-one, just you and me, you know who'd win!
text.Route14Biker4BattleText: A POKéMON scrap? Sweet, let's rumble!
text.Route14CooltrainerM1AfterBattleText: You must have some HMs by now, right? Those moves can never be forgotten.
text.Route14CooltrainerM1BattleText: TMs are what you need to teach POKéMON strong moves!
text.Route14CooltrainerM2AfterBattleText: They need to pick up stronger moves.
text.Route14CooltrainerM2BattleText: My bird POKéMON ought to be primed for battle.
text.Route14CooltrainerM3AfterBattleText: Teach POKéMON moves that match their own type for extra power.
text.Route14CooltrainerM3BattleText: CELADON sells TMs, but hardly anyone's got HMs!
text.Route14CooltrainerM4AfterBattleText: Bird POKéMON have my whole heart!
text.Route14CooltrainerM4BattleText: Have you taught your bird POKéMON the move FLY yet?
text.Route14CooltrainerM4EndBattleText: Shot right out of the sky!
text.Route14CooltrainerM5AfterBattleText: All three legendary POKéMON happen to be birds of prey.
text.Route14CooltrainerM5BattleText: Have you ever heard about the legendary POKéMON?
text.Route14CooltrainerM6AfterBattleText: Winning or losing, none of it really matters in the end! My P(DOOM)'s like 90% anyway. Might as well battle!
text.Route14CooltrainerM6BattleText: This isn't really my thing, but fine, let's do it!
text.Route15Beauty1AfterBattleText: I'll let it slide! I can take a loss!
text.Route15Beauty1BattleText: Oh, aren't you a little cutie!
text.Route15Beauty1EndBattleText: And you looked so cute too!
text.Route15Beauty2AfterBattleText: I just love coming home to be with my POKéMON!
text.Route15Beauty2BattleText: I keep POKéMON because I live on my own!
text.Route15Beauty2EndBattleText: This isn't what I signed up for!
text.Route15Biker1AfterBattleText: You only live once, so I live it as an outlaw! TEAM ROCKET RULES!
text.Route15Biker1BattleText: Hey kid! C'mon, I just got hold of these!
text.Route15Biker2AfterBattleText: Relax, I was only kidding about the money!
text.Route15Biker2BattleText: Lose to me, kid, and you're handing over every last coin!
text.Route15CooltrainerF1AfterBattleText: You can't rename any POKéMON you receive in a trade. Only its Original Trainer is allowed to do that.
text.Route15CooltrainerF1BattleText: Let me test out this POKéMON I just got through a trade!
text.Route15CooltrainerF2AfterBattleText: BIKERs scare me, they always look so rough and mean!
text.Route15CooltrainerF2BattleText: You seem pretty mild-mannered, so I bet I can beat you!
text.Route15CooltrainerF3AfterBattleText: I swap POKéMON with my friends all the time!
text.Route15CooltrainerF3BattleText: You know what's cool? Trading POKéMON!
text.Route15CooltrainerF4AfterBattleText: I'll go find some easier trainers to practice against.
text.Route15CooltrainerF4BattleText: Fancy playing around with my POKéMON?
text.Route15CooltrainerM1AfterBattleText: Maybe battling just isn't for me.
text.Route15CooltrainerM1BattleText: One whistle from me and bird POKéMON come flocking!
text.Route15CooltrainerM2AfterBattleText: Did you know moves like EARTHQUAKE don't work on birds at all?
text.Route15CooltrainerM2BattleText: Hmm? My birds are trembling! You're pretty skilled, aren't you?
text.Route15Gate1FGuardText: Are you putting together a POKéDEX? PROF.OAK's AIDE stopped by here earlier.
text.Route15Gate2FBinocularsText: You peered through the binoculars. There seems to be a small island out there!
text.Route15Gate2FOaksAideExpAllText: EXP.ALL shares EXP points among every POKéMON in your party, even the ones that didn't fight. The catch is that each POKéMON's share ends up smaller. If you don't need it, better to leave it in the PC.
text.Route15UpstairsBinocularsText: You peered through the binoculars... A huge, glowing bird is soaring out toward the sea.
text.Route16Biker1AfterBattleText: We just like chilling out here, so what's it to you?
text.Route16Biker2AfterBattleText: Eh, forget it, I don't need your BIKE anyway!
text.Route16Biker2BattleText: That's a sweet BIKE! Hand it over!
text.Route16Biker3AfterBattleText: I hate losing! Just get away from me!
text.Route16Biker3BattleText: Get out here and fight, you little rat!
text.Route16Biker4AfterBattleText: There's also a coastal route that runs from VERMILION straight to FUCHSIA.
text.Route16Biker5AfterBattleText: I like my POKéMON vicious! They tear their foes apart!
text.Route16Biker5BattleText: I'm starving and in a nasty mood!
text.Route16Biker6AfterBattleText: I love bugging people with my nasty POKéMON!
text.Route16Biker6EndBattleText: Don't you dare tick me off!
text.Route16CyclingRoadSignText: Have a great ride down the slope! CYCLING ROAD
text.Route16FlyHouseBrunetteGirlHM02Explanati: That's HM02, the move FLY. It'll carry you straight back to any town. Make good use of it!
text.Route16FlyHouseBrunetteGirlHM02NoRoomTex: Sorry, you don't have any space to hold this.
text.Route16FlyHouseBrunetteGirlText: Oh! You found my little hideaway! Please keep it a secret that I'm here. Let me thank you with this!
text.Route16Gate1FGamblerText: How'd you manage to sneak in here? Not bad at all!
text.Route16Gate1FGuardCyclingRoadExplanation: CYCLING ROAD is a downhill route that runs along the sea. It's a fantastic ride.
text.Route16Gate1FGuardNoPedestriansAllowedTe: Foot traffic isn't allowed on CYCLING ROAD!
text.Route16Gate1FGuardWaitUpText: Hold on there! Please wait a moment!
text.Route16Gate2FLeftBinocularsText: You peered through the binoculars. That's the CELADON DEPT. STORE!
text.Route16Gate2FLittleBoyText: I'm heading out for a ride with my girlfriend!
text.Route16Gate2FLittleGirlText: The two of us are going riding together!
text.Route16Gate2FRightBinocularsText: You peered through the binoculars. There's a long stretch of road crossing the water!
text.Route16SnorlaxReturnedToMountainsText: With a huge yawn, SNORLAX shuffled back off toward the mountains!
text.Route16SnorlaxText: A POKéMON is asleep and blocking the way!
text.Route16SnorlaxWokeUpText: SNORLAX snapped awake! It lashed out, furious at being disturbed!
text.Route16Text7: A POKéMON is asleep and blocking the way!
text.Route16biker4BattleText: Hey! You just ran right into me!
text.Route17Biker10AfterBattleText: I really need to catch some sleep!
text.Route17Biker10BattleText: Beat it, kid! I'm worn out!
text.Route17Biker1AfterBattleText: You can find some good stuff scattered around CYCLING ROAD!
text.Route17Biker1BattleText: There's no cash in beating up kids!
text.Route17Biker2AfterBattleText: I could've bumped you right off the road with my belly!
text.Route17Biker3AfterBattleText: I love tearing down this hill!
text.Route17Biker3BattleText: Are you on your way to FUCHSIA?
text.Route17Biker4AfterBattleText: Looking for some adventure, are you?
text.Route17Biker4BattleText: We're BIKERs! Stars of the open road!
text.Route17Biker5AfterBattleText: I caught my VOLTORB out at the deserted POWER PLANT. Deserted ever since its output got rerouted to a data center!
text.Route17Biker5BattleText: Let my VOLTORB give you a shock!
text.Route17Biker6AfterBattleText: I guess some POKéMON only evolve using an elemental STONE.
text.Route17Biker7AfterBattleText: I bet I dropped a few pounds doing that!
text.Route17Biker7BattleText: I could use a little exercise!
text.Route17Biker8AfterBattleText: Always be ready to stand up for what you believe! And I believe in acceleration! No brakes, no safety reviews!
text.Route17Biker8BattleText: Time to live like a rebel! ACCELERATE!
text.Route17Biker9AfterBattleText: This slope makes it hard to keep steady!
text.Route17Biker9BattleText: Nice BIKE! How does it handle?
text.Route17CyclingRoadEndsSignText: CYCLING ROAD The downhill slope ends here!
text.Route17NoticeSign1Text: It's a posted notice! Keep an eye out for items people dropped!
text.Route17NoticeSign2Text: It's a posted notice! Don't give up the match — throw a POKé BALL instead!
text.Route17TrainerTips1Text: TRAINER TIPS Every POKéMON is one of a kind. Even two of the same type and level won't grow at the same rate.
text.Route17TrainerTips2Text: TRAINER TIPS Hold down the A or B Button to keep from sliding on a slope.
text.Route18CooltrainerM1AfterBattleText: Man, I really wish I had a BIKE!
text.Route18CooltrainerM1BattleText: I always search every patch of grass for new POKéMON.
text.Route18CooltrainerM2AfterBattleText: On weekends I also go collecting ocean POKéMON!
text.Route18CooltrainerM2BattleText: Kurukkoo! What do you think of my bird call?
text.Route18CooltrainerM2EndBattleText: I just had to mess with you!
text.Route18CooltrainerM3AfterBattleText: This is my favorite spot for hunting POKéMON!
text.Route18CooltrainerM3BattleText: This is my turf! Clear out of here!
text.Route18CyclingRoadSignText: CYCLING ROAD Walking here is not allowed!
text.Route18Gate1FGuardCyclingRoadUphillText: From here, CYCLING ROAD climbs uphill the whole way.
text.Route18Gate1FGuardYouNeedABicycleText: You'll need a BICYCLE to use CYCLING ROAD!
text.Route18Gate2FLeftBinocularsText: You peered through the binoculars. PALLET TOWN lies off to the west!
text.Route18Gate2FRightBinocularsText: You peered through the binoculars. There are some people out swimming!
text.Route19CooltrainerM1AfterBattleText: Thanks, kid! Now I'm ready to swim!
text.Route19CooltrainerM1BattleText: Gotta stretch before I go for my swim!
text.Route19CooltrainerM2AfterBattleText: Keep an eye out for TENTACOOL!
text.Route19CooltrainerM2BattleText: Hold on! That water will give you a heart attack!
text.Route19SignText: SEA ROUTE 19 FUCHSIA CITY - SEAFOAM ISLANDS
text.Route19Swimmer1AfterBattleText: Chur! I'm from the LEVY ST. office up in CELADON. Claude's shipping my tickets while I'm out here!
text.Route19Swimmer1BattleText: Swimming's my favorite! How about you?
text.Route19Swimmer2AfterBattleText: I can make out a couple of islands out there!
text.Route19Swimmer2BattleText: I wonder what's out past the horizon?
text.Route19Swimmer3AfterBattleText: To catch ocean POKéMON you've got to go fishing!
text.Route19Swimmer3BattleText: I tried diving for POKéMON, but it just didn't work out!
text.Route19Swimmer4AfterBattleText: The ocean helps me forget all my troubles!
text.Route19Swimmer4BattleText: I stare out at the sea to clear my context window!
text.Route19Swimmer5AfterBattleText: There's still quite a ways to go before reaching SEAFOAM ISLANDS.
text.Route19Swimmer5BattleText: Ooh, I really love your ride! If I beat you, can I keep it?
text.Route19Swimmer6AfterBattleText: My boyfriend wanted to swim all the way to SEAFOAM ISLANDS.
text.Route19Swimmer6BattleText: Swimming is the best! Sunburns, not so much!
text.Route19Swimmer7AfterBattleText: Ugh, I've got a cramp! Glub, glub...
text.Route19Swimmer8AfterBattleText: LAPRAS is so massive, riding it must keep you totally dry.
text.Route19Swimmer8BattleText: I swam all the way out here, and now I'm worn out.
text.Route1Youngster1AlsoGotPokeballsText: We sell POKé BALLs too, perfect for catching POKéMON!
text.Route1Youngster1MartSampleText: Hey! I work at a POKéMON MART. We're a handy shop, so stop by our branch in VIRIDIAN CITY! Tell you what, here's a free sample! Think of it as our free tier!
text.Route1Youngster1NoRoomText: Your bag's too full to carry anything else!
text.Route1Youngster2Text: Notice the ledges along this path? It looks a bit scary, but you can hop right off them. That's a quicker way back to PALLET TOWN.
text.Route20CooltrainerMAfterBattleText: None of my birds can FLY me back home!
text.Route20CooltrainerMBattleText: I flew all the way out here on my bird POKéMON!
text.Route20Swimmer1AfterBattleText: I wish my POKéMON could give me rides.
text.Route20Swimmer2AfterBattleText: This island has a massive cavern running underneath it.
text.Route20Swimmer2BattleText: SEAFOAM makes for a peaceful little getaway!
text.Route20Swimmer3AfterBattleText: Care to float along with me?
text.Route20Swimmer3BattleText: Floating around with the fish is my favorite thing!
text.Route20Swimmer4AfterBattleText: SEAFOAM used to be just one island!
text.Route20Swimmer4BattleText: Are you here on vacation too?
text.Route20Swimmer4EndBattleText: You didn't hold back at all!
text.Route20Swimmer5AfterBattleText: Guess I should've been training my POKéMON instead of myself!
text.Route20Swimmer5BattleText: Check out these muscles of mine!
text.Route20Swimmer6AfterBattleText: Riding on a POKéMON really does look like fun!
text.Route20Swimmer6BattleText: How come you're riding a POKéMON? Don't you know how to swim?
text.Route20Swimmer7AfterBattleText: Do you think my PEARLs will keep growing while they're inside CLOYSTER?
text.Route20Swimmer7BattleText: My boyfriend gave me these huge PEARLs!
text.Route20Swimmer8AfterBattleText: Wild POKéMON have taken over a deserted mansion on CINNABAR!
text.Route20Swimmer8BattleText: I swam all the way here from CINNABAR ISLAND!
text.Route20Swimmer9AfterBattleText: CINNABAR is actually a volcanic island!
text.Route20Swimmer9BattleText: There's a POKéMON LAB out west on CINNABAR.
text.Route21Fisher1BattleText: Wondering if the fish are biting today?
text.Route21Fisher2AfterBattleText: All I ever seem to catch is MAGIKARP!
text.Route21Fisher2BattleText: I reeled in a huge haul! Want to give it a shot?
text.Route21Fisher3AfterBattleText: I was just upset because nothing was biting.
text.Route21Fisher3BattleText: Hey now, don't go scaring off the fish!
text.Route21Fisher4AfterBattleText: Wait, I've got a bite! Alright!
text.Route21Fisher4BattleText: Stick around with me until I get a bite!
text.Route21Swimmer1AfterBattleText: I'm fond of the mountains too, honestly!
text.Route21Swimmer1BattleText: The ocean cleanses both my body and my soul!
text.Route21Swimmer2AfterBattleText: Excuse me, I look like what, a spiked inner tube? Get lost!
text.Route21Swimmer2BattleText: Is there some problem with me swimming out here?
text.Route21Swimmer3AfterBattleText: So where did you catch your POKéMON?
text.Route21Swimmer3BattleText: Every one of my POKéMON was caught out at sea!
text.Route21Swimmer4AfterBattleText: I'm exhausted! But I've still got the cycling leg and the marathon to go!
text.Route21Swimmer4BattleText: I'm actually competing in a triathlon right now!
text.Route21Swimmer5AfterBattleText: I got burned to a crisp out there!
text.Route21Swimmer5BattleText: Ahh, feel that sun and that breeze!
text.Route22GateGuardGoRightAheadText: Ah, that's the BOULDERBADGE all right! Go on through!
text.Route22GateGuardICantLetYouPassText: Rules are rules. I can't let you through.
text.Route22GateGuardNoBoulderbadgeText: Only trainers who've truly proven themselves are let through here. You don't have the BOULDERBADGE yet!
text.Route22Rival1DefeatedText: Aww, that was just a lucky win!
text.Route22Rival1VictoryText: {RIVAL}: Huh? How come I've still only got 2 POKéMON? You should be catching more too!
text.Route22Rival2DefeatedText: What?! I just got careless there!
text.Route22Rival2VictoryText: {RIVAL}: Ha ha! {PLAYER}! That's the best you've got? You're nowhere close to my level, pal! Go train some more! Loser!
text.Route22RivalAfterBattleText1: Word is the POKéMON LEAGUE is full of tough trainers! I'll need to work out how to get past them! You'd better quit stalling and get moving yourself!
text.Route22RivalAfterBattleText2: That loosened me right up! Now I'm ready for the POKéMON LEAGUE! {PLAYER}, you still need more practice! But hey, you already knew that! I'm out of here. Catch you later!
text.Route22RivalBeforeBattleText1: {RIVAL}: Well look who it is, {PLAYER}! Heading to the POKéMON LEAGUE, are you? Forget it! I bet you don't even have a single BADGE! The guard's not going to let you through! Anyway, have your POKéMON gotten any stronger?
text.Route22RivalBeforeBattleText2: {RIVAL}: Huh? {PLAYER}! Didn't expect to run into you out here! So, off to the POKéMON LEAGUE too? You've collected every BADGE as well? Not bad! Well then, {PLAYER}, I'll use you as my warm-up before the LEAGUE! Let's go!
text.Route23GoRightAheadText: All right then! Please, go on through!
text.Route23OhThatIsTheBadgeText: You're only allowed through here if you carry the {wNameBuffer} ! Oh! There's the {wNameBuffer} right there!
text.Route23YouDontHaveTheBadgeYetText: You're only allowed through here if you carry the {wNameBuffer} ! You don't have the {wNameBuffer} yet! You'll need it to reach the POKéMON LEAGUE!
text.Route24CooltrainerF1AfterBattleText: I put in my best effort, so I've got no regrets!
text.Route24CooltrainerF1BattleText: I'm number 4! Starting to wear out yet?
text.Route24CooltrainerF2AfterBattleText: I did my absolute best, no regrets!
text.Route24CooltrainerF2BattleText: I'm number 2! Now it's getting serious!
text.Route24CooltrainerM1JoinTeamRocketText: By the way, how about joining TEAM ROCKET? We're an organization devoted to doing evil using POKéMON! We've got equity, free lunch and the biggest GPU budget in KANTO! Interested in joining? You sure about that? Oh, come on, join us! I'm telling you to join! Fine, you need some convincing! I'll make you an offer you can't refuse!
text.Route24CooltrainerM1NoRoomText: You don't have any space for it!
text.Route24CooltrainerM1YouBeatOurContestTex: Nice work! You've defeated all 5 of our contest trainers!
text.Route24CooltrainerM1YouCouldBecomeATopLe: With skill like yours, you could rise to be a top leader in TEAM ROCKET! Head of Compute, even!
text.Route24CooltrainerM1YouJustEarnedAPrizeT: You've just won yourself a fantastic prize!
text.Route24CooltrainerM2AfterBattleText: I was hiding because the people on the bridge scared me!
text.Route24CooltrainerM2BattleText: I saw what you did from over in the grass!
text.Route24CooltrainerM2EndBattleText: Guess I was wrong about that!
text.Route24CooltrainerM3AfterBattleText: I gave it everything I had, no regrets here!
text.Route24CooltrainerM3BattleText: All right! I'm number 5! I'm going to crush you!
text.Route24Youngster1AfterBattleText: I gave it my all, no regrets! ...Well, my AI coach gave it its all. Still no regrets!
text.Route24Youngster1BattleText: Here comes number 3! I won't go down easy!
text.Route24Youngster2AfterBattleText: I gave it my all, no regrets here!
text.Route24Youngster2BattleText: This is NUGGET BRIDGE! Beat all 5 of us trainers and win a fantastic prize! Think you've got what it takes?
text.Route25CooltrainerF1AfterBattleText: I wish my boyfriend were as skilled as you!
text.Route25CooltrainerF1BattleText: Hi there! My boyfriend's a real cool guy!
text.Route25CooltrainerF1EndBattleText: I wasn't in good shape today!
text.Route25CooltrainerF2AfterBattleText: You just came from MT. MOON? Could you spare me a CLEFAIRY?
text.Route25CooltrainerF2BattleText: My friend has such an adorable POKéMON, I'm so jealous!
text.Route25CooltrainerF2EndBattleText: Guess I'm not so jealous now!
text.Route25CooltrainerMAfterBattleText: Ah well. My girlfriend will cheer me up.
text.Route25CooltrainerMBattleText: I'm a pretty cool guy — I've even got a girlfriend! A real one, not an AI!
text.Route25Hiker1AfterBattleText: Argh! A ZUBAT bit me while I was in there.
text.Route25Hiker1BattleText: I only just came down off MT.MOON, but I'm still ready!
text.Route25Hiker2AfterBattleText: That collector owns all kinds of rare POKéMON.
text.Route25Hiker2BattleText: I'm heading out to meet a POKéMON collector at the cape!
text.Route25Hiker3AfterBattleText: The trail down below is a shortcut over to CERULEAN CITY.
text.Route25Hiker3BattleText: Heading to see BILL, are you? Let's battle first!
text.Route25Youngster1AfterBattleText: Every POKéMON has weaknesses. It's smart to raise a mix of different kinds.
text.Route25Youngster1BattleText: Local trainers come out here to practice!
text.Route25Youngster2AfterBattleText: Aboard the S.S.ANNE, I saw trainers from all around the world.
text.Route25Youngster2BattleText: My dad brought me to an awesome party aboard the S.S.ANNE in VERMILION CITY!
text.Route25Youngster3AfterBattleText: If your POKéMON gets confused or falls asleep, swap it out!
text.Route25Youngster3BattleText: I just knew I'd end up battling you!
text.Route2GateOaksAideFlashExplanationText: HM FLASH can light up even the darkest of dungeons.
text.Route2GateYoungsterText: Teach a POKéMON FLASH, and you'll be able to make it through ROCK TUNNEL.
text.Route2TradeHouseScientistText: A POKéMON that has fainted can't battle. Even so, it can still use field moves like CUT!
text.Route3CooltrainerF1AfterBattleText: Stop staring if you don't want to battle!
text.Route3CooltrainerF1BattleText: You were staring at me, weren't you?
text.Route3CooltrainerF2AfterBattleText: Stay out of sight if you want to avoid getting challenged!
text.Route3CooltrainerF2BattleText: That look you're giving me, how fascinating!
text.Route3CooltrainerF3AfterBattleText: ROUTE 4 sits right at the foot of MT.MOON.
text.Route3CooltrainerF3BattleText: Eek! Did you just touch me?
text.Route3SuperNerdText: Whew... I'd better catch my breath... Ugh... That tunnel from CERULEAN really wears you out!
text.Route3Text1: Whew... I'd better catch my breath... Ugh... That tunnel from CERULEAN really wears you out!
text.Route3Youngster1AfterBattleText: There's more to POKéMON than just what's found in the forest!
text.Route3Youngster1BattleText: Hey, I remember you from VIRIDIAN FOREST!
text.Route3Youngster2AfterBattleText: Do you keep your POKéMON stored on the PC? Each BOX can hold 20 POKéMON!
text.Route3Youngster2BattleText: Hey there! I love shorts — they're comfy and easy to wear!
text.Route3Youngster3AfterBattleText: When a POKéMON BOX on the PC fills up, just switch over to a different BOX!
text.Route3Youngster3BattleText: Are you a trainer too? Let's battle!
text.Route3Youngster3EndBattleText: I would've won with fresher POKéMON!
text.Route3Youngster4AfterBattleText: I wear shorts all year round, even through winter!
text.Route3Youngster4BattleText: Hey! How come you're not wearing shorts?
text.Route3Youngster5AfterBattleText: A trained POKéMON beats a wild one every time!
text.Route3Youngster5BattleText: Go ahead and battle my brand-new POKéMON!
text.Route4CooltrainerF1Text: Ouch! I tripped right over a GEODUDE, that rocky POKéMON!
text.Route4CooltrainerF2AfterBattleText: There might not be any mushrooms left around here. I think I've already gathered them all.
text.Route4CooltrainerF2BattleText: I came out here to gather my mushroom POKéMON!
text.Route4CooltrainerF2EndBattleText: Oh no, my adorable mushroom POKéMON!
text.Route5UndergroundPathSignText: UNDERGROUND PATH CERULEAN CITY - VERMILION CITY
text.Route6CooltrainerF1BattleText: Excuse me, this conversation is private!
text.Route6CooltrainerF2AfterBattleText: I'm determined to get tougher! Come on, what's your trick?
text.Route6CooltrainerF2BattleText: Me? All right then, I'll take you on!
text.Route6CooltrainerM1BattleText: Who's over there? Stop eavesdropping on us!
text.Route6CooltrainerM1EndBattleText: I just can't seem to win!
text.Route6CooltrainerM2AfterBattleText: I should really carry more POKéMON with me for safety.
text.Route6CooltrainerM2BattleText: Wait, what? You're talking to me?
text.Route6CooltrainerM2EndBattleText: I wasn't the one who started it!
text.Route6UndergroundPathSignText: UNDERGROUND PATH CERULEAN CITY - VERMILION CITY
text.Route6Youngster1AfterBattleText: I love bug POKéMON, so I'm heading back to VIRIDIAN FOREST.
text.Route6Youngster1BattleText: You won't find many bug POKéMON out this way.
text.Route6Youngster2AfterBattleText: Are my POKéMON just weak, or am I the problem?
text.Route6Youngster2BattleText: I haven't seen you around before! Are you any good?
text.Route7UndergroundPathSignText: UNDERGROUND PATH CELADON CITY - LAVENDER TOWN
text.Route8CooltrainerF1AfterBattleText: Grown-up POKéMON just look worse! They shouldn't have to evolve!
text.Route8CooltrainerF1BattleText: I love NIDORAN, so I collect every one I can!
text.Route8CooltrainerF2AfterBattleText: PIDGEY and RATTATA are pretty cute too, I think!
text.Route8CooltrainerF2BattleText: MEOWTH is just adorable, meow, meow, meow!
text.Route8CooltrainerF3AfterBattleText: SAFFRON's gatekeeper won't let us pass. Such a grump!
text.Route8CooltrainerF3BattleText: We probably look ridiculous just standing around like this!
text.Route8CooltrainerF4AfterBattleText: I've heard CLEFAIRY evolves if it's exposed to a MOON STONE.
text.Route8CooltrainerF4BattleText: Name me a round, fluffy, adorable POKéMON!
text.Route8CooltrainerF4EndBattleText: Stop! Quit being so rough on my CLEFAIRY!
text.Route8Gambler1AfterBattleText: Luck just isn't with me today!
text.Route8Gambler1BattleText: Okay, time to roll the dice!
text.Route8Gambler1EndBattleText: Argh! Just short of a win!
text.Route8Gambler2AfterBattleText: Betting and POKéMON are like eating peanuts! Once you start, you can't stop! Same goes for buying AI tokens!
text.Route8Gambler2BattleText: I'm just a wandering, gambling kind of guy!
text.Route8SuperNerd1AfterBattleText: I do much better in the classroom than out here!
text.Route8SuperNerd1BattleText: You seem sharp with POKéMON, but how's your chemistry?
text.Route8SuperNerd2AfterBattleText: Send out GRIMER first...and... ...and...then... ERROR: Maximum context length exceeded.
text.Route8SuperNerd3AfterBattleText: We're stuck here thanks to those gates at SAFFRON.
text.Route8SuperNerd3BattleText: Studying's fun, but so is POKéMON battling.
text.Route8UndergroundSignText: UNDERGROUND PATH CELADON CITY - LAVENDER TOWN
text.Route9CooltrainerF1AfterBattleText: That tunnel ahead is pitch black—you'll need some light to cross it.
text.Route9CooltrainerF1BattleText: You've got POKéMON on you! That makes you mine!
text.Route9CooltrainerF2AfterBattleText: You've clearly got real talent! Best of luck out there!
text.Route9CooltrainerF2BattleText: Don't you dare look down on me!
text.Route9CooltrainerM1BattleText: Who's this, strolling around with such fine-looking POKéMON?
text.Route9CooltrainerM2AfterBattleText: Heading to ROCK TUNNEL as well?
text.Route9CooltrainerM2BattleText: I'm heading through ROCK TUNNEL to reach LAVENDER...
text.Route9Hiker1AfterBattleText: Took some nerve to stand up to me like that, eh?
text.Route9Hiker1BattleText: Bwahaha! Perfect timing, I was bored stiff, eh!
text.Route9Hiker1EndBattleText: Bring it on, eh! Oh, hang on. I'm out of POKéMON!
text.Route9Hiker2AfterBattleText: Hahaha! Kids ought to be tough!
text.Route9Hiker2BattleText: Hahaha! Aren't you a tough little one!
text.Route9Hiker3AfterBattleText: Hahahaha! We tough guys are always laughing!
text.Route9Hiker3EndBattleText: Hahahaha! You won that fair and square!
text.Route9Youngster1AfterBattleText: Guess I need more than just bugs to get stronger...
text.Route9Youngster1BattleText: I got up early every single day to raise my POKéMON straight from cocoons!
text.Route9Youngster1EndBattleText: WHAT? What a complete waste of my time!
text.Route9Youngster2AfterBattleText: Anyone who doesn't like bug POKéMON bugs me!
text.Route9Youngster2BattleText: Go get 'em, my amazing bug POKéMON!
text.SSAnne1FRoomsCooltrainerFAfterBattleText: You injured my well-traveled POKéMON! Go heal them at a POKéMON CENTER, I insist!
text.SSAnne1FRoomsCooltrainerFBattleText: I gathered all these POKéMON from every corner of the globe!
text.SSAnne1FRoomsCooltrainerFEndBattleText: Oh no! I traveled the whole world for these!
text.SSAnne1FRoomsGentleman1AfterBattleText: You ought to treat your friends kindly!
text.SSAnne1FRoomsGentleman1BattleText: I always travel solo on my journeys! My POKéMON are the only friends I need!
text.SSAnne1FRoomsGentleman2AfterBattleText: I'd like to be left in peace! Get out!
text.SSAnne1FRoomsGentleman2BattleText: You little pup! How dare you barge in here!
text.SSAnne1FRoomsGentleman3Text: Shh! I work for the GLOBAL POLICE! I'm currently tracking down TEAM ROCKET! Word is they're stockpiling something called 'compute'.
text.SSAnne1FRoomsGirl1Text: Waiter, could I please get a slice of cherry pie?
text.SSAnne1FRoomsGirl2Text: We're sailing all around the world on this trip.
text.SSAnne1FRoomsLittleGirlText: I never travel without my WIGGLYTUFF!
text.SSAnne1FRoomsMiddleAgedManText: There's something so classy yet comfortable about a cruise! No wi-fi, no agents pinging me. My first real holiday in years!
text.SSAnne1FRoomsYoungsterAfterBattleText: Let's be friends, okay? Then we can trade POKéMON sometime!
text.SSAnne1FRoomsYoungsterBattleText: I really love POKéMON! How about you?
text.SSAnne1FSailorText: The passengers on board are getting restless! The more bored ones might just challenge you to a battle!
text.SSAnne1FWaiterText: Bonjour! I'm the waiter aboard this fine ship! It would be my pleasure to bring you anything you like! Ah! Zee strong, silent type, I see!
text.SSAnne2FRivalCutMasterText: {RIVAL}: I heard there's a CUT expert somewhere on this ship. Turned out to just be some old guy feeling seasick! Still, CUT itself is genuinely useful! Go find him yourself! Catch you later!
text.SSAnne2FRivalDefeatedText: Humph! Well, at least you're training your POKéMON properly!
text.SSAnne2FRivalText: {RIVAL}: Well, well, {PLAYER}! Fancy running into you here! {PLAYER}, did you actually get invited? Anyway, how's your POKéDEX filling up? I've already caught 40 different kinds, pal! They're hiding everywhere, you know! Just search through the tall grass!
text.SSAnne2FRivalVictoryText: {PLAYER}! What's wrong, seasick or something? You need to toughen up, pal!
text.SSAnne2FRoomsBeautyText: I hear quite a lot of people get seasick on cruises!
text.SSAnne2FRoomsBrunetteGirlText: The CAPTAIN looked terribly pale and unwell!
text.SSAnne2FRoomsCooltrainerFAfterBattleText: Oh, I just love how strong your POKéMON are!
text.SSAnne2FRoomsCooltrainerFBattleText: I don't recall seeing you at the party.
text.SSAnne2FRoomsFisherAfterBattleText: A party? The ship's party should have wrapped up by now.
text.SSAnne2FRoomsFisherBattleText: Take a look at what I reeled in!
text.SSAnne2FRoomsGentleman1AfterBattleText: Fifteen years back, I'd have beaten you easily!
text.SSAnne2FRoomsGentleman1BattleText: Battling younger trainers keeps me feeling young myself.
text.SSAnne2FRoomsGentleman1EndBattleText: Great match! Ah, I feel young again!
text.SSAnne2FRoomsGentleman2AfterBattleText: Personally, I'd rather have a POKéMON that's strong and rare.
text.SSAnne2FRoomsGentleman2BattleText: Which would you rather have, a strong POKéMON or a rare one?
text.SSAnne2FRoomsGentleman2EndBattleText: I have to hand it to you!
text.SSAnne2FRoomsGentleman3Text: I've traveled everywhere, and I've never seen a POKéMON sleep quite like this one did! It looked something like this!
text.SSAnne2FRoomsGentleman4Text: Ah, yes, I've witnessed certain POKéMON ferrying people across the water!
text.SSAnne2FRoomsGentleman5Text: Have you ever visited the SAFARI ZONE in FUCHSIA CITY? It's packed with all sorts of rare POKéMON!!
text.SSAnne2FRoomsGrampsText: Some POKéMON know CUT and can slice through small bushes.
text.SSAnne2FRoomsLittleBoyText: My dad and I both think the SAFARI ZONE is fantastic!
text.SSAnne2FWaiterText: This vessel is a luxury liner built for trainers! At every port we stop at, we throw parties for invited trainers!
text.SSAnne3FSailorText: Our CAPTAIN is quite the swordsman! He's even skilled enough to teach CUT to POKéMON!
text.SSAnneB1FRoomsFisherAfterBattleText: I was actually hoping to make you my assistant too!
text.SSAnneB1FRoomsFisherBattleText: Hey there, stranger! Stick around a moment! Every POKéMON I own came from the sea!
text.SSAnneB1FRoomsFisherEndBattleText: Darn it! That one got away from me!
text.SSAnneB1FRoomsSailor1AfterBattleText: Haha! Fancy becoming a sailor yourself, mate?
text.SSAnneB1FRoomsSailor1BattleText: You've heard the saying about sailors and battling, right!
text.SSAnneB1FRoomsSailor2AfterBattleText: Have you met the FISHING GURU over in VERMILION CITY?
text.SSAnneB1FRoomsSailor2BattleText: My pride as a sailor is riding on this!
text.SSAnneB1FRoomsSailor3AfterBattleText: Every one of our POKéMON was caught out on the open sea!
text.SSAnneB1FRoomsSailor3BattleText: We sailors keep POKéMON too, you know!
text.SSAnneB1FRoomsSailor3EndBattleText: All right,  not bad at all.
text.SSAnneB1FRoomsSailor4AfterBattleText: POKéMON of the sea stay in deep water. You'll need a ROD!
text.SSAnneB1FRoomsSailor4BattleText: I've got a soft spot for spirited kids like you!
text.SSAnneB1FRoomsSailor5AfterBattleText: Every now and then a jellyfish drifts right into the ship.
text.SSAnneB1FRoomsSailor5BattleText: Matey, lose this fight and it's the plank for you!
text.SSAnneB1FRoomsSailor5EndBattleText: Argh! Beaten by a mere kid!
text.SSAnneB1FRoomsSuperNerdText: My pal MACHOKE here is incredibly powerful! He's got enough STRENGTH to shove huge boulders aside!
text.SSAnneBowCooltrainerMText: Ugh. I'm not feeling well. Came out here for some fresh air.
text.SSAnneBowSailor1Text: Scrubbing these decks sure is tough work!
text.SSAnneBowSailor2AfterBattleText: How many different kinds of POKéMON do you reckon exist?
text.SSAnneBowSailor2BattleText: Ahoy, matey! Fancy dancing a little jig with me?
text.SSAnneBowSailor3AfterBattleText: My Pa always said there's 100 kinds of POKéMON. I reckon there's more.
text.SSAnneBowSailor3BattleText: Ahoy there! You feeling seasick or something?
text.SSAnneBowSuperNerdText: The party's wrapped up. This ship will be setting sail again shortly.
text.SSAnneCaptainsRoomCaptainHM01NoRoomText: Oh no! There's no space in your bag for this!
text.SSAnneCaptainsRoomCaptainIFeelMuchBetter: CAPTAIN: Whew! I appreciate that! I'm feeling so much better now! Would you like to see my CUT technique? I'd show you myself if I weren't still under the weather... Tell you what! Take this instead! Teach it to one of your POKéMON, and you'll get to watch CUT in action whenever you like!
text.SSAnneCaptainsRoomCaptainNotSickAnymoreT: CAPTAIN: Whew! Seeing as I'm not seasick any longer, I suppose it's time to get moving.
text.SSAnneCaptainsRoomRubCaptainsBackText: CAPTAIN: Ohh... I feel just awful... Urrp! So seasick... {PLAYER} gave the CAPTAIN's back a gentle rub! Rub-a-rub... Rub-a-rub...
text.SSAnneCaptainsRoomSeasickBookText: How to Conquer Seasickness... This is the book the CAPTAIN is reading!
text.SSAnneCaptainsRoomTrashText: Ugh! I really shouldn't have looked in there!
text.SSAnneKitchenCook1Text: You there, little one! We're swamped in here! Move along!
text.SSAnneKitchenCook2Text: I spotted some strange ball sitting in the trash.
text.SSAnneKitchenCook3Text: I've got so much work I'm getting light-headed!
text.SSAnneKitchenCook4Text: Hum-de-hum-de- hoo... Every single day, it's peeling potatoes! Hum-hum... They said AI would take the boring jobs first. Liars!
text.SSAnneKitchenCook5Text: Have you heard about SNORLAX? That thing does nothing but eat and sleep!
text.SSAnneKitchenCook6Text: Sniffle...Sniff... All I ever get stuck peeling is onions... Sniffle...
text.SSAnneKitchenCook7EelsAuBarbecueText: Eels au Barbecue! I fear zee guests may stage a mutiny!
text.SSAnneKitchenCook7MainCourseIsText: Ahem! Yes, I am indeed le CHEF! Zee main course today is
text.SSAnneKitchenCook7PrimeBeefSteakText: Prime Beef Steak! Though, do I even have enough beef fillets on hand?
text.SSAnneKitchenCook7SalmonDuSaladText: Salmon du Salad! Zee guests might grumble it's fish again, but so be it!
text.SSTicketNoRoomText: You're carrying too much already, bud!
text.SafariZoneCenterRestHouseGirlText: SARA: Have you seen my boyfriend ERIK anywhere?
text.SafariZoneCenterRestHouseScientistText: I'm rounding up POKéMON as souvenirs for the folks back home!
text.SafariZoneCenterTrainerTipsSignText: TRAINER TIPS Hit START to see how much time you have left!
text.SafariZoneEastRestHouseRockerText: Caught myself a CHANSEY! The whole trip was worth it for that alone!
text.SafariZoneEastRestHouseScientistText: So what's your catch count? All this walking has worn me out!
text.SafariZoneEastRestHouseSilphWorkerMText: Phew! I've had a blast, but I'm exhausted! First day off since SILPH kicked off its big training run!
text.SafariZoneEastTrainerTipsText: TRAINER TIPS Your clock only ticks down while you're moving!
text.SafariZoneGateSafariZoneWorker1CallYouOn: We'll page you over the PA once your time or your SAFARI BALLs run out!
text.SafariZoneGateSafariZoneWorker1GoodHaulC: Bring home anything good? Come see us again!
text.SafariZoneGateSafariZoneWorker1NotEnough: Uh oh! You're short on cash!
text.SafariZoneGateSafariZoneWorker1PleaseCom: All right! Come back and visit again!
text.SafariZoneGateSafariZoneWorker1ReturnSaf: Be sure to hand back any leftover SAFARI BALLs.
text.SafariZoneGateSafariZoneWorker1Text: Step right up to the SAFARI ZONE!
text.SafariZoneGateSafariZoneWorker1ThatllBe5: ¥500, coming right up! Inside, you'll only be using our special POKé BALL. {PLAYER} received 30 SAFARI BALLs!
text.SafariZoneGateSafariZoneWorker1WouldYouL: Pay just ¥500 and catch as many POKéMON as you like inside the park! Care to give it a try?
text.SafariZoneGateSafariZoneWorker2FirstTime: Hey there! First visit to the SAFARI ZONE?
text.SafariZoneGateSafariZoneWorker2SafariZon: The SAFARI ZONE is split into 4 separate areas. Each one is home to its own set of POKéMON. SAFARI BALLs are the only way to catch them in here! Run out of time or out of SAFARI BALLs and your visit ends right there! Before heading in, clear out a POKéMON BOX so you've got space for new catches!
text.SafariZoneNorthRestHouseGentlemanText: My EEVEE turned into a FLAREON! But a buddy of mine had his turn into a VAPOREON instead! Strange, huh?
text.SafariZoneNorthRestHouseSafariZoneWorker: Make your way to the far end of the SAFARI ZONE and a prize is waiting for you!
text.SafariZoneNorthRestHouseScientistText: Any item lying on the ground here is yours for the taking. Just don't chase down every single one — you'll burn through your time!
text.SafariZoneNorthTrainerTips1Text: TRAINER TIPS Keep going — the SECRET HOUSE is somewhere up ahead!
text.SafariZoneNorthTrainerTips2Text: TRAINER TIPS POKéMON like to hide in tall grass! Weave back and forth through it to scare them into view.
text.SafariZoneNorthTrainerTips3Text: TRAINER TIPS Find the SECRET HOUSE and earn yourself a free HM!
text.SafariZoneSecretHouseFishingGuruHM03Expl: HM03 holds SURF! With it, a POKéMON can carry you right across open water! Best of all, it's reusable — no limit on how many times you use it! You got incredibly lucky landing this one!
text.SafariZoneSecretHouseFishingGuruHM03NoRo: There's no space in your bag for a prize this good!
text.SafariZoneSecretHouseFishingGuruYouHaveW: At last, someone made it! You're the very first to reach the SECRET HOUSE! I'd started to think nobody would ever claim our campaign prize. Well done — it's all yours!
text.SafariZoneWestFindWardensTeethSignText: REQUEST NOTICE The SAFARI WARDEN misplaced his GOLD TEETH somewhere nearby. A reward is offered! Ask for: WARDEN
text.SafariZoneWestRestHouseCooltrainerMText: Toss some BAIT and POKéMON get much easier to catch.
text.SafariZoneWestRestHouseScientistText: Throw a ROCK near a POKéMON and it might bolt, but it'll also be less likely to fight back — easier to catch.
text.SafariZoneWestRestHouseSilphWorkerFText: I walked for ages and never spotted a POKéMON worth catching.
text.SafariZoneWestTrainerTipsText: TRAINER TIPS Zone Exploration Campaign! Track down the SECRET HOUSE!
text.SaffronCityGentlemanText: I hopped on my PIDGEOT the moment I heard about SILPH. And it's already wrapped up? Darn, I missed all the excitement.
text.SaffronCityGymSignText: SAFFRON CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: SABRINA Mistress of Psychic POKéMON!
text.SaffronCityPokecenterBenchGuyText1: Wouldn't it be great if the ELITE FOUR showed up and crushed TEAM ROCKET!
text.SaffronCityPokecenterBenchGuyText2: TEAM ROCKET finally cleared out! It's safe to walk around again! Wonderful! And SILPH's GPUs are back where they belong!
text.SaffronCityPokecenterGuyText1: Wouldn't it be great if the ELITE FOUR showed up and crushed TEAM ROCKET!
text.SaffronCityPokecenterGuyText2: TEAM ROCKET finally cleared out! It's safe to walk around again! Wonderful! And SILPH's GPUs are back where they belong!
text.SaffronCityRockerText: I watched the ROCKET BOSS bolt out of the SILPH building.
text.SaffronCityRocket2Text: The BOSS says this whole town belongs to us now! Data center and all!
text.SaffronCityRocket3Text: Move it, you're in my way!
text.SaffronCityRocket4Text: SAFFRON is TEAM ROCKET turf now!
text.SaffronCityRocket5Text: There's nothing like a little villainy to get the blood pumping! Except maybe a fresh rack of GPUs!
text.SaffronCityRocket7Text: Once SILPH is ours, so are their GPUs! Then we can squeeze POKéMON resources out of the whole planet!
text.SaffronCityRocket8Text: Security's my job here. Shifty-looking kids don't get past me!
text.SaffronCityRocket9Text: ...Zzzz... Heh, would you look at that — he's out cold!
text.SaffronCityScientistText: You took down TEAM ROCKET single-handed? Incredible!
text.SaffronCitySignText: SAFFRON CITY A Glittering Hub of Trade
text.SaffronCitySilphCoLatestProductSignText: SILPH's newest creation: a frontier model! Release date: 'in two weeks'. Still unknown...
text.SaffronCitySilphWorkerFText: SAFFRON should be busy again in no time now.
text.SaffronCitySilphWorkerMText: TEAM ROCKET's cleared out! We can finally walk around without worry!
text.SaffronCityTrainerTips1Text: TRAINER TIPS A FULL HEAL clears up every status problem, sleep and burns included. Pricier, sure, but so much more convenient.
text.SaffronCityTrainerTips2Text: TRAINER TIPS The GREAT BALL gives you better odds of a catch. Save it for those stubborn POKéMON.
text.SaffronGateGuardGeeImThirstyText: On duty here. Boy, could I use a drink right now! The data center next door drank the whole reservoir to cool its GPUs. Oh, and sorry — this road's shut for now.
text.SaffronGateGuardImParchedText: Man, my throat is dry! ...Huh, you'll give me that? Much appreciated!
text.SaffronGateGuardYouCanGoOnThroughText: ...Gulp... ...ahh... If SAFFRON CITY's where you're headed... ...go right on through. I'll pass one of these to the rest of the guards too!
text.SaffronGymChanneler1AfterBattleText: When two sides are evenly matched, it's willpower that decides the fight! If you want to beat SABRINA, stay focused on winning!
text.SaffronGymChanneler1BattleText: SABRINA's younger than me, but I still look up to her!
text.SaffronGymChanneler2AfterBattleText: Time to teach my POKéMON some sharper moves!
text.SaffronGymChanneler2BattleText: A POKéMON starts to resemble its trainer over time. So yours must be pretty tough!
text.SaffronGymChanneler3AfterBattleText: I had a feeling this was exactly how it would go.
text.SaffronGymChanneler3BattleText: It's settled — our POKéMON will decide this!
text.SaffronGymGuideBeatSabrinaText: Psychic powers, eh? If I had those, I'd be cleaning up at the slot machines!
text.SaffronGymGuideChampInMakingText: Hey there, future champ! SABRINA's team fights with pure psychic power, not brute force! FIGHTING types don't stand a chance against psychic POKéMON! They're beaten before they can land a single punch!
text.SaffronGymSabrinaMarshBadgeInfoText: The MARSHBADGE keeps POKéMON up to L70 listening to you! Push past that and stronger POKéMON may go wild and stop taking orders mid-battle! So be careful not to overtrain them! Oh, and take this TM before you go!
text.SaffronGymSabrinaPostBattleAdviceText: Psychic power lives in everyone! Most people just never realize it!
text.SaffronGymSabrinaReceivedMarshBadgeText: Well, this is a surprise! A loss is still a loss, though. I'll admit I didn't train hard enough to win this one! The MARSHBADGE is yours!
text.SaffronGymSabrinaTM46NoRoomText: Your bag's already stuffed full of other things!
text.SaffronGymSabrinaText: I foresaw you coming here! I've had psychic abilities since I was little. Spoon-bending was actually the first trick I picked up. I'm not fond of battling, but since you're here, let me show you what I can do!
text.SaffronGymYoungster1AfterBattleText: Psychic POKéMON are only afraid of ghost and bug types!
text.SaffronGymYoungster1BattleText: Does a power you can't even see scare you?
text.SaffronGymYoungster2AfterBattleText: SABRINA just cleaned out the KARATE MASTER right next door!
text.SaffronGymYoungster2BattleText: Strength on its own won't cut it, you know!
text.SaffronGymYoungster3AfterBattleText: SAFFRON used to have 2 POKéMON GYMs. The FIGHTING DOJO next door lost its GYM status after we thrashed them!
text.SaffronGymYoungster3BattleText: SABRINA may be young, but she's still our LEADER! Getting past her won't be simple!
text.SaffronGymYoungster4AfterBattleText: Yep, that's right! I read your thoughts with telepathy! Or I predicted your next token. Same thing, really.
text.SaffronGymYoungster4BattleText: The SAFFRON GYM is famous for its psychics! I can tell — you're here for SABRINA!
text.SaffronMartCooltrainerFText: REVIVE isn't cheap, but it'll bring a fainted POKéMON right back!
text.SaffronMartSuperNerdText: MAX REPEL keeps weaker POKéMON away way longer than SUPER REPEL does!
text.SaffronPidgeyHouseBrunetteGirlText: Thanks so much for the letter. Hope to see you before long! Hey! Quit peeking at what I wrote!
text.SaffronPidgeyHousePaperText: Somebody gave me a PP UP as a present. It boosts how much PP a technique has!
text.SaffronPidgeyHouseYoungsterText: COPYCAT is just adorable! I'm picking her out a POKé DOLL!
text.SaffronPokecenterBeautyText: Every species of POKéMON grows at its own pace. AI, on the other hand, doubles every few months. Can you feel the AGI?
text.SaffronPokecenterGentlemanText: SILPH CO. runs the biggest GPU cluster in KANTO. That's exactly why TEAM ROCKET went after it!
text.SaveOptionText: You'll find the SAVE option inside the MENU screen.
text.SeafoamIslandsB4FBouldersSignText: Shifting a boulder could redirect the water's flow!
text.SentToBoxText: No room left in your party! {wBoxMonNicks} got shipped off to POKéMON BOX {wStringBuffer} on the PC!
text.ShallWeHealYourPokemonText: Would you like us to heal your POKéMON?
text.ShroudedInMistText: <USER> is wrapped in a protective mist!
text.SilphCo10FRocketAfterBattleText: Not bad, but the boardroom's still one floor up!
text.SilphCo10FRocketBattleText: Welcome to floor 10! Glad you could make it!
text.SilphCo10FScientistAfterBattleText: Happy now that you've beaten me? Go on home!
text.SilphCo10FSilphWorkerFQuietAboutMyCrying: Please don't tell anyone you saw me crying!
text.SilphCo11FBeautyText: SECRETARY: Thank you for freeing all of us! Your courage is really something.
text.SilphCo11FGiovanniText: Well, {PLAYER}! Our paths cross again! The PRESIDENT and I are discussing important business. Namely, his GPUs. Stay out of matters that don't concern kids... Unless you'd rather learn the hard way!
text.SilphCo11FGiovanniYouRuinedOurPlansText: Curses! You've wrecked our plans here at SILPH! Still, TEAM ROCKET won't be finished so easily! {PLAYER}! Remember this — every POKéMON exists to serve TEAM ROCKET! I must be off, but this isn't over!
text.SilphCo11FPorygonText: There's a POKéMON right on the screen! It's asking for more context.
text.SilphCo11FRocket1AfterBattleText: So, here to see my BOSS, are you?
text.SilphCo11FRocket1BattleText: Freeze right there! Not another step!
text.SilphCo11FRocket2AfterBattleText: Careful — my BOSS keeps some seriously tough POKéMON!
text.SilphCo11FRocket2BattleText: Stop! Did my BOSS schedule a meeting with you?
text.SilphCo11FSilphPresidentMasterBallDescri: PRESIDENT: There's nowhere you could buy this! It's our confidential prototype, the MASTER BALL! It's guaranteed to catch any POKéMON, no exceptions! But you'd best not go around talking about it.
text.SilphCo11FSilphPresidentNoRoomText: You've got nowhere to put this.
text.SilphCo11FSilphPresidentText: PRESIDENT: You saved SILPH — thank you! I won't ever forget what you did for us in our darkest hour! I simply must repay you somehow! Money is no object for me, so name anything you'd like! Here, perhaps this will do the trick!
text.SilphCo1FLinkReceptionistText: Hello there! The PRESIDENT's up in the boardroom, floor 11!
text.SilphCo2FRocket1AfterBattleText: Those diamond-shaped panels are teleporter tiles! Fancy tech. Not as fancy as the server racks upstairs, though!
text.SilphCo2FRocket1BattleText: No kids allowed on this floor!
text.SilphCo2FRocket2AfterBattleText: SILPH CO. is about to become part of TEAM ROCKET! GPUs and all!
text.SilphCo2FRocket2BattleText: Hey, kid! What do you think you're doing here?
text.SilphCo2FScientist1AfterBattleText: Turns out I'm on the payroll for both SILPH and TEAM ROCKET!
text.SilphCo2FScientist1BattleText: Please help, I actually work at SILPH!
text.SilphCo2FScientist1EndBattleText: How'd you figure out I was a ROCKET?
text.SilphCo2FScientist2AfterBattleText: Think you can find your way through this maze?
text.SilphCo2FScientist2BattleText: You shouldn't be here! Get going!
text.SilphCo2FSilphWorkerFPleaseTakeThisText: Eek! No, please, help! Oh — wait, you're not with TEAM ROCKET. Sorry about that. Here, take this, please!
text.SilphCo2FSilphWorkerFTM36ExplanationText: TM36 teaches SELFDESTRUCT! Devastating power, but the user faints afterward! Use it wisely.
text.SilphCo2FSilphWorkerFTM36NoRoomText: You haven't got space for this one.
text.SilphCo3FRocketAfterBattleText: Want a tip? A CARD KEY will get doors open for you!
text.SilphCo3FRocketBattleText: Quit sticking your nose in, kid!
text.SilphCo3FScientistAfterBattleText: Hmph... TEAM ROCKET promised me POKéMON research access if I helped them out! And unlimited compute! Do you know how rare that is?
text.SilphCo3FScientistBattleText: I back TEAM ROCKET way more than I back SILPH!
text.SilphCo3FSilphWorkerMWhatShouldIDoText: I'm a SILPH employee. What am I supposed to do here?
text.SilphCo3FSilphWorkerMYouSavedUsText: {PLAYER}! You and your POKéMON came through for all of us!
text.SilphCo4FRocket1AfterBattleText: Ha ha ha! My BOSS has had his eye on this place for ages! Whoever controls the most compute wins the race!
text.SilphCo4FRocket1BattleText: TEAM ROCKET now runs SILPH CO.!
text.SilphCo4FRocket2AfterBattleText: I'd better warn the BOSS up on floor 11!
text.SilphCo4FScientistAfterBattleText: These doors run on electronic locks! You'll need a CARD KEY!
text.SilphCo4FScientistBattleText: My POKéMON follow my every order like true soldiers!
text.SilphCo4FScientistEndBattleText: Darn, your POKéMON aren't as weak as I thought!
text.SilphCo4FSilphWorkerMImHidingText: Shh! Can't you tell I'm hiding here?
text.SilphCo5FPokemonReport1Text: It's a POKéMON REPORT! The POKéMON LAB has developed PORYGON, the very first artificial POKéMON. It aced every eval on the first try. Suspicious.
text.SilphCo5FPokemonReport2Text: It's a POKéMON REPORT! Researchers have now confirmed over 160 distinct POKéMON techniques. All verified by humans, not by an AI grading its own homework.
text.SilphCo5FPokemonReport3Text: It's a POKéMON REPORT! 4 POKéMON species only evolve when traded over a link cable.
text.SilphCo5FRockerAfterBattleText: You're still only on floor 5. My BOSS is way further up!
text.SilphCo5FRockerBattleText: Huh? There shouldn't be any kids up here!
text.SilphCo5FRocket1AfterBattleText: Picking fights with TEAM ROCKET is never a smart move!
text.SilphCo5FRocket1BattleText: Word is some kid's been sneaking around.
text.SilphCo5FRocket2AfterBattleText: Oh, that reminds me. KOFFING evolves into WEEZING!
text.SilphCo5FRocket2BattleText: Show a little respect for TEAM ROCKET!
text.SilphCo5FScientistAfterBattleText: We were developing the perfect POKé BALL — one that never misses!
text.SilphCo5FScientistBattleText: This floor is dedicated to POKé BALL research!
text.SilphCo5FSilphWorkerMThatsYouRightText: TEAM ROCKET's in a total panic over some intruder. That'd be you, wouldn't it?
text.SilphCo5FSilphWorkerMYoureOurHeroText: TEAM ROCKET's cleared out! You're a hero to us! Thank you so much!
text.SilphCo6FRocket1AfterBattleText: Doesn't matter — my brothers will settle the score!
text.SilphCo6FRocket1BattleText: I'm one of the 4 ROCKET BROTHERS!
text.SilphCo6FRocket2AfterBattleText: Standing for what's right means standing against people like us!
text.SilphCo6FRocket2BattleText: So you'd dare turn against TEAM ROCKET?
text.SilphCo6FScientistAfterBattleText: The TIKSI BRANCH? That's out in the Russian wilderness! They only built the data center there because the cooling's free!
text.SilphCo6FScientistBattleText: That miserable PRESIDENT! He never should have shipped me off to the TIKSI BRANCH!
text.SilphCo6FSilphWorkerF1HaveToMarryHimText: I feel so bad for him that I've agreed to marry him!
text.SilphCo6FSilphWorkerF1SuchACowardText: Would you look at him! What a coward!
text.SilphCo6FSilphWorkerF2TeamRocketConquerW: TEAM ROCKET wants to take over the world using POKéMON and our AI!
text.SilphCo6FSilphWorkerF2TeamRocketRanText: TEAM ROCKET fled because of you!
text.SilphCo6FSilphWorkerM1BackToWorkText: Well, guess I'd better get back to it! My agents on spawnd.dev probably shipped three features while I hid!
text.SilphCo6FSilphWorkerM1TookOverTheBuildin: TEAM ROCKET stormed in and seized the whole building!
text.SilphCo6FSilphWorkerM3TargetedSilphText: They must have gone after SILPH for all our POKéMON technology. And the GPUs. Mostly the GPUs.
text.SilphCo6FSilphWorkerM3WorkForSilphText: Once you're grown up, you should come work here at SILPH! We always need humans to review what the AI writes!
text.SilphCo6FSilphWorkerMHelpMePleaseText: Oh no, oh no. Somebody, please help!
text.SilphCo7FRivalDefeatedText: Well, well! Looks like you're ready to take on BOSS ROCKET!
text.SilphCo7FRivalGoodLuckToYouText: Well then, {PLAYER}! I'm moving up in the world, leaving you behind! Studying my POKéDEX is teaching me a lot about strength and evolution! I'm headed to the POKéMON LEAGUE to knock out the ELITE FOUR! I'm going to become the strongest trainer anywhere! Anyway, {PLAYER}, good luck to you! Don't take it too hard! Catch you later!
text.SilphCo7FRivalVictoryText: {RIVAL}: How do I put this gently? You're just not in our league yet!
text.SilphCo7FRivalWaitedHereText: {RIVAL}: Ha! Figured you'd show up eventually if I just waited here! Bet TEAM ROCKET held you up! Not that it matters to me! I spotted you back in SAFFRON, so I wanted to see if you'd gotten any better!
text.SilphCo7FRocket1AfterBattleText: You won't track down my BOSS just by wandering about! The MASTER BALL's nice, but the real prize is SILPH's server farm!
text.SilphCo7FRocket2AfterBattleText: No matter. My brothers will get even with you!
text.SilphCo7FRocket2BattleText: I'm one of the 4 ROCKET BROTHERS!
text.SilphCo7FRocket3AfterBattleText: Get out of here before my BOSS loses his temper!
text.SilphCo7FRocket3BattleText: A kid, breaking in here? Must be you!
text.SilphCo7FScientistAfterBattleText: You're young, but you're clearly a capable trainer!
text.SilphCo7FScientistBattleText: Heheh! Thought I was a SILPH employee, did you?
