text.SilphCo7FSilphWorkerM1HaveThisPokemonTex: Oh! You're not a ROCKET — you came here to rescue us? Thank you so much! Please, take this POKéMON as thanks for saving us.
text.SilphCo7FSilphWorkerM1IsOurPresidentOkTe: TEAM ROCKET's BOSS headed up to the boardroom! Is our PRESIDENT going to be all right?
text.SilphCo7FSilphWorkerM1LaprasDescriptionT: This is LAPRAS. It's remarkably smart. We've kept it here in the lab, but it deserves a life with you instead! I think you'll make a fine trainer for it! It's a strong swimmer — it can even carry you across the water!
text.SilphCo7FSilphWorkerM2AfterTheMasterBall: TEAM ROCKET was after the MASTER BALL — the one that never fails to catch a POKéMON!
text.SilphCo7FSilphWorkerM2CancelledMasterBal: We shut down the MASTER BALL project entirely, all because of TEAM ROCKET.
text.SilphCo7FSilphWorkerM3ItWouldBeBadText: It would be terrible if TEAM ROCKET got their hands on SILPH or our POKéMON!
text.SilphCo7FSilphWorkerM3YouChasedOffTeamRo: Whoa! You drove off all of TEAM ROCKET on your own?
text.SilphCo7FSilphWorkerM4ItsReallyDangerous: Hey, you! It's not safe here at all! You came to rescue me? You shouldn't have!
text.SilphCo7FSilphWorkerM4SafeAtLastText: Finally safe! Oh, thank you so much!
text.SilphCo8FRocket1AfterBattleText: Turn back now, or I'm calling in backup!
text.SilphCo8FRocket1BattleText: You're not getting any further than this!
text.SilphCo8FRocket2AfterBattleText: I'll let my brothers handle you from here!
text.SilphCo8FRocket2BattleText: I'm one of the 4 ROCKET BROTHERS!
text.SilphCo8FScientistAfterBattleText: So, what do you make of the SILPH BUILDING's maze?
text.SilphCo8FScientistBattleText: You've been nothing but trouble for us!
text.SilphCo8FSilphWorkerMSilphIsFinishedText: I wonder if SILPH is done for...
text.SilphCo9FNurseYouLookTiredText: You look exhausted! Maybe take a short rest!
text.SilphCo9FRocket1AfterBattleText: If only I'd started training at your age...
text.SilphCo9FRocket1BattleText: Your POKéMON clearly think the world of you, kid!
text.SilphCo9FRocket2AfterBattleText: My brothers will make sure you pay for this!
text.SilphCo9FRocket2BattleText: I'm one of the 4 ROCKET BROTHERS!
text.SilphCo9FScientistAfterBattleText: Targeting weaknesses really pays off! Always think about types!
text.SilphCo9FScientistBattleText: Every POKéMON has a weakness! I know exactly where to hit!
text.SilphCo9FScientistEndBattleText: You hit me right where it hurt!
text.SoYouWantPrizeText: So you'd like {wNameBuffer} , is that right?
text.SorryNeedMoreCoinsText: Sorry, you don't have enough coins.
text.StatusChangesEliminatedText: All STATUS changes were wiped out!
text.StrengthsAndWeaknessesText: Every POKéMON type has advantages and disadvantages against other types.
text.SubstituteTookDamageText: The SUBSTITUTE absorbed the damage for <TARGET>!
text.SurfingNoPlaceToGetOffText: There's nowhere here to get off!
text.TM21ExplanationText: TM21 holds MEGA DRAIN. It saps half the damage dealt to heal the user!
text.TM24ExplanationText: TM24 holds THUNDERBOLT! Pass it on to an electric POKéMON!
text.TM34ExplanationText: A TM holds a technique you can teach to a POKéMON! But each TM can only be used once, so choose the POKéMON carefully when you teach it! TM34 holds the move BIDE! Your POKéMON takes hits in battle, then strikes back for double the damage!
text.TM46ExplanationText: TM46 teaches PSYWAVE! A blast of psychic energy that damages the target!
text.TMNotebookText: It's a booklet all about TMs. ... There are 50 TMs total. There are also 5 reusable HMs. SILPH CO.
text.TeachMachineMoveText: This one holds {wStringBuffer} ! Teach {wStringBuffer}  to a POKéMON?
text.ThrowBallAtTrainerMonText1: The trainer knocked the BALL right back!
text.TooImportantToTossText: That one's much too important to throw out!
text.TooWeakSubstituteText: Not enough HP left to form a SUBSTITUTE!
text.TossHowManyText: How many do you want to throw out?
text.TrainerAboutToUseText: {wTrainerName} is getting ready to send out {wEnemyMonNick}! Should {PLAYER} switch POKéMON?
text.TryingToLearnText: {wLearnMoveMonName} wants to learn {wStringBuffer} ! But, {wLearnMoveMonName}  already knows 4 moves, the max! Forget an old move to make room for {wStringBuffer} ?
text.UndergroundPathRoute6GirlText: People are always losing things down in that UNDERGROUND PATH.
text.UndergroundPathRoute7CopyUnusedGirlText: I'd love to shop at the department store in CELADON, but... There are so many rough-looking folks hanging around there.
text.UndergroundPathRoute7CopyUnusedGoesUnder: The UNDERGROUND PATH runs beneath SAFFRON and comes out near LAVENDER. For CERULEAN, use the building across the street instead.
text.UndergroundPathRoute7CopyUnusedMiddleAge: Here to shop in CELADON? Just head outside and go west!
text.UndergroundPathRoute7CopyUnusedTeamRocke: TEAM ROCKET actually had a secret base in CELADON CITY?
text.UndergroundPathRoute7MiddleAgedManText: Word is a drowsy POKéMON's been spotted near CELADON CITY.
text.UndergroundPathRoute8GirlText: The department store in CELADON has such a fantastic selection!
text.UnusedBenchGuyText1: I sure wish I could catch some POKéMON.
text.UnusedBenchGuyText2: All this excitement really wore me out...
text.UnusedBenchGuyText3: The SILPH manager is hiding out in the SAFARI ZONE.
text.UnveiledGhostText: The SILPH SCOPE revealed who the GHOST really is!
text.VendingMachineText1: A vending machine! Take a look at the menu!
text.VendingMachineText4: Oops, you don't have enough money!
text.VendingMachineText6: You're out of room for more items!
text.VendingMachineText7: Guess you're not thirsty after all!
text.VermilionCityBeautyText: We keep a close eye on pollution here! Apparently GRIMER breeds like crazy in toxic sludge! And don't get me started on the data centers' cooling water!
text.VermilionCityGambler1DidYouSeeText: Notice the S.S. ANNE docked in the harbor?
text.VermilionCityGambler1SSAnneDepartedText: Well, the S.S.ANNE has shipped out! Won't be back for about a year now.
text.VermilionCityGambler2Text: I'm putting up a new building on this lot. A data center! My POKéMON is flattening out the ground for it. The one worker I can't automate!
text.VermilionCityGymSignText: VERMILION CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: LT.SURGE The Lightning American!
text.VermilionCityMachopStompingTheLandFlatTe: A MACHOP is pounding the ground flat.
text.VermilionCityNoticeSignText: NOTICE! ROUTE 12 may currently be blocked by a sleeping POKéMON. Use ROCK TUNNEL as a detour to reach LAVENDER TOWN. VERMILION POLICE
text.VermilionCityPokecenterBenchGuyText: Sure, a higher-level POKéMON hits harder... But every POKéMON has types it's weak against. So no single POKéMON is strong against everything. Same goes for AI models, whatever the benchmarks say!
text.VermilionCityPokemonFanClubSignText: POKéMON FAN CLUB Every POKéMON fan is welcome!
text.VermilionCitySailor1DoYouHaveATicketText: Step aboard the S.S. ANNE! Pardon me, could I see your ticket?
text.VermilionCitySailor1FlashedTicketText: {PLAYER} held up the S.S.TICKET! Wonderful! Enjoy your trip on the S.S.ANNE!
text.VermilionCitySailor1ShipSetSailText: The ship has already left port.
text.VermilionCitySailor1YouNeedATicketText: {PLAYER} doesn't have an S.S.TICKET. Apologies! A ticket's required to board.
text.VermilionCitySailor2Text: The S.S.ANNE is a well-known luxury liner. It calls at VERMILION once every year.
text.VermilionCitySignText: VERMILION CITY Harbor of Beautiful Sunsets
text.VermilionGymGentlemanAfterBattleText: The door won't budge? That's LT.SURGE for you — always careful!
text.VermilionGymGentlemanBattleText: Back in my Army days, LT.SURGE was my no-nonsense commanding officer!
text.VermilionGymGymGuideBeatLTSurgeText: Whew! Now that was an electrifying match!
text.VermilionGymGymGuideChampInMakingText: Hey, future champ! LT.SURGE goes by a nickname — folks call him the Lightning American! He knows electric POKéMON inside and out! Flying and water types are in real danger! Watch for paralysis too! LT.SURGE never takes chances, though. You'll need to crack a code before you can even reach him!
text.VermilionGymLTSurgePostBattleAdviceText: Here's some free advice, kid! Electricity packs a serious punch! But it won't do a thing against ground-type POKéMON!
text.VermilionGymLTSurgePreBattleText: Hey, kid! What do you think you're doing in here? You won't last long against me, that's for sure! I'll let you in on something — electric POKéMON pulled me through the war! They left my enemies paralyzed on the spot! And I'll do the exact same to you!
text.VermilionGymLTSurgeReceivedThunderBadgeT: Whoa! You've got the real skill, kid! All right then, here's the THUNDERBADGE!
text.VermilionGymLTSurgeTM24NoRoomText: Hey kid, clear out some space in that pack!
text.VermilionGymLTSurgeThunderBadgeInfoText: The THUNDERBADGE boosts your POKéMON's SPEED stat! It also lets your POKéMON use FLY whenever you want, kid! You've got real talent, kid! Here, take this!
text.VermilionGymSailorAfterBattleText: LT.SURGE rigged up two locks! Here's a hint for you! Open the first lock, and the second one's right beside it!
text.VermilionGymSuperNerdAfterBattleText: Fine, I'll spill it! LT.SURGE hid the door switches inside something!
text.VermilionGymSuperNerdBattleText: I may not look it, but I know my way around electricity!
text.VermilionGymTrashFailText: Nope, just trash here. Uh-oh, the electric locks reset themselves!
text.VermilionGymTrashSuccessText1: Hey, there's a switch hidden under the trash! Flip it! The first electric lock just opened!
text.VermilionGymTrashSuccessText2: Hey, another switch under this trash! Flip it!
text.VermilionGymTrashSuccessText3: The second electric lock just opened! The automatic door swung open!
text.VermilionMartCooltrainerFText: I believe POKéMON themselves are neither good nor evil. It all comes down to the trainer. I feel the same way about AI, honestly.
text.VermilionMartCooltrainerMText: There are unscrupulous people out there who exploit POKéMON for crime. TEAM ROCKET deals in rare POKéMON on the black market. They also dump POKéMON they decide aren't popular or useful enough.
text.VermilionOldRodHouseFishingGuruDoYouLike: I'm the FISHING GURU around here! I absolutely adore fishing! So, do you enjoy it too?
text.VermilionOldRodHouseFishingGuruFishingIs: Fishing isn't just a hobby, it's a way of life! Whether it's the ocean or a river, go land yourself a big one, kiddo!
text.VermilionOldRodHouseFishingGuruHowAreThe: Well hello, {PLAYER}! How's the fishing treating you?
text.VermilionOldRodHouseFishingGuruNoRoomTex: Oh dear! There's no room in your bag for my gift!
text.VermilionOldRodHouseFishingGuruTakeThisT: Wonderful! I like the way you think! Here, take this and get out there and fish, kiddo! {PLAYER} received an {wStringBuffer} !
text.VermilionPidgeyHouseLetterText: Dear PIPPI, hope to see you again soon. I heard SAFFRON's been having trouble with TEAM ROCKET. VERMILION seems to be doing fine, though.
text.VermilionPidgeyHouseYoungsterText: I'm training my PIDGEY to carry a letter all the way up to SAFFRON! E-mail? No way. An AI would just summarize it into nothing!
text.VermilionPokecenterFishingGuruText: Two POKéMON at the same level can still have wildly different strength. One raised by a trainer will always outclass a wild one.
text.VermilionPokecenterGuyText: Sure, a higher-level POKéMON hits harder... But every POKéMON has types it's weak against. So no single POKéMON is strong against everything. Same goes for AI models, whatever the benchmarks say!
text.VermilionPokecenterSailorText: My POKéMON got poisoned and collapsed right in the middle of our walk!
text.VictoryRoad1FCooltrainerFAfterBattleText: I never wanted to lose to anyone, ever!
text.VictoryRoad1FCooltrainerFBattleText: Let's see if you're really good enough for me!
text.VictoryRoad1FCooltrainerMAfterBattleText: I have to admit, you're better than I am!
text.VictoryRoad1FCooltrainerMBattleText: You look skilled! Let's find out exactly how skilled!
text.VictoryRoad2FCooltrainerMAfterBattleText: You've proven you belong on VICTORY ROAD!
text.VictoryRoad2FCooltrainerMBattleText: Bring it on! I'll take you apart!
text.VictoryRoad2FHikerAfterBattleText: Stuck somewhere? Try shifting a few boulders around!
text.VictoryRoad2FHikerBattleText: VICTORY ROAD is where every trainer faces their toughest test!
text.VictoryRoad2FSuperNerd1BattleText: Ah, so you're here to take on the ELITE FOUR?
text.VictoryRoad2FSuperNerd1EndBattleText: You beat me fair and square!
text.VictoryRoad2FSuperNerd2AfterBattleText: When it comes to POKéMON knowledge, I've still got you beat! I memorized the whole benchmark!
text.VictoryRoad2FSuperNerd2BattleText: Make it through here, and the ELITE FOUR await!
text.VictoryRoad2FSuperNerd3AfterBattleText: Plenty of trainers turn back right around here.
text.VictoryRoad2FSuperNerd3BattleText: Finding VICTORY ROAD a bit much?
text.VictoryRoad3FCooltrainerF1AfterBattleTex: You just showed me exactly how good I really was!
text.VictoryRoad3FCooltrainerF1BattleText: I'll find out exactly how good you really are!
text.VictoryRoad3FCooltrainerF2AfterBattleTex: Fighting hard battles is exactly how you grow stronger.
text.VictoryRoad3FCooltrainerF2BattleText: A true trainer always craves a tougher opponent!
text.VictoryRoad3FCooltrainerM1AfterBattleTex: Wait, you actually beat GIOVANNI of TEAM ROCKET?
text.VictoryRoad3FCooltrainerM1BattleText: I've heard whispers about some kind of child prodigy!
text.VictoryRoad3FCooltrainerM2AfterBattleTex: Every trainer here is bound for the POKéMON LEAGUE! Stay sharp!
text.VictoryRoad3FCooltrainerM2BattleText: Only the truly worthy get past this point!
text.ViridianBlackboardBurnText: Being burned lowers power and speed, and deals damage over time. The burn persists after battle. Use BURN HEAL to cure it!
text.ViridianBlackboardFrozenText: A frozen POKéMON can't move at all! It remains frozen even after the battle is done. Use ICE HEAL to thaw it!
text.ViridianBlackboardPoisonText: A poisoned POKéMON loses HP little by little. The poison sticks around after battle too. Use an ANTIDOTE to cure it!
text.ViridianBlackboardPrlzText: Paralysis can cause a POKéMON's moves to fail! It stays paralyzed after battle as well. Use PARLYZ HEAL to treat it!
text.ViridianBlackboardSleepText: A sleeping POKéMON can't attack! It'll remain asleep even once the battle's over. Use AWAKENING to rouse it!
text.ViridianCityFisherYouCanHaveThisText: Yawwn! Must've nodded off in the sunshine. Had this odd dream about a DROWZEE devouring it. Huh? Where'd this TM come from? That's kind of eerie! Anyway, here, it's yours.
text.ViridianCityGambler1GymAlwaysClosedText: This POKéMON GYM never seems to open up. I wonder who's actually in charge of it?
text.ViridianCityGambler1GymLeaderReturnedTex: The VIRIDIAN GYM's LEADER is finally back!
text.ViridianCityGirlHasntHadHisCoffeeYetText: Oh, Grandpa! Don't be so grumpy! He hasn't even had his coffee yet.
text.ViridianCityGirlWhenIGoShopText: Whenever I go shopping over in PEWTER CITY, I have to cut through that winding path in VIRIDIAN FOREST.
text.ViridianCityOldManHadMyCoffeeNowText: Ahh, coffee's finally in my system and I feel fantastic! Go right ahead through here! In a rush about something?
text.ViridianCityOldManKnowHowToCatchPokemonT: I notice you've got a POKéDEX there. Catching a POKéMON updates it automatically. What, you don't actually know how to catch one? Let me walk you through it, then.
text.ViridianCityOldManSleepyPrivatePropertyT: You can't pass through here! This land is private!
text.ViridianCityOldManTimeIsMoneyText: Time's money, friend... off you go.
text.ViridianCityOldManYouNeedToWeakenTheTarg: Step one — wear the wild POKéMON down first.
text.ViridianCityPokecenterBenchGuyText: A POKéMON CENTER will fully heal your exhausted, injured, or fainted POKéMON!
text.ViridianCityPokecenterGuyText: A POKéMON CENTER will fully heal your exhausted, injured, or fainted POKéMON!
text.ViridianCityTrainerTips1Text: TRAINER TIPS Catch POKéMON to grow your collection! A bigger team makes battles a whole lot easier!
text.ViridianCityTrainerTips2Text: TRAINER TIPS Every move a POKéMON knows draws from its own POWER POINTs, or PP. Rest at a POKéMON CENTER to refill your tired POKéMON's PP!
text.ViridianCityYoungster1Text: Those POKé BALLs on your belt! You're a real trainer! Must be nice being able to bring your POKéMON along everywhere!
text.ViridianCityYoungster2CaterpieAndWeedleD: CATERPIE isn't venomous, but WEEDLE sure is. Mind that POISON STING of its!
text.ViridianCityYoungster2YouWantToKnowAbout: Curious about the two kinds of caterpillar POKéMON?
text.ViridianForestLeavingSignText: LEAVING VIRIDIAN FOREST PEWTER CITY AHEAD
text.ViridianForestNorthGateGrampsText: Notice those bushes along the road? A certain POKéMON move can slice right through them.
text.ViridianForestNorthGateSuperNerdText: Plenty of POKéMON only turn up in forests and caves. You'll need to search everywhere to round up every kind!
text.ViridianForestSouthGateGirlText: Heading into VIRIDIAN FOREST? Careful, it's a real maze in there!
text.ViridianForestSouthGateLittleGirlText: RATTATA's tiny, but its bite is nasty! Have you nabbed one yet?
text.ViridianForestTrainerTips1Text: TRAINER TIPS Want to dodge battles? Steer clear of the tall grass!
text.ViridianForestTrainerTips2Text: TRAINER TIPS Call PROF.OAK over the PC to have your POKéDEX rated!
text.ViridianForestTrainerTips3Text: TRAINER TIPS Never swipe POKéMON from other trainers! Only wild ones are fair game!
text.ViridianForestTrainerTips4Text: TRAINER TIPS Wear a POKéMON down before you try catching it! Full-health POKéMON tend to slip away!
text.ViridianForestUseAntidoteSignText: Poisoned? Reach for an ANTIDOTE! POKéMON MARTs carry them!
text.ViridianForestYoungster1Text: I came out here with a few friends! They're all off looking for POKéMON battles!
text.ViridianForestYoungster2AfterBattleText: Shh! Keep it down, you'll scare off the bugs!
text.ViridianForestYoungster2BattleText: Hey, you've got POKéMON! Let's throw down and battle!
text.ViridianForestYoungster2EndBattleText: Aw! CATERPIE just wasn't up to it!
text.ViridianForestYoungster3AfterBattleText: Ugh! Time to go find some tougher POKéMON!
text.ViridianForestYoungster3BattleText: Hey! No slacking off if you're a real POKéMON trainer!
text.ViridianForestYoungster4AfterBattleText: Sometimes you'll spot things lying on the ground! I'm out here hunting for the stuff I dropped, actually!
text.ViridianForestYoungster4BattleText: Whoa there, hold up! Where are you rushing off to?
text.ViridianForestYoungster4EndBattleText: I concede! You've got real skill!
text.ViridianForestYoungster5Text: I've completely run out of POKé BALLs for catching! Always carry spares, trust me!
text.ViridianGymCooltrainerM1AfterBattleText: You'll need serious power to keep pace with our GYM LEADER!
text.ViridianGymCooltrainerM1BattleText: Heh! Bet you're running low on energy by now!
text.ViridianGymCooltrainerM2AfterBattleText: The LEADER's going to have words with me over this!
text.ViridianGymCooltrainerM2BattleText: Real talent wins battles with style!
text.ViridianGymCooltrainerM3AfterBattleText: Only by beating our GYM LEADER can you move on to the POKéMON LEAGUE!
text.ViridianGymCooltrainerM3BattleText: VIRIDIAN GYM sat shut for ages, but our LEADER's finally returned!
text.ViridianGymGiovanniEarthBadgeInfoText: The EARTHBADGE makes any POKéMON obey you, no matter its level! It's proof that you've truly mastered POKéMON training! With it, the POKéMON LEAGUE is open to you! Consider it my gift for the challenge ahead!
text.ViridianGymGiovanniPostBattleAdviceText: Defeated like this, I can't show my face to my own men! TEAM ROCKET is done for good! From here on, I'll devote myself to studying POKéMON instead! Perhaps our paths will cross again someday! Farewell!
text.ViridianGymGiovanniPreBattleText: Ha ha ha! Welcome to my hideout! This is where I meant to rebuild TEAM ROCKET from the ground up! But once again, you've tracked me down! Fine then! No more holding back this time! Prepare to face GIOVANNI, greatest of all trainers, once more!
text.ViridianGymGiovanniReceivedEarthBadgeTex: Heh! Now that was a genuinely fierce battle! You've earned this. Here's the EARTHBADGE!
text.ViridianGymGiovanniTM27ExplanationText: TM27 holds FISSURE! One hit is all it takes to knock a POKéMON out cold! I put that one together back when I still ran this GYM myself...
text.ViridianGymGiovanniTM27NoRoomText: There's nowhere left in your bag for this!
text.ViridianGymGuidePostBattleText: Well, knock me over! GIOVANNI was the GYM LEADER here the whole time?
text.ViridianGymGuidePreBattleText: Hey! Future champ! Even I don't know who's really behind the VIRIDIAN LEADER mask! This is shaping up to be the hardest GYM of them all! Word is these trainers favor ground-type POKéMON!
text.ViridianGymHiker1AfterBattleText: Still not good enough, it seems!
text.ViridianGymHiker1BattleText: Grrraaah! Feel that fury building up in me!
text.ViridianGymHiker2AfterBattleText: If only my POKéMON had my skill at Karate...
text.ViridianGymHiker2BattleText: Karate stands above every other martial art!
text.ViridianGymHiker3AfterBattleText: The POKéMON LEAGUE? You? Don't get ahead of yourself!
text.ViridianGymHiker3BattleText: Call me the KARATE KING! Your future is in my hands!
text.ViridianGymRocker1AfterBattleText: Any idea who our GYM LEADER actually is?
text.ViridianGymRocker1BattleText: My POKéMON and I make beautiful music together!
text.ViridianGymRocker1EndBattleText: What perfect harmony you two have!
text.ViridianGymRocker2AfterBattleText: Hold on! I just got careless there!
text.ViridianGymRocker2BattleText: One crack of my whip and your POKéMON will cower!
text.ViridianMartClerkParcelQuestText: You're acquainted with PROF. OAK, right? His shipment just arrived. Mind delivering it to him? {PLAYER} got OAK's PARCEL!
text.ViridianMartClerkSayHiToOakText: Sure thing! Send my regards to PROF.OAK!
text.ViridianMartClerkYouCameFromPalletTownTe: Oh hey! You're from PALLET TOWN, aren't you?
text.ViridianMartCooltrainerMText: Darn, they're completely out of POTIONs. First GPUs, now POTIONs. Is everything sold out these days?
text.ViridianMartYoungsterText: This place stocks plenty of ANTIDOTEs.
text.ViridianNicknameHouseBaldingGuyText: Thinking up nicknames is a blast, but it's tougher than it looks. Simple ones tend to stick in your memory best. Unlike AI model names. 'MAGIKARP-4o-mini-high'? Who remembers that?
text.ViridianNicknameHouseLittleGirlText: My dad's a huge POKéMON fan too.
text.ViridianPokecenterCooltrainerMText: You'll find a POKéMON CENTER in every town from here on. Best part is, they're completely free!
text.ViridianPokecenterGentlemanText: Feel free to use that PC over in the corner. The receptionist mentioned it to me. Awfully kind of her!
text.ViridianSchoolBlackboardText1: The blackboard explains the STATUS conditions POKéMON can get during battle.
text.ViridianSchoolBlackboardText2: Which topic do you want to look at?
text.ViridianSchoolHouseBrunetteGirlText: Whew, I'm doing my best to cram all these notes into my head. My context window is only so big, you know!
text.ViridianSchoolHouseCooltrainerFText: All right! Make sure you read everything on the blackboard closely! And no asking a chatbot to summarize it for you!
text.ViridianSchoolNotebookText1: You looked through the notebook! Page one... POKé BALLs are what you use to catch POKéMON. You can carry up to 6 POKéMON at once. Those who raise POKéMON and battle with them are known as POKéMON trainers.
text.ViridianSchoolNotebookText2: Page two... A fully healthy POKéMON can be tough to catch, so wear it down first! Poisoning, burning, and other damage all help!
text.ViridianSchoolNotebookText3: Page three... POKéMON trainers look for others to battle against. POKéMON GYMs are always hosting fights.
text.ViridianSchoolNotebookText4: Page four... A POKéMON trainer's goal is to defeat all 8 POKéMON GYM LEADERs. Doing so earns you the right to challenge... The ELITE FOUR of the POKéMON LEAGUE!
text.ViridianSchoolNotebookText5: GIRL: Hey, quit peeking at my notes!
text.WannaTrade1Text: I'm after a {wInGameTradeGiveMonName} ! Care to trade one for my {wInGameTradeReceiveMonName} ?
text.WannaTrade2Text: Hey there! Fancy swapping your {wInGameTradeGiveMonName} for my {wInGameTradeReceiveMonName} ?
text.WannaTrade3Text: Hiya! Got yourself a {wInGameTradeGiveMonName} ? Want to swap it for my {wInGameTradeReceiveMonName} ?
text.WardensHouseWardenGaveTheGoldTeethText: {PLAYER} handed the GOLD TEETH over to the WARDEN!
text.WardensHouseWardenGibberish1Text: WARDEN: Mmff fmm mmmuffoo! Muh loff muh feef muh mubbafuh moo. Muff moo fwee!
text.WardensHouseWardenGibberish2Text: Muh mowmee moo moo! Eef ee mubbafuh moo!
text.WardensHouseWardenGibberish3Text: Muh? Muh omuh muh muh moo ee mumuh!
text.WardensHouseWardenHM04ExplanationText: WARDEN: HM04 teaches STRENGTH! Outside of battle, it lets a POKéMON shove boulders out of the way. Oh, by the way — did you happen to find the SECRET HOUSE in the SAFARI ZONE? Find it and you'll walk away with a free HM! I hear it's that rare SURF one.
text.WardensHouseWardenHM04NoRoomText: Your bag is packed to the brim!
text.WardensHouseWardenTeethPoppedInHisTeethT: The WARDEN popped his teeth right back in!
text.WardensHouseWardenThanksText: WARDEN: Much obliged, kid! Not one person could make sense of what I was saying. I was useless like that. Let me make it up to you somehow.
text.WarpToLastPokemonCenterText: Warps you back to the last POKéMON CENTER you visited.
text.WhatDoYouWantText: What would you like to do?
text.WhatGoesAroundComesAroundText: What you dish out comes back to you!
text.WhatToDepositText: What would you like to deposit?
text.WhatToTossText: What would you like to throw away?
text.WhatToWithdrawText: What would you like to withdraw?
text.WhenYouChangeBoxText: Switching POKéMON BOXes will save your data automatically. Is that all right?
text.WhereWouldYouLikeText: Where do you want to go?
text.WithdrawHowManyText: How many do you want to take?
text.WouldYouLikeToSaveText: Would you like to SAVE your progress?
text.WrongMon1Text: Huh? That's not {wInGameTradeGiveMonName} ! Come find me again once you've got one!
text.WrongMon2Text: Hmm? This one isn't {wInGameTradeGiveMonName} . Keep me in mind once you find one.
text.WrongMon3Text: ...Nope, that's not {wInGameTradeGiveMonName} . Bring it here once you get one!
text.YourNameIsText: Got it! Your name is {PLAYER}, then!

dex.ABRA: ABRA can sense danger approaching by peering into the minds of those around it. The instant it senses trouble, it TELEPORTs to safety, often before a fight even begins.
dex.AERODACTYL: AERODACTYL is a vicious POKéMON revived from ancient times. It lunges straight for an opponent's throat with its jagged, saw-edged fangs.
dex.ALAKAZAM: ALAKAZAM's mind processes information faster than any supercomputer. Its IQ is said to reach 5,000, and it can count the R's in STRAWBERRY.
dex.ARBOK: ARBOK flashes intimidating markings across its belly to warn enemies away. Locals claim the exact pattern differs depending on where the POKéMON lives.
dex.ARCANINE: ARCANINE has long been admired for its striking, elegant appearance. It gallops with such grace that it seems to glide as if carried on wings.
dex.ARTICUNO: ARTICUNO is a legendary bird POKéMON said to reveal itself only to travelers stranded and freezing in snowbound mountains. Sighting it is treated as an omen by those who climb.
dex.BEEDRILL: BEEDRILL darts through the air at tremendous speed. It strikes with the poison-tipped stingers mounted on its forelegs and tail.
dex.BELLSPROUT: BELLSPROUT is a carnivorous POKéMON that snares insects before devouring them. Its rooted feet draw up whatever moisture it needs straight from the soil.
dex.BLASTOISE: BLASTOISE fires pressurized jets of water from the twin cannons on its shell. It rides the resulting thrust to slam into foes at high speed.
dex.BULBASAUR: BULBASAUR hatches with a mysterious seed lodged on its back. Over the years, the seed sprouts and grows steadily in step with the POKéMON itself.
dex.BUTTERFREE: BUTTERFREE beats its wings at a furious pace during battle. The motion scatters a cloud of highly poisonous scale dust into the air around it.
dex.CATERPIE: CATERPIE's stubby feet end in tiny suction pads. They let it scale steep slopes and sheer walls without ever seeming to tire.
dex.CHANSEY: CHANSEY is an uncommon, hard-to-find POKéMON. Folklore holds that good fortune follows any trainer lucky enough to catch one.
dex.CHARIZARD: CHARIZARD breathes flames scorching enough to melt solid boulders. Its fiery breath has occasionally started forest fires by accident.
dex.CHARMANDER: CHARMANDER clearly favors warm climates and struggles in the cold. Whenever rain falls, wisps of steam are said to rise from the tip of its tail.
dex.CHARMELEON: CHARMELEON lashes its blazing tail when agitated. A single swing can push the surrounding air to almost unbearably high temperatures.
dex.CLEFABLE: CLEFABLE is a bashful, fairy-like POKéMON seldom glimpsed by anyone. The moment it senses a person nearby, it darts off to hide.
dex.CLEFAIRY: CLEFAIRY's charming, almost magical look has won it countless admirers. It remains rare, turning up only in a handful of locations.
dex.CLOYSTER: CLOYSTER fires its sharp horns in rapid volleys whenever it comes under attack. No one has ever managed to glimpse what lies inside its sealed shell.
dex.CUBONE: CUBONE wears the skull of its departed mother as a permanent helmet. Because it is never taken off, no one has ever seen this POKéMON's actual face.
dex.DEWGONG: DEWGONG stockpiles thermal energy within its body to stay warm. It can hold a steady pace of 8 knots even while swimming through frigid seas.
dex.DIGLETT: DIGLETT burrows roughly a yard beneath the surface, feeding on plant roots it finds there. It occasionally pokes its head above ground to look around.
dex.DITTO: DITTO can analyze an opponent's genetic code in an instant, then reshape itself into a near-perfect copy. Researchers call this distillation.
dex.DODRIO: DODRIO coordinates complex tactics using its three separate brains. While two of its heads rest, the third always stays alert on watch.
dex.DODUO: DODUO isn't much of a flier, but it more than makes up for it with remarkable running speed. Its powerful strides leave behind unusually large footprints.
dex.DRAGONAIR: DRAGONAIR is a mystical POKéMON wrapped in a calm, gentle aura. It is said to hold the power to alter the weather around it.
dex.DRAGONITE: DRAGONITE is rarely encountered, favoring a life spent out in the open ocean. Its intelligence is said to rival that of a human being.
dex.DRATINI: DRATINI was regarded as a mythical POKéMON for generations. That changed only recently, when a small colony was discovered living beneath the waves.
dex.DROWZEE: DROWZEE lulls its enemies to sleep and then feeds on their dreams. Occasionally it falls ill after swallowing an especially unpleasant nightmare.
dex.DUGTRIO: DUGTRIO forms when three DIGLETT fuse together underground. Burrowing as deep as 60 miles, it can trigger massive earthquakes on the surface above.
dex.EEVEE: EEVEE carries an unusually unstable genetic code. Exposure to the radiation given off by certain element STONEs can trigger it to suddenly mutate.
dex.EKANS: EKANS slithers along in near-total silence to avoid detection. It swallows whole the eggs of birds such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW.
dex.ELECTABUZZ: ELECTABUZZ is typically drawn to areas surrounding power plants. When it strays as far as a city, it can trigger widespread blackouts.
dex.ELECTRODE: ELECTRODE keeps a charge of electricity compressed inside its body under intense pressure. The slightest disturbance can be enough to set off a violent explosion.
dex.EXEGGCUTE: EXEGGCUTE is frequently mistaken for a cluster of ordinary eggs. If disturbed, the group quickly clusters together and swarms the intruder.
dex.EXEGGUTOR: EXEGGUTOR is unusual for growing several heads atop its towering body. Legend claims that, on rare occasions, one head falls away and carries on its own life as an EXEGGCUTE.
dex.FARFETCHD: FARFETCH'D never goes anywhere without the sprig of green onions it carries. It wields the stalk skillfully in battle, much like a trainer swinging a sword.
dex.FEAROW: FEAROW spreads a pair of huge, magnificent wings that keep it airborne for long stretches. It can stay aloft for extended periods without ever needing to land and rest.
dex.FLAREON: FLAREON stockpiles thermal energy inside its fluffy coat, and when it taps that reserve its internal temperature can spike past 1600 degrees. That stored heat fuels its fiery attacks.
dex.GASTLY: Almost impossible to see, this gaseous POKéMON envelops its target in a thick cloud and puts it to sleep before the victim even notices it is there.
dex.GENGAR: On nights with a full moon, GENGAR likes to hide inside people's shadows and mimic their movements, delighting in the fright it gives them when they notice.
dex.GEODUDE: Scattered across fields and mountainsides, GEODUDE looks so much like an ordinary rock that hikers frequently trip over it or use it as a stepping stone without realizing.
dex.GLOOM: The thick fluid dripping from GLOOM's mouth is not saliva. It is a sweet-smelling nectar the POKéMON produces to lure prey in close.
dex.GOLBAT: Once GOLBAT fastens onto a target, it keeps draining energy without pause, even after gorging itself so full that flying becomes a struggle.
dex.GOLDEEN: Its flowing tail fin ripples like a fine ballroom gown as it swims, which is how GOLDEEN earned its nickname, the Water Queen.
dex.GOLDUCK: GOLDUCK is often spotted gliding gracefully along lake shores, and its elegant form has led people to mistake it for the legendary Japanese water spirit, the kappa.
dex.GOLEM: GOLEM's rocky shell is so tough that it can shrug off a stick of dynamite without taking any real damage.
dex.GRAVELER: To get around, GRAVELER simply tumbles down hillsides, rolling straight through anything in its path without losing speed or changing course.
dex.GRIMER: GRIMER thrives in filthy surroundings, settling near factories so it can feed on the polluted sludge being pumped out.
dex.GROWLITHE: Fiercely loyal to its home ground, GROWLITHE barks and snaps at anyone who wanders too close, chasing off intruders without hesitation.
dex.GYARADOS: Wild GYARADOS are rarely encountered, but when one is provoked, its size and fury are enough to level an entire city.
dex.HAUNTER: HAUNTER can slip clean through solid walls, a trick that has convinced many people it must come from some other dimension entirely.
dex.HITMONCHAN: HITMONCHAN throws punches in blindingly fast combinations, landing so many blows so quickly that its fists appear to be standing still.
dex.HITMONLEE: When it needs to move fast, HITMONLEE's legs stretch out longer than usual, letting it cover ground with smooth, extended strides.
dex.HORSEA: HORSEA is known to pick flying insects out of the air, firing precise jets of ink up from just below the water's surface.
dex.HYPNO: Once HYPNO locks eyes with an opponent, it layers on psychic attacks such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION until the target can no longer resist.
dex.IVYSAUR: As the bud on IVYSAUR's back grows larger and heavier, the POKéMON starts to have real trouble standing upright on its hind legs.
dex.JIGGLYPUFF: When JIGGLYPUFF's round eyes begin to glow, it hums an eerily gentle tune that lulls anyone listening straight into a deep sleep.
dex.JOLTEON: JOLTEON pulls negative ions out of the surrounding air, then discharges the buildup as lightning bolts reaching up to 10,000 volts.
dex.JYNX: JYNX sways its hips rhythmically as it walks, and the motion is oddly contagious, with onlookers often swaying right along with it.
dex.KABUTO: KABUTO is a POKéMON revived from an ancient fossil, one dug up from ground that used to lie beneath the ocean floor millions of years ago.
dex.KABUTOPS: Built for speed in the water, KABUTOPS slashes at prey with its sharp claws and drains the fluids from their bodies.
dex.KADABRA: KADABRA gives off unusual alpha waves that are strong enough to leave anyone standing nearby with a pounding headache.
dex.KAKUNA: Barely able to move at all, KAKUNA's only real defense is to harden its shell and wait out whatever danger is near.
dex.KANGASKHAN: A KANGASKHAN infant stays tucked safely inside its mother's pouch and rarely climbs out until it turns three years old.
dex.KINGLER: KINGLER's oversized pincer can crush with roughly 10,000 hp of force, though its sheer size makes it clumsy to swing around.
dex.KOFFING: KOFFING keeps a mix of toxic gases bottled up inside its body, which leaves it prone to bursting without any warning at all.
dex.KRABBY: KRABBY's pincers aren't only for fighting. It also relies on them to keep its balance while shuffling around sideways.
dex.LAPRAS: Decades of overhunting have pushed LAPRAS to the edge of extinction, though it still gently ferries people across open water when asked.
dex.LICKITUNG: LICKITUNG's tongue stretches out like a chameleon's, and its lick leaves behind a lingering, tingling sensation wherever it lands.
dex.MACHAMP: MACHAMP's dense muscles let it throw punches powerful enough to send an opponent flying clear over the horizon.
dex.MACHOKE: MACHOKE's muscles are so overdeveloped that it must wear a power-restricting belt just to keep its own movements under control.
dex.MACHOP: MACHOP is obsessed with getting stronger, drilling constantly in every style of martial arts it can get its hands on.
dex.MAGIKARP: Fossil evidence suggests MAGIKARP's ancestors were once considerably tougher than the famously feeble version that swims around today.
dex.MAGMAR: MAGMAR's body gives off a constant orange glow, letting it blend in almost perfectly whenever it is surrounded by open flame.
dex.MAGNEMITE: MAGNEMITE hovers using anti-gravity, and it tends to ambush targets out of nowhere with moves like THUNDER WAVE.
dex.MAGNETON: MAGNETON forms when several MAGNEMITE link themselves together into one body. Sightings of it tend to spike whenever solar activity flares up.
dex.MANKEY: MANKEY's temper is a hair-trigger. It can seem perfectly calm one second and be thrashing wildly the next.
dex.MAROWAK: The bone MAROWAK carries is its signature weapon, and it can hurl it with boomerang precision to knock out a target from a distance.
dex.MEOWTH: MEOWTH has a weakness for anything round and shiny, and it prowls the streets after dark hunting for loose coins people have dropped.
dex.METAPOD: While its shell is still soft, METAPOD is defenseless, leaving its frail, tender body exposed to anything that attacks it.
dex.MEW: MEW is so seldom encountered that many researchers treat sightings of it as rumor. Its genes are said to hold the base model of every POKéMON.
dex.MEWTWO: MEWTWO came into being after years of gene splicing and unsettling DNA experiments. Its creators never managed to align it.
dex.MOLTRES: Revered as the legendary bird of fire, MOLTRES sends out a brilliant burst of flame with every beat of its wings.
dex.MR_MIME: If someone breaks its concentration mid-performance, MR. MIME will swat at the interruption with its broad, flat hands.
dex.MUK: MUK is coated in a thick layer of foul, toxic sludge, and the poison runs so deep that even its footprints are dangerous to touch.
dex.NIDOKING: In battle, NIDOKING relies on its powerful tail, using it to smash into an opponent, wrap them up, and snap their bones.
dex.NIDOQUEEN: NIDOQUEEN's hard scales give it excellent protection, and it puts its considerable bulk to work behind its heaviest attacks.
dex.NIDORAN_F: Small as it is, NIDORAN♀ carries venomous barbs that make it more dangerous than it looks; the female's horns stay noticeably shorter than the male's.
dex.NIDORAN_M: NIDORAN♂ stiffens its ears to pick up on nearby danger, and the bigger its horns grow, the stronger the venom it can secrete.
dex.NIDORINA: The female's horn takes a long time to develop, so NIDORINA tends to fall back on physical attacks like clawing and biting instead.
dex.NIDORINO: A quick-tempered, aggressive POKéMON, NIDORINO carries a horn that secretes a potent venom, and it rarely waits long before striking.
dex.NINETALES: NINETALES is both clever and unforgiving; legend holds that pulling on one of its nine tails invites a curse lasting a thousand years.
dex.ODDISH: ODDISH keeps its face buried in the soil throughout the day, only coming out after dark to wander about scattering its seeds.
dex.OMANYTE: Long extinct in the wild, OMANYTE can, in rare cases, be brought back through genetic restoration from a fossil.
dex.OMASTAR: This prehistoric POKéMON is believed to have died out because its own heavy shell eventually made it too slow to catch prey.
dex.ONIX: As ONIX ages, the rocky sections of its body harden further, taking on a texture close to diamond, though colored a deep black.
dex.PARAS: PARAS burrows underground to feed on tree roots, and the mushrooms sprouting from its back grow by drawing nutrients straight out of its bug host.
dex.PARASECT: PARASECT is really a bug host that has been fully taken over by the parasitic mushroom on its back, and it favors damp, shaded places.
dex.PERSIAN: Its lustrous fur draws plenty of admirers, but PERSIAN's fickle, ill-tempered nature makes it a difficult POKéMON to keep as a pet.
dex.PIDGEOT: While hunting, PIDGEOT skims low and fast across open water to snatch up unsuspecting prey like MAGIKARP.
dex.PIDGEOTTO: Fiercely territorial, PIDGEOTTO will peck viciously at anything that dares wander into its wide claimed range.
dex.PIDGEY: A familiar sight across forests and woodland, PIDGEY flies low to the ground and beats its wings to throw up a blinding cloud of sand.
dex.PIKACHU: When a number of PIKACHU gather in one place, the electricity they generate together can build up enough to spark a lightning storm.
dex.PINSIR: If PINSIR cannot crush its target between its pincers, it will instead swing the victim around and hurl it forcefully aside.
dex.POLIWAG: POLIWAG's legs are still too new to support running, so it tends to swim everywhere rather than attempt to stand.
dex.POLIWHIRL: POLIWHIRL can survive equally well in or out of water; once on land, it sweats constantly to keep its skin slick.
dex.POLIWRATH: A powerful swimmer skilled in both freestyle and breaststroke, POLIWRATH can easily leave even top human swimmers behind.
dex.PONYTA: PONYTA's hooves are harder than diamond, letting it flatten almost anything underfoot in moments.
dex.PORYGON: PORYGON exists entirely as program code, which lets it move freely through cyberspace. It was reportedly vibe-coded in a single weekend.
dex.PRIMEAPE: Perpetually furious and stubborn, PRIMEAPE will chase down its target relentlessly and refuse to give up until it is caught.
dex.PSYDUCK: Behind its blank, dazed expression, PSYDUCK is quietly cunning, and it can unleash surprising psychokinetic power on its foes.
dex.RAICHU: RAICHU's long tail acts as a grounding rod, shielding its own body from the high-voltage electricity it generates.
dex.RAPIDASH: Intensely competitive, RAPIDASH will chase after anything fast-moving it sees, eager to turn it into a race.
dex.RATICATE: RATICATE relies on its whiskers to keep its balance, and it visibly slows down if they are ever trimmed away.
dex.RATTATA: RATTATA bites at whatever it attacks. It is small and fast, which makes it one of the most commonly seen POKéMON around.
dex.RHYDON: Shielded by hide as tough as armor, RHYDON can tolerate molten lava reaching 3,600 degrees without harm.
dex.RHYHORN: RHYHORN's massive bones are a thousand times sturdier than a human's, letting it send a trailer flying with a single charge.
dex.SANDSHREW: SANDSHREW digs deep tunnels in dry regions far from any water source, surfacing only when it needs to hunt for food.
dex.SANDSLASH: When threatened, SANDSLASH curls into a spiked ball and can roll in that shape either to attack or to flee.
dex.SCYTHER: SCYTHER moves with the speed and agility of a ninja, fast enough that it can seem to split into more than one at once.
dex.SEADRA: SEADRA swims backward by beating its wing-shaped pectoral fins together with its sturdy tail.
dex.SEAKING: During the autumn spawning season, SEAKING can be seen powering its way upstream through rivers and creeks.
dex.SEEL: The hard horn jutting from SEEL's head is tough enough that it uses it to smash straight through thick ice.
dex.SHELLDER: SHELLDER's hard shell deflects nearly any attack, leaving it vulnerable only in the brief moment the shell is open.
dex.SLOWBRO: The SHELLDER clamped onto SLOWPOKE's tail is thought to survive on whatever scraps its host leaves behind.
dex.SLOWPOKE: SLOWPOKE is remarkably slow-witted, taking a full five seconds to even register that it has been attacked.
dex.SNORLAX: SNORLAX does little besides eat and sleep, and the bigger its rounded body grows, the lazier it seems to become.
dex.SPEAROW: SPEAROW feeds on bugs in grassy areas, and it must beat its short wings rapidly just to stay in the air.
dex.SQUIRTLE: Shortly after hatching, SQUIRTLE's back swells and hardens into a shell, and it can blast a powerful jet of foam from its mouth.
dex.STARMIE: STARMIE's central core shines with all seven colors of the rainbow, and some people prize it as though it were a gemstone.
dex.STARYU: A mysterious POKéMON, STARYU can regrow any limb it loses in battle with no apparent effort.
dex.TANGELA: TANGELA's entire body is wrapped in broad, seaweed-like vines, which rustle and sway with every step it takes.
dex.TAUROS: Once TAUROS sets its sights on a foe, it charges in furiously, lashing its own body with its long tails as it goes.
dex.TENTACOOL: TENTACOOL drifts through shallow coastal waters, and anglers who accidentally hook one often end up on the receiving end of its stinging acid.
dex.TENTACRUEL: TENTACRUEL usually keeps its tentacles short, but stretches them out while hunting to snare and pin down prey.
dex.VAPOREON: VAPOREON makes its home near water, and its long, finned tail is often mistaken by onlookers for a mermaid's.
dex.VENOMOTH: The fine, dust-like scales coating VENOMOTH's wings are color-coded, each shade signaling a different kind of poison it carries.
dex.VENONAT: VENONAT lurks in the shade of tall trees where it feeds on insects, and it is easily drawn out by light after dark.
dex.VENUSAUR: The flower on VENUSAUR's back blooms once it has soaked up enough sunlight, so the POKéMON keeps moving to chase the light.
dex.VICTREEBEL: Rumor holds that VICTREEBEL live in vast colonies deep within the jungle, though no one who has gone looking for them has ever come back to confirm it.
dex.VILEPLUME: The larger VILEPLUME's petals grow, the more toxic its pollen becomes, and its oversized head grows heavy enough to be a strain to hold up.
dex.VOLTORB: Typically found around power plants, VOLTORB is frequently mistaken for a POKé BALL, a mix-up that has given more than a few people a shock.
dex.VULPIX: VULPIX is born with only a single tail, which gradually splits into more as the POKéMON matures.
dex.WARTORTLE: WARTORTLE often lies in wait underwater to ambush unsuspecting prey, and it steers with its ears while swimming at speed.
dex.WEEDLE: Commonly found in forests feeding on leaves, WEEDLE carries a sharp, venomous stinger on top of its head.
dex.WEEPINBELL: WEEPINBELL spits POISONPOWDER to immobilize its target, then finishes the job with a spray of ACID.
dex.WEEZING: When the fumes from two different poison gases mingle in the same place, a pair of KOFFING can slowly merge into a single WEEZING over the years.
dex.WIGGLYTUFF: WIGGLYTUFF's body is soft and rubbery, and when it gets angry it can gulp down air to inflate itself to an enormous size.
dex.ZAPDOS: A legendary bird POKéMON, ZAPDOS is said to descend from storm clouds trailing massive bolts of lightning.
dex.ZUBAT: ZUBAT gathers in colonies inside places that never see any light, navigating and tracking targets purely through ultrasonic waves.
